vac.t: n. 吸尘器（vacuum 的缩写）；假期

e.en: The hotel has no {vacancies} this holiday weekend.
e.zh: 这个假日周末酒店没有空房了。

e.en: The company posted several engineering {vacancies} on LinkedIn.
e.zh: 公司在领英上发布了几个工程岗位空缺。

e.en: There's a {vacancy} for a junior designer on our team.
e.zh: 我们团队有一个初级设计师的职位空缺。

e.en: The motel sign flashed "No {vacancy}" all night.
e.zh: 汽车旅馆的招牌整夜闪烁着“客满”的字样。

vacant.t:
adj. 空的、未被占用的
adj. 茫然的（神情）

e.en: The apartment next door has been {vacant} for months.
e.zh: 隔壁的公寓已经空置好几个月了。

e.en: He stared at the wall with a {vacant} expression.
e.zh: 他茫然地盯着墙壁。

e.en: She gazed {vacantly} out the train window for hours.
e.zh: 她茫然地望着火车窗外好几个小时。

e.en: The tired student stared {vacantly} at the textbook.
e.zh: 疲惫的学生呆呆地盯着课本。

vacate.t: v. 腾出、空出（房间、职位）

e.en: Tenants must {vacate} the premises by the end of June.
e.zh: 租户必须在六月底前搬离这处房产。

e.en: The judge ordered the court to {vacate} the previous ruling.
e.zh: 法官下令法院撤销之前的判决。

e.en: The protesters peacefully {vacated} the building after negotiations.
e.zh: 经过谈判,抗议者和平地撤离了大楼。

e.en: She {vacated} her seat on the board last month.
e.zh: 她上个月辞去了董事会的职位。

vacation.t:
n. 假期、休假
v. 度假

e.en: We're going on {vacation} to Japan next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要去日本度假。

e.en: She booked a beach {vacation} to escape the cold winter.
e.zh: 她订了一个海滩度假行程,逃离寒冷的冬天。

e.en: The {vacationer} snapped photos of the sunset on the beach.
e.zh: 那位度假者在海滩上拍下了日落的照片。

e.en: Every {vacationer} on the island enjoyed the warm weather.
e.zh: 岛上的每位度假者都享受着温暖的天气。

e.en: My parents are {vacationing} in Hawaii this week.
e.zh: 我父母这周正在夏威夷度假。

e.en: She loves {vacationing} in small mountain towns each summer.
e.zh: 她喜欢每年夏天去山区小镇度假。

e.en: Paid {vacations} are an important employee benefit nowadays.
e.zh: 带薪休假如今是一项重要的员工福利。

e.en: He takes two {vacations} a year, usually overseas.
e.zh: 他一年休两次假,通常都去国外。

e.en: Doctors urge parents to {vaccinate} their kids on time.
e.zh: 医生敦促家长按时给孩子接种疫苗。

e.en: You should {vaccinate} your dog against rabies annually.
e.zh: 你应该每年给狗注射狂犬病疫苗。

valet.t:
n. 贴身男仆；代客泊车员
v. 为…当仆人

e.en: The hotel offers free {valet} parking for guests.
e.zh: 酒店为客人提供免费代客泊车服务。

e.en: His {valet} laid out a fresh suit each morning.
e.zh: 他的贴身男仆每天早上都为他备好新西装。

e.en: The school magazine prints a {valete} list for graduating seniors.
e.zh: 校刊会为毕业生刊登一份告别名单。

e.en: He ended his farewell speech with a heartfelt {valete}.
e.zh: 他以一句真诚的告别辞结束了演讲。

valetudinarian.t:
n. 体弱多病者
adj. 忧虑健康的

e.en: Her uncle became a {valetudinarian} after his heart surgery.
e.zh: 她叔叔在心脏手术后变得过分关注自己的健康。

e.en: The novel features a wealthy {valetudinarian} obsessed with diet.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一位痴迷于饮食的富有疑病症患者。

e.en: For surfers, this beach is absolute {Valhalla}.
e.zh: 对冲浪者来说,这片海滩简直就是天堂。

e.en: In Norse myth, fallen warriors feast in {Valhalla}.
e.zh: 在北欧神话中,阵亡的战士在英灵殿中宴饮。

e.en: She made a {valiant} effort to finish the marathon.
e.zh: 她为完成马拉松付出了英勇的努力。

e.en: The {valiant} firefighters rescued everyone from the burning building.
e.zh: 英勇的消防员把所有人都从着火的大楼里救了出来。

e.en: She fought {valiantly} against the disease for two years.
e.zh: 她与疾病英勇抗争了两年。

e.en: The team played {valiantly} despite being short three players.
e.zh: 尽管少了三名队员,球队仍然奋勇拼搏。

e.en: Your passport must be {valid} for at least six months.
e.zh: 你的护照有效期必须至少还有六个月。

e.en: That's a {valid} point worth discussing further.
e.zh: 这是个值得进一步讨论的合理观点。

e.en: Please {validate} your email address before logging in.
e.zh: 登录前请验证你的电子邮箱地址。

e.en: The data helps us {validate} our marketing assumptions.
e.zh: 这些数据有助于我们验证营销方面的假设。

validated.t:
adj. 已验证的
v. validate 的过去式

e.en: The form couldn't be submitted until every field was {validated}.
e.zh: 每个字段都通过验证后,表单才能提交。

e.en: Her therapist {validated} her feelings about the breakup.
e.zh: 她的治疗师认可了她对这段分手的感受。

validating.t: v. 正在验证（validate 的现在分词）

e.en: The script is {validating} user input before saving to the database.
e.zh: 脚本在保存到数据库前正在验证用户输入。

e.en: Hearing "me too" can be incredibly {validating} for survivors.
e.zh: 听到“我也是”对幸存者来说极具认可感。

e.en: Form {validation} failed because the email was missing an @ sign.
e.zh: 由于邮箱缺少@符号,表单验证失败了。

e.en: Many people seek {validation} from others on social media.
e.zh: 许多人在社交媒体上寻求他人的认可。

e.en: The court questioned the {validity} of the contract.
e.zh: 法院对该合同的有效性提出了质疑。

e.en: Researchers tested the {validity} of their survey results.
e.zh: 研究人员检验了他们调查结果的有效性。

e.en: The contract was {validly} signed by both parties.
e.zh: 该合同已由双方有效签署。

e.en: She argued {validly} that the policy needed updating.
e.zh: 她有理有据地主张政策需要更新。

e.en: He packed a small leather {valise} for the weekend trip.
e.zh: 他为周末旅行收拾了一个小皮手提箱。

e.en: The detective's {valise} held all his case files.
e.zh: 侦探的手提箱里装着他所有的案件档案。

valium.t: n. 安定（镇静药，商标名）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {Valium} to help with her anxiety.
e.zh: 医生开了安定来帮助缓解她的焦虑。

e.en: He took a {Valium} before the long flight.
e.zh: 他在长途飞行前吃了一片安定。

e.en: In the painting, a {Valkyrie} carries a warrior to the afterlife.
e.zh: 画中一位女武神将战士带往来世。

e.en: She dressed as a {Valkyrie} for the comic convention.
e.zh: 她在漫展上扮成了一位女武神。

e.en: We hiked through {Valle} de la Luna at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时徒步穿越了月亮谷。

e.en: The wines from {Valle} Central are excellent and affordable.
e.zh: 中央山谷的葡萄酒品质优良,价格也实惠。

e.en: Fog filled the {valley} every morning in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天的每个早晨,山谷里都弥漫着浓雾。

e.en: Many tech startups are based in Silicon {Valley}.
e.zh: 许多科技创业公司都位于硅谷。

e.en: The drone flew over green {valleys} and snow-capped peaks.
e.zh: 无人机飞越了翠绿的山谷和白雪覆盖的山峰。

e.en: Life has its peaks and {valleys}, as everyone knows.
e.zh: 人生有起有落,这是众所周知的。

e.en: The {Valois} dynasty ruled France for over 250 years.
e.zh: 瓦卢瓦王朝统治法国超过250年。

e.en: Historians still debate the legacy of the {Valois} kings.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论瓦卢瓦诸王的遗产。

e.en: The soldier received a medal for his {valor} in combat.
e.zh: 这名士兵因在战斗中表现英勇而获得勋章。

e.en: Her {valor} during the rescue inspired the entire community.
e.zh: 她在救援中的英勇行为激励了整个社区。

e.en: The artist criticized the {valorization} of fame over craft.
e.zh: 这位艺术家批评了把名气置于技艺之上的价值取向。

e.en: Government policies aim at the {valorization} of agricultural products.
e.zh: 政府政策旨在提升农产品的价值。

e.en: The {valorous} knight charged into battle without hesitation.
e.zh: 那位英勇的骑士毫不犹豫地冲入战场。

e.en: She gave a {valorous} speech defending free expression.
e.zh: 她发表了一篇捍卫言论自由的英勇演讲。

valour.t: n. 英勇（valor 的英式拼写）

e.en: He was honoured for his {valour} during the rescue mission.
e.zh: 他因在救援任务中的英勇行为而受到表彰。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {valour} of ancient warriors.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂了古代勇士的英勇。

e.en: Her advice has been incredibly {valuable} to my career.
e.zh: 她的建议对我的职业生涯极为宝贵。

e.en: He inherited a {valuable} painting from his grandmother.
e.zh: 他从祖母那里继承了一幅珍贵的画作。

e.en: Please lock your {valuables} in the hotel safe.
e.zh: 请把贵重物品锁在酒店保险箱里。

e.en: The thieves took only the most expensive {valuables}.
e.zh: 小偷只拿走了最值钱的贵重物品。

e.en: The startup reached a billion-dollar {valuation} after Series C.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在C轮融资后估值达到十亿美元。

e.en: We need a professional {valuation} before selling the house.
e.zh: 我们卖房前需要做一次专业估价。

value.t:
n. 价值；数值
v. 重视；估价

e.en: I really {value} your honest feedback on the design.
e.zh: 我非常重视你对这个设计的诚实反馈。

e.en: The {value} of the dollar dropped against the yen yesterday.
e.zh: 美元昨天兑日元的汇率下跌了。

valued.t: adj. 受重视的；已估价的

e.en: You are a deeply {valued} member of this team.
e.zh: 你是这个团队中备受重视的一员。

e.en: The painting is {valued} at over two million dollars.
e.zh: 这幅画估价超过两百万美元。

e.en: Without the original receipt, the warranty is essentially {valueless}.
e.zh: 没有原始收据,这份保修基本上毫无价值。

e.en: The old currency became {valueless} after the reform.
e.zh: 改革后,旧货币变得一文不值。

e.en: A licensed {valuer} inspected the property last Tuesday.
e.zh: 一位持牌估价师上周二查看了这处房产。

e.en: The art {valuer} authenticated the painting as a genuine Monet.
e.zh: 艺术品估价师鉴定这幅画为真正的莫奈作品。

values.t:
n. 价值观；数值
v. value 的三单

e.en: The company's core {values} include honesty and curiosity.
e.zh: 这家公司的核心价值观包括诚实和好奇心。

e.en: She {values} her quiet mornings more than anything.
e.zh: 她最珍视清晨的宁静时光。

valuing.t: v. 重视；估价（value 的现在分词）

e.en: He has trouble {valuing} his own time and effort.
e.zh: 他难以正确看待自己的时间和付出。

e.en: The accountant is {valuing} the company's assets this week.
e.zh: 会计这周正在评估公司的资产价值。

e.en: Turn the {valve} clockwise to shut off the water.
e.zh: 顺时针转动阀门即可关闭水源。

e.en: The doctor said his heart {valve} needs replacement surgery.
e.zh: 医生说他的心脏瓣膜需要做置换手术。

e.en: The cardiologist diagnosed her with mild {valvular} disease.
e.zh: 心脏科医生诊断她患有轻度瓣膜病。

e.en: Modern surgery makes {valvular} repair much safer than before.
e.zh: 现代手术让瓣膜修复比以前安全得多。

vamp.t:
n. 鞋面；勾引男人的女人
v. 即兴演奏

e.en: The pianist had to {vamp} while the singer adjusted her mic.
e.zh: 歌手调整麦克风时,钢琴师不得不即兴弹奏过渡。

e.en: She played the classic {vamp} in the noir film.
e.zh: 她在那部黑色电影中饰演了经典的妖艳女郎。

e.en: The kids dressed as a {vampire} and a witch for Halloween.
e.zh: 孩子们万圣节打扮成吸血鬼和女巫。

e.en: That coworker is a real energy {vampire} during meetings.
e.zh: 那个同事在开会时简直就是个能量吸血鬼。

e.en: The novel describes his {vampiric} obsession with younger artists.
e.zh: 小说描写了他对年轻艺术家近乎吸血般的迷恋。

e.en: She wore {vampiric} dark lipstick and a black velvet cape.
e.zh: 她涂着吸血鬼般的深色口红,披着黑色天鹅绒斗篷。

vampirism.t: n. 吸血鬼习性；残酷剥削

e.en: Folklore about {vampirism} exists in many Eastern European cultures.
e.zh: 东欧许多文化中都存在关于吸血鬼传说的民间故事。

e.en: Critics accused the company of corporate {vampirism} toward small startups.
e.zh: 批评者指责该公司对小型创业公司进行企业式的吸血压榨。

e.en: She wore a {vampy} red dress to the after-party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条妖艳的红色连衣裙参加庆功派对。

e.en: The actress is known for her {vampy} on-screen persona.
e.zh: 这位女演员以她妖艳的银幕形象而闻名。

e.en: High-quality knife steel often contains {vanadium} for added hardness.
e.zh: 优质刀具钢通常含有钒以增加硬度。

e.en: Researchers are testing {vanadium} batteries for grid-scale energy storage.
e.zh: 研究人员正在测试钒电池用于电网级储能。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {vancomycin} to treat the resistant infection.
e.zh: 医生开了万古霉素来治疗这种耐药感染。

e.en: Hospitals reserve {vancomycin} for serious bacterial infections.
e.zh: 医院将万古霉素留作治疗严重细菌感染之用。

vancouver.t: n. 温哥华（加拿大城市）

e.en: {Vancouver} is surrounded by mountains and ocean on every side.
e.zh: 温哥华四面环山环海。

e.en: She moved to {Vancouver} for a tech job last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天为一份科技工作搬到了温哥华。

e.en: A {vandal} spray-painted graffiti across the school wall.
e.zh: 一名破坏者在学校墙上喷涂了涂鸦。

e.en: Police arrested the {vandal} who smashed the bus stop.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了砸毁公交站的那名破坏者。

vaccinated.t:
adj. 已接种疫苗的
v. 接种（vaccinate 过去式）

e.en: Most students were {vaccinated} before the school year started.
e.zh: 大多数学生在学年开始前就接种了疫苗。

e.en: She got {vaccinated} against the flu last October.
e.zh: 她去年十月接种了流感疫苗。

e.en: Childhood {vaccination} has prevented millions of deaths worldwide.
e.zh: 儿童疫苗接种在全球避免了数百万人死亡。

e.en: The clinic offers free flu {vaccination} every autumn.
e.zh: 该诊所每年秋季提供免费流感疫苗接种。

e.en: Scientists developed the new {vaccine} in record time.
e.zh: 科学家以创纪录的速度研发出了这种新疫苗。

e.en: The measles {vaccine} is highly effective and safe.
e.zh: 麻疹疫苗安全且非常有效。

e.en: Modern {vaccines} protect against dozens of dangerous diseases.
e.zh: 现代疫苗可以预防几十种危险疾病。

e.en: The pharmacy stocks {vaccines} for travelers heading abroad.
e.zh: 该药店为出国旅客备有各种疫苗。

e.en: The smallpox vaccine uses the {vaccinia} virus as its base.
e.zh: 天花疫苗以痘苗病毒为基础制成。

e.en: Researchers study {vaccinia} to understand pox virus behavior.
e.zh: 研究人员研究痘苗病毒以了解痘类病毒的行为。

e.en: Stop {vacillate}—just pick one restaurant for dinner.
e.zh: 别再犹豫了,就选一家餐厅吃晚饭吧。

e.en: Politicians often {vacillate} between competing public demands.
e.zh: 政客们常常在相互冲突的公众诉求之间摇摆不定。

vacillating.t: adj. 犹豫不决的，摇摆的

e.en: His {vacillating} leadership frustrated the entire team.
e.zh: 他摇摆不定的领导风格让整个团队感到沮丧。

e.en: She kept {vacillating} between accepting and declining the offer.
e.zh: 她在接受和拒绝这份工作之间反复犹豫。

e.en: His constant {vacillation} cost the company a major deal.
e.zh: 他不断的犹豫不决让公司失去了一笔大生意。

e.en: After much {vacillation}, she finally chose the blue dress.
e.zh: 经过反复犹豫,她终于选了那条蓝色裙子。

e.en: The speech was criticized for its complete {vacuity}.
e.zh: 那场演讲因毫无内容而受到批评。

e.en: Reviewers noted the novel's surprising emotional {vacuity}.
e.zh: 评论家指出这部小说在情感上空洞得令人意外。

e.en: A plant cell stores water inside a large central {vacuole}.
e.zh: 植物细胞将水储存在一个巨大的中央液泡中。

e.en: The {vacuole} helps regulate pressure inside the cell.
e.zh: 液泡有助于调节细胞内部的压力。

e.en: The celebrity gave a {vacuous} answer to the serious question.
e.zh: 那位明星对严肃的问题给出了空洞的回答。

e.en: His {vacuous} smile suggested he wasn't really listening.
e.zh: 他茫然的微笑显示他其实并没在听。

vacuum.t:
n. 真空；吸尘器
v. 用吸尘器清扫

e.en: I need to {vacuum} the carpet before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人来之前我得用吸尘器吸一下地毯。

e.en: Sound cannot travel through the {vacuum} of outer space.
e.zh: 声音无法在外太空的真空中传播。

vacuuming.t: v. 用吸尘器清扫（进行时）

e.en: He's {vacuuming} the living room while I cook dinner.
e.zh: 我做晚饭时他正在吸客厅的尘。

e.en: {Vacuuming} regularly helps reduce dust and allergens at home.
e.zh: 经常吸尘有助于减少家中的灰尘和过敏原。

e.en: Modern robot {vacuums} clean the floor while you're away.
e.zh: 现代扫地机器人会在你外出时清洁地板。

e.en: She {vacuums} the apartment every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早上都会给公寓吸尘。

vagabond.t:
n. 流浪者
adj. 流浪的

e.en: He lived as a {vagabond}, drifting from town to town.
e.zh: 他像个流浪汉,在城镇之间漂泊。

e.en: The novel follows a charming {vagabond} across Europe.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一位迷人的流浪者游历欧洲的故事。

e.en: Slow breathing can stimulate {vagal} nerve activity and relaxation.
e.zh: 缓慢呼吸可以刺激迷走神经活动并促使放松。

e.en: The doctor measured her {vagal} response during the test.
e.zh: 医生在测试中测量了她的迷走神经反应。

vagaries.t: n. 反复无常，变幻莫测（复数）

e.en: Farmers must cope with the {vagaries} of the weather.
e.zh: 农民必须应对变幻莫测的天气。

e.en: The {vagaries} of the stock market unsettled new investors.
e.zh: 股市的反复无常让新投资者感到不安。

e.en: On a sudden {vagary}, she booked a flight to Rome.
e.zh: 她一时心血来潮,订了去罗马的机票。

e.en: Every {vagary} of fashion seems to return eventually.
e.zh: 时尚的每一种突发奇想似乎最终都会卷土重来。

e.en: The doctor explained how the {vagina} functions during childbirth.
e.zh: 医生解释了阴道在分娩过程中的作用。

e.en: Health classes should clearly teach about the {vagina}.
e.zh: 健康课应当清楚地讲解关于阴道的知识。

e.en: The pharmacy sells over-the-counter treatments for {vaginal} infections.
e.zh: 该药店出售治疗阴道感染的非处方药。

e.en: Her doctor recommended a routine {vaginal} examination this year.
e.zh: 医生建议她今年做一次常规的阴道检查。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {vagotomy} to reduce stomach acid.
e.zh: 外科医生施行了迷走神经切断术以减少胃酸。

e.en: A {vagotomy} was once common treatment for severe ulcers.
e.zh: 迷走神经切断术曾是治疗严重溃疡的常用方法。

e.en: The city repealed its outdated laws against {vagrancy}.
e.zh: 该市废除了过时的反流浪法律。

e.en: Rising rents have led to increased {vagrancy} downtown.
e.zh: 租金上涨导致市中心流浪现象增加。

vagrant.t:
n. 流浪汉
adj. 流浪的

e.en: A {vagrant} was sleeping under the bridge last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有一个流浪汉睡在桥下。

e.en: The shelter offers meals to any {vagrant} in need.
e.zh: 该收容所为任何有需要的流浪者提供餐食。

e.en: Her instructions were too {vague} for me to follow.
e.zh: 她的指示太含糊,我没法照做。

e.en: I have a {vague} memory of meeting him before.
e.zh: 我对以前见过他有一点模糊的记忆。

e.en: He {vaguely} remembered locking the door before leaving.
e.zh: 他依稀记得离开前锁了门。

e.en: Her face looked {vaguely} familiar, but I couldn't place her.
e.zh: 她的脸看着有点眼熟,但我想不起在哪见过。

e.en: The contract's {vagueness} caused disputes between the two parties.
e.zh: 合同的模糊措辞导致双方产生了纠纷。

e.en: Critics complained about the {vagueness} of the new policy.
e.zh: 批评者抱怨新政策表述含糊。

e.en: The {vagus} nerve runs from the brain to the abdomen.
e.zh: 迷走神经从大脑一直延伸到腹部。

e.en: Stimulating the {vagus} nerve may help treat depression.
e.zh: 刺激迷走神经可能有助于治疗抑郁症。

e.en: The knights would {vail} their helmets before the king.
e.zh: 骑士们会在国王面前脱下头盔以示敬意。

e.en: She watched him {vail} his hat in respectful silence.
e.zh: 她看着他默默地脱帽以示敬意。

e.en: He's so {vain} that he checks every mirror he passes.
e.zh: 他虚荣到每经过一面镜子都要照一下。

e.en: All her efforts to save the business were in {vain}.
e.zh: 她为挽救生意所做的一切努力都白费了。

e.en: His {vainglorious} speech annoyed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他自负浮夸的演讲让晚宴上的每个人都感到厌烦。

e.en: The general's {vainglorious} boasts hid his real failures.
e.zh: 那位将军自吹自擂的浮夸掩盖了他真正的失败。

e.en: She {vainly} tried to fix the broken phone herself.
e.zh: 她徒劳地试图自己修好那部坏掉的手机。

e.en: He searched {vainly} for his keys all morning.
e.zh: 他一上午都在白白地找钥匙。

e.en: She hung a floral {valance} above the kitchen window.
e.zh: 她在厨房窗户上方挂了一条带花纹的窗帘短帷。

e.en: The {valance} on the bed matched the bedroom curtains.
e.zh: 床上的床帷与卧室窗帘很配。

valdez.t: n. 瓦尔迪兹（地名/姓氏）

e.en: The Exxon {Valdez} oil spill damaged Alaska's coastline severely.
e.zh: 埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号漏油事件严重破坏了阿拉斯加海岸线。

e.en: Tourists often visit {Valdez} for its stunning glaciers.
e.zh: 游客常去瓦尔迪兹欣赏壮观的冰川。

e.en: A small village sat quietly in the green {vale}.
e.zh: 一座小村庄静静地坐落在绿色的山谷里。

e.en: They hiked down into the {vale} at sunrise.
e.zh: 他们在日出时徒步走进山谷。

e.en: His emotional {valediction} brought tears to many graduates' eyes.
e.zh: 他动情的告别辞让许多毕业生热泪盈眶。

e.en: The letter ended with a warm and heartfelt {valediction}.
e.zh: 那封信以温暖而真挚的告别语结尾。

valedictorian.t: n. 毕业典礼致辞的优秀学生

e.en: As {valedictorian}, she gave a speech at graduation.
e.zh: 作为毕业生代表,她在毕业典礼上致辞。

e.en: The {valedictorian} thanked her teachers and family warmly.
e.zh: 毕业生代表诚挚地感谢了她的老师和家人。

valedictory.t:
adj. 告别的
n. 告别演说

e.en: The principal delivered a moving {valedictory} address to seniors.
e.zh: 校长向毕业生发表了一篇感人的告别演说。

e.en: His {valedictory} email thanked colleagues for years of support.
e.zh: 他的告别邮件感谢同事们多年来的支持。

e.en: Carbon has a {valence} of four in most compounds.
e.zh: 碳在大多数化合物中的化合价为四。

e.en: Psychologists study the emotional {valence} of different memories.
e.zh: 心理学家研究不同记忆所带的情绪倾向。

valencia.t: n. 瓦伦西亚（西班牙城市）

e.en: We spent a sunny week in {Valencia} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在巴伦西亚度过了阳光明媚的一周。

e.en: This juice is made from sweet {Valencia} oranges.
e.zh: 这款果汁是用甜瓦伦西亚橙榨成的。

valency.t: n. 化合价（等同于 valence）

e.en: Carbon has a {valency} of four in most compounds.
e.zh: 碳在大多数化合物中的化合价为四。

e.en: Linguists discuss the {valency} of verbs in a sentence.
e.zh: 语言学家讨论句子中动词的配价。

valentine.t: n. 情人节爱人；情人节贺卡

e.en: He sent her a handmade {valentine} with a poem inside.
e.zh: 他寄给她一张手工情人节卡片，里面还有首诗。

e.en: Will you be my {valentine} this year?
e.zh: 今年你愿意做我的情人吗？

valentines.t: n. 情人节贺卡（复数）；情人节

e.en: The kids exchanged {valentines} during class on Monday.
e.zh: 周一上课时孩子们互送情人节卡片。

e.en: Restaurants get fully booked on {Valentines} Day.
e.zh: 情人节当天餐厅都被订满了。

valentino.t: n. 瓦伦蒂诺（人名/品牌）

e.en: She wore a stunning {Valentino} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件惊艳的华伦天奴礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: Rudolph {Valentino} was a silent film heartthrob.
e.zh: 鲁道夫·瓦伦蒂诺曾是默片时代的万人迷。

e.en: She drinks {valerian} tea to help her sleep.
e.zh: 她喝缬草茶来帮助入睡。

e.en: The garden was filled with pink {valerian} flowers.
e.zh: 花园里开满了粉色的缬草花。

vandalise.t: v. 故意破坏（公共财物）

e.en: Teenagers tried to {vandalise} the public library overnight.
e.zh: 几个青少年企图在夜里破坏公共图书馆。

e.en: It is illegal to {vandalise} historic monuments anywhere.
e.zh: 破坏历史古迹在任何地方都是违法的。

vandalised.t: v. 故意破坏（vandalise 的过去式）

e.en: Someone {vandalised} the playground equipment last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末有人破坏了游乐场的设备。

e.en: The car was badly {vandalised} while parked downtown.
e.zh: 那辆车停在市区时被严重损坏。

vandalism.t: n. 故意破坏公物的行为

e.en: Graffiti and broken windows are common forms of {vandalism}.
e.zh: 涂鸦和砸碎玻璃是常见的破坏行为。

e.en: The city spent thousands repairing damage from {vandalism}.
e.zh: 市政府花了数千美元修复破坏行为造成的损失。

vandalize.t: v. 故意破坏（公共财物）

e.en: Don't {vandalize} the new bus shelters, please.
e.zh: 请不要破坏新建的公交候车亭。

e.en: Some fans tried to {vandalize} the rival team's stadium.
e.zh: 一些球迷企图破坏对手球队的体育场。

vandalized.t: v. 故意破坏（vandalize 的过去式）

e.en: Vandals {vandalized} dozens of cars in the parking lot.
e.zh: 破坏者损毁了停车场里的几十辆车。

e.en: The statue was {vandalized} during the protest last night.
e.zh: 那座雕像在昨晚的抗议中被破坏了。

vandalizes.t: v. 故意破坏（第三人称单数）

e.en: Anyone who {vandalizes} property faces criminal charges here.
e.zh: 在这里破坏财物的人都会面临刑事指控。

e.en: He frequently {vandalizes} signs along the highway at night.
e.zh: 他经常在夜里破坏高速公路旁的标志牌。

e.en: Teenagers were caught {vandalizing} the bus stop last night.
e.zh: 昨晚几个青少年因破坏公交车站被抓。

e.en: He was fined for {vandalizing} the public mural.
e.zh: 他因损坏公共壁画被罚款。

e.en: {Vandals} sprayed graffiti all over the school walls.
e.zh: 破坏者在学校墙上到处涂鸦。

e.en: Police are searching for the {vandals} who damaged the statue.
e.zh: 警方正在追查毁坏雕像的破坏分子。

e.en: The weather {vane} on the barn pointed north.
e.zh: 谷仓上的风向标指向北方。

e.en: Wind turned the rusted {vane} on the rooftop.
e.zh: 风吹动着屋顶上生锈的风向标。

e.en: This startup is at the {vanguard} of AI research.
e.zh: 这家初创公司处于人工智能研究的最前沿。

e.en: The {vanguard} of the army crossed the river first.
e.zh: 军队的先头部队率先渡过河流。

vanilla.t:
n. 香草（风味）
adj. 普通的、无特色的

e.en: I'll have a scoop of {vanilla} ice cream, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一勺香草冰淇淋。

e.en: The app ships with a pretty {vanilla} setup.
e.zh: 这款应用自带相当朴素的默认配置。

e.en: Magicians make coins {vanish} into thin air.
e.zh: 魔术师能让硬币凭空消失。

e.en: My motivation tends to {vanish} after lunch.
e.zh: 我的干劲往往在午饭后就消失了。

e.en: Her phone {vanished} from the table within seconds.
e.zh: 她的手机几秒钟内就从桌上不见了。

e.en: The old bookstore {vanished} when rents went up.
e.zh: 租金上涨后那家老书店就消失了。

vanishes.t: v. 消失（第三人称单数）

e.en: The notification {vanishes} after three seconds onscreen.
e.zh: 该通知在屏幕上显示三秒后就消失。

e.en: Morning fog {vanishes} as soon as the sun rises.
e.zh: 晨雾在太阳一升起就消散了。

e.en: Handwritten letters are a {vanishing} tradition today.
e.zh: 如今手写信件已是日渐消失的传统。

e.en: The {vanishing} point gives the painting real depth.
e.zh: 那个消失点让这幅画极具纵深感。

vanishingly.t: adv. 小到几乎可忽略地

e.en: The odds of winning are {vanishingly} small.
e.zh: 中奖的概率小到几乎可以忽略不计。

e.en: Bugs in production are {vanishingly} rare now.
e.zh: 如今生产环境的漏洞已经少得几乎绝迹。

e.en: Social media feeds on our small {vanities}.
e.zh: 社交媒体正是靠我们那点虚荣心生存的。

e.en: The bathroom features two marble {vanities}.
e.zh: 这间浴室配有两个大理石梳妆台。

e.en: His {vanity} made it hard to accept criticism.
e.zh: 他的虚荣心让他难以接受批评。

e.en: She sat at the {vanity} brushing her hair.
e.zh: 她坐在梳妆台前梳头发。

e.en: They delivered a whole {vanload} of furniture today.
e.zh: 他们今天送来了满满一车家具。

e.en: A {vanload} of volunteers arrived at the shelter.
e.zh: 一车志愿者抵达了收容所。

e.en: The hero set out to {vanquish} the dragon.
e.zh: 英雄出发去击败那条恶龙。

e.en: She finally managed to {vanquish} her stage fright.
e.zh: 她终于战胜了自己的舞台恐惧。

vanquished.t:
v. 击败（过去式）
adj. 战败的

e.en: Our team {vanquished} the defending champions last night.
e.zh: 我们队昨晚击败了卫冕冠军。

e.en: The {vanquished} army retreated across the border.
e.zh: 战败的军队撤过了边境。

vans.t:
n. 厢式货车（复数）
n. 品牌 Vans

e.en: Three delivery {vans} are parked outside the warehouse.
e.zh: 三辆送货厢式货车停在仓库外面。

e.en: He always wears black {Vans} sneakers to work.
e.zh: 他上班总是穿黑色的Vans板鞋。

e.en: From this {vantage} point you can see the whole valley.
e.zh: 从这个有利位置可以俯瞰整个山谷。

e.en: The hill offered a great {vantage} for photos.
e.zh: 那座小山是拍照的绝佳观景点。

e.en: {Vanuatu} is famous for its volcanoes and clear lagoons.
e.zh: 瓦努阿图以火山和清澈的潟湖闻名。

e.en: They honeymooned on a remote island in {Vanuatu}.
e.zh: 他们在瓦努阿图一个偏远小岛上度蜜月。

e.en: The talk show was full of {vapid} celebrity gossip.
e.zh: 那档脱口秀满是空洞乏味的明星八卦。

e.en: He gave a {vapid} smile and changed the subject.
e.zh: 他露出一个无趣的笑容然后转移了话题。

e.en: Water {vapor} condenses into clouds high in the sky.
e.zh: 水蒸气在高空凝结成云。

e.en: A faint {vapor} rose from the hot coffee.
e.zh: 一缕淡淡的水汽从热咖啡里升起。

e.en: We took the {vaporetto} down the Grand Canal in Venice.
e.zh: 我们乘水上巴士沿威尼斯大运河前行。

e.en: A single {vaporetto} ticket isn't cheap these days.
e.zh: 如今一张水上巴士单程票可不便宜。

e.en: Intense heat can {vaporise} metal almost instantly.
e.zh: 高温几乎能瞬间使金属汽化。

e.en: The morning dew began to {vaporise} as sunlight hit it.
e.zh: 晨露在阳光照射下开始蒸发。

e.en: The {vaporization} of water requires significant energy.
e.zh: 水的汽化需要相当多的能量。

e.en: Engineers studied the fuel's {vaporization} rate carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细研究了燃料的汽化速率。

e.en: The laser can {vaporize} small bits of debris in space.
e.zh: 激光可以汽化太空中的小块碎片。

e.en: Hopes of a deal seemed to {vaporize} overnight.
e.zh: 达成协议的希望仿佛一夜之间就化为乌有。

e.en: The asteroid {vaporized} on entering the atmosphere.
e.zh: 那颗小行星进入大气层时就汽化了。

e.en: His savings nearly {vaporized} during the market crash.
e.zh: 他的积蓄在市场崩盘中几乎化为乌有。

e.en: She uses a {vaporizer} to ease her cough at night.
e.zh: 她晚上用蒸汽机来缓解咳嗽。

e.en: Plug the {vaporizer} in before adding the essential oil.
e.zh: 先插上蒸汽机的电源再加精油。

e.en: A {vaporous} mist hung over the lake at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时湖面上笼罩着一层薄薄的水雾。

e.en: His promises felt {vaporous} and unreliable.
e.zh: 他的承诺听起来虚无缥缈，不太可靠。

e.en: Steam is just water in {vapour} form.
e.zh: 蒸汽其实就是水的气态形式。

e.en: A cloud of {vapour} drifted out of the kettle.
e.zh: 一团水汽从水壶里飘了出来。

e.en: The {vaquero} skillfully roped the wandering calf.
e.zh: 那位墨西哥牛仔熟练地套住了走失的小牛。

e.en: American cowboy culture borrowed heavily from the {vaquero}.
e.zh: 美国牛仔文化深受墨西哥牛仔的影响。

var.t:
n. 变量（variable 缩写）
n. VAR 视频助理裁判

e.en: There's huge {variability} in customer response times.
e.zh: 客户响应时间存在巨大差异。

e.en: Climate {variability} makes long-term planning difficult.
e.zh: 气候的多变性使长期规划变得困难。

variable.t:
n. 变量
adj. 可变的

e.en: Declare the {variable} before using it in the function.
e.zh: 在函数中使用之前先声明这个变量。

e.en: Weather in spring is highly {variable} around here.
e.zh: 这里春天的天气变化无常。

e.en: Many {variables} affect the outcome of the experiment.
e.zh: 许多变量都会影响实验的结果。

e.en: Store API keys in environment {variables}, not in code.
e.zh: 应把API密钥存在环境变量里，而不是写进代码。

e.en: The medication works {variably} from patient to patient.
e.zh: 这种药对不同病人的效果差异很大。

e.en: Skies will be {variably} cloudy throughout the afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午天空将多云转晴不定。

e.en: There's a notable {variance} between the two reports.
e.zh: 两份报告之间存在明显的差异。

e.en: Statisticians calculate the {variance} of each data set.
e.zh: 统计学家会计算每个数据集的方差。

variant.t:
n. 变体；变种
adj. 不同的

e.en: A new {variant} of the virus emerged this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天出现了一种新的病毒变种。

e.en: This shoe comes in a vegan leather {variant} too.
e.zh: 这款鞋还有一个素皮革版本。

e.en: Each random {variate} is drawn from the same distribution.
e.zh: 每个随机变量都取自同一分布。

e.en: The model treats temperature as a continuous {variate}.
e.zh: 该模型把温度作为一个连续变量来处理。

e.en: There's slight {variation} in color between batches.
e.zh: 不同批次之间颜色略有差异。

e.en: This recipe is a {variation} on classic carbonara.
e.zh: 这道菜是经典培根蛋意面的一种变体。

e.en: The store sells three {variations} of the same hoodie.
e.zh: 这家店出售同款连帽衫的三种版本。

e.en: Seasonal {variations} in demand affect our pricing.
e.zh: 需求的季节性变化会影响我们的定价。

e.en: The doctor warned about the risk of {variceal} bleeding.
e.zh: 医生警告说有静脉曲张出血的风险。

e.en: Endoscopy is the standard treatment for {variceal} hemorrhage.
e.zh: 内镜检查是静脉曲张出血的标准治疗手段。

e.en: Most kids get the {varicella} vaccine before kindergarten.
e.zh: 大多数孩子在上幼儿园前会接种水痘疫苗。

e.en: She caught {varicella} from her younger brother.
e.zh: 她从弟弟那里传染上了水痘。

e.en: Standing all day worsened her {varicose} veins.
e.zh: 整天站立加重了她的静脉曲张。

e.en: Compression socks can help with {varicose} veins.
e.zh: 压力袜对静脉曲张有缓解作用。

varied.t:
adj. 各种各样的
v. vary 的过去式

e.en: The menu offers a {varied} selection of vegan dishes.
e.zh: 菜单上提供了丰富多样的素食选择。

e.en: Reviews of the new film have been wildly {varied}.
e.zh: 对这部新片的评价两极分化非常严重。

variegate.t: v. 使多样化；使呈杂色

e.en: Designers often {variegate} the layout to keep readers engaged.
e.zh: 设计师常会让版式多样化以吸引读者。

e.en: Gardeners {variegate} flower beds with contrasting colors.
e.zh: 园丁会用对比色让花坛显得丰富多彩。

e.en: The garden features {variegated} leaves with cream and green stripes.
e.zh: 花园里有奶白与绿色条纹相间的杂色叶片。

e.en: She painted a {variegated} pattern across the entire wall.
e.zh: 她在整面墙上画了多彩斑斓的图案。

e.en: The plant's leaf {variegation} fades when grown in low light.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶片斑纹在弱光下会褪色。

e.en: Collectors pay extra for unusual {variegation} on rare houseplants.
e.zh: 收藏家愿为稀有室内植物的独特斑纹多付钱。

varies.t: v. vary 的第三人称单数，变化

e.en: The price {varies} depending on the season and demand.
e.zh: 价格根据季节和需求而有所不同。

e.en: Battery life {varies} widely between different phone models.
e.zh: 不同手机型号的电池续航差异很大。

varietal.t: adj. 品种的（尤指葡萄酒）

e.en: This {varietal} of grape thrives in cool coastal climates.
e.zh: 这种葡萄品种在凉爽的沿海气候中长势很好。

e.en: The winery specializes in single-{varietal} red wines.
e.zh: 这家酒庄专注于单一品种的红葡萄酒。

varieties.t: n. variety 的复数，多种多样

e.en: The store stocks dozens of {varieties} of imported cheese.
e.zh: 这家店备有数十种进口奶酪。

e.en: Farmers planted heirloom {varieties} to preserve genetic diversity.
e.zh: 农民种植传家宝品种以保存基因多样性。

e.en: The cafe offers a wide {variety} of plant-based milks.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供多种植物奶选择。

e.en: Adding {variety} to your workouts prevents boredom and plateaus.
e.zh: 训练多样化能避免枯燥和瓶颈期。

various.t: adj. 各种各样的；不同的

e.en: The app supports {various} languages including Chinese and Spanish.
e.zh: 该应用支持包括中文和西班牙语在内的多种语言。

e.en: She has worked at {various} startups over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里她在多家初创公司工作过。

variously.t: adv. 以不同的方式；各自不同地

e.en: The painting has been {variously} described as bold and chaotic.
e.zh: 这幅画被人们形容得各不相同,有人说大胆,有人说混乱。

e.en: He is {variously} known as a coder, writer, and teacher.
e.zh: 他以程序员、作家和教师等多重身份为人所知。

e.en: A pesky {varmint} keeps digging up the vegetable garden.
e.zh: 一只讨厌的小害兽老是在菜园里乱挖。

e.en: The farmer set traps to catch the troublesome {varmint}.
e.zh: 农夫设了陷阱来抓那只惹麻烦的小动物。

varna.t: n. 瓦尔纳（保加利亚城市）；(印度) 种姓

e.en: The ancient {varna} system divided society into four broad classes.
e.zh: 古代瓦尔纳制度将社会划分为四大种姓。

e.en: Scholars debate how rigidly {varna} categories were enforced historically.
e.zh: 学者们争论瓦尔纳种姓在历史上执行得有多严格。

varnish.t:
n. 清漆；亮光漆
v. 上漆

e.en: Apply a coat of {varnish} to protect the wooden floor.
e.zh: 涂一层清漆来保护木地板。

e.en: The polite words couldn't {varnish} over his real intentions.
e.zh: 客气话掩盖不了他的真实意图。

varnished.t:
adj. 涂了清漆的
v. varnish 的过去式

e.en: He {varnished} the bookshelf to bring out the wood grain.
e.zh: 他给书架上了清漆,凸显出木纹。

e.en: She gave a {varnished} version of events to the press.
e.zh: 她向媒体讲了一个经过粉饰的版本。

e.en: He made the {varsity} basketball team in his junior year.
e.zh: 他高三那年入选了校队篮球队。

e.en: The {varsity} jacket featured the school's colors and emblem.
e.zh: 那件校队夹克上印有学校的颜色和校徽。

e.en: Results may {vary} depending on individual circumstances and effort.
e.zh: 结果可能因个人情况和努力程度而异。

e.en: Try to {vary} your route to avoid getting bored.
e.zh: 试着换换路线,免得感到无聊。

e.en: Students arrived with {varying} levels of programming experience.
e.zh: 学生们带着深浅不一的编程经验前来。

e.en: The product has received {varying} reviews from early users.
e.zh: 该产品收到了早期用户褒贬不一的评价。

e.en: {Vasco} da Gama opened the sea route from Europe to India.
e.zh: 瓦斯科·达伽马开辟了从欧洲到印度的海上航线。

e.en: The museum displays maps inspired by {Vasco}'s legendary voyages.
e.zh: 博物馆展出受瓦斯科传奇航行启发而绘制的地图。

e.en: Regular exercise improves {vascular} health and lowers blood pressure.
e.zh: 规律运动能改善血管健康并降低血压。

e.en: The doctor referred him to a {vascular} specialist immediately.
e.zh: 医生立刻把他转给了一位血管专科医生。

vascularity.t: n. 血管分布；血管丰富程度

e.en: Bodybuilders prize the {vascularity} that comes with low body fat.
e.zh: 健美运动员推崇低体脂带来的明显血管线条。

e.en: Imaging revealed reduced {vascularity} in the affected tissue.
e.zh: 影像显示受影响组织的血管供应减少了。

vasculature.t: n. 脉管系统；血管分布

e.en: The retina's delicate {vasculature} can reveal early signs of diabetes.
e.zh: 视网膜上精细的血管系统可显示糖尿病的早期迹象。

e.en: Surgeons carefully mapped the tumor's {vasculature} before operating.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前仔细绘制了肿瘤的血管分布。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with autoimmune {vasculitis} last spring.
e.zh: 这位患者去年春天被诊断为自身免疫性血管炎。

e.en: {Vasculitis} causes painful inflammation in the body's blood vessels.
e.zh: 血管炎会引起体内血管痛苦的炎症反应。

e.en: She arranged fresh tulips in a glass {vase} on the table.
e.zh: 她把新鲜的郁金香插在桌上的玻璃花瓶里。

e.en: The antique {vase} sold for over a million dollars.
e.zh: 这只古董花瓶卖出了超过一百万美元的高价。

e.en: He scheduled a {vasectomy} after their third child was born.
e.zh: 他们第三个孩子出生后,他预约了输精管结扎手术。

e.en: A {vasectomy} is a quick outpatient procedure with low risks.
e.zh: 输精管结扎是一项快速的门诊手术,风险很低。

e.en: Apply a thin layer of {Vaseline} to chapped lips overnight.
e.zh: 在干裂的嘴唇上薄薄涂一层凡士林过夜。

e.en: She keeps a tub of {Vaseline} in her travel bag.
e.zh: 她的旅行包里常备着一罐凡士林。

e.en: Empty {vases} lined the shelf above the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 空花瓶整齐地排在厨房水槽上方的架子上。

e.en: The artist designs ceramic {vases} for boutique hotels worldwide.
e.zh: 这位艺术家为全球精品酒店设计陶瓷花瓶。

e.en: Cold weather causes {vasoconstriction} in the fingers and toes.
e.zh: 寒冷天气会引起手指和脚趾血管收缩。

e.en: Caffeine triggers mild {vasoconstriction} that can ease some headaches.
e.zh: 咖啡因能引起轻度血管收缩,从而缓解某些头痛。

e.en: The nasal spray contains a {vasoconstrictor} to reduce congestion.
e.zh: 这种鼻喷剂含有血管收缩剂以减轻鼻塞。

e.en: Doctors avoid prescribing strong {vasoconstrictor} drugs to hypertensive patients.
e.zh: 医生避免给高血压患者开强效的血管收缩药物。

e.en: Exercise produces {vasodilation} that helps cool the working body.
e.zh: 运动会引起血管扩张,有助于运动中的身体散热。

e.en: Alcohol triggers {vasodilation}, which makes the skin feel warm.
e.zh: 酒精会引起血管扩张,让皮肤感觉发热。

e.en: The cardiologist prescribed a {vasodilator} to ease his chest pain.
e.zh: 心脏科医生开了一种血管扩张剂来缓解他的胸痛。

e.en: Beetroot juice acts as a natural {vasodilator} during workouts.
e.zh: 甜菜根汁在锻炼时可作为天然的血管扩张剂。

vasopressin.t: n. 血管加压素；抗利尿激素

e.en: The brain releases {vasopressin} to help the kidneys retain water.
e.zh: 大脑会分泌血管加压素,帮助肾脏留住水分。

e.en: Researchers link {vasopressin} to social bonding in mammals.
e.zh: 研究人员将血管加压素与哺乳动物的社会联结联系起来。

e.en: The medieval lord granted land to each loyal {vassal}.
e.zh: 中世纪的领主把土地分封给每一位忠诚的家臣。

e.en: Critics warned the country was becoming a {vassal} state.
e.zh: 批评者警告说该国正沦为附庸国。

e.en: The library holds a {vast} collection of rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 这座图书馆藏有大量珍稀手稿。

e.en: There's a {vast} difference between knowing and actually doing.
e.zh: 知道和真正去做之间有着巨大的差距。

e.en: The new model is {vastly} faster than its predecessor.
e.zh: 新款机型比上一代快得多。

e.en: Their experiences in the program differed {vastly} from mine.
e.zh: 他们在项目中的经历与我的截然不同。

e.en: Standing on the cliff, she felt the ocean's {vastness}.
e.zh: 站在悬崖上,她感受到了海洋的辽阔。

e.en: The {vastness} of space makes Earth feel incredibly small.
e.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚让地球显得无比渺小。

e.en: Squats primarily strengthen the {vastus} muscles in the thigh.
e.zh: 深蹲主要锻炼大腿的股肌群。

e.en: The physical therapist focused on his weak {vastus} medialis.
e.zh: 理疗师重点训练他薄弱的股内侧肌。

vat.t:
n. 大桶；大缸
n. 增值税 (VAT)

e.en: Tourists wait hours to enter the {Vatican} museums each morning.
e.zh: 游客每天早上要排好几个小时才能进入梵蒂冈博物馆。

e.en: The pope addressed reporters from a balcony at the {Vatican}.
e.zh: 教皇在梵蒂冈的一个阳台上向记者发表讲话。

vaudeville.t: n. 杂耍表演；歌舞杂耍

e.en: His grandfather performed comedy routines in 1920s {vaudeville}.
e.zh: 他祖父在二十世纪二十年代的杂耍剧场表演喜剧。

e.en: The film pays homage to classic {vaudeville} stage gags.
e.zh: 这部电影向经典杂耍剧场的舞台噱头致敬。

vaudevillian.t:
n. 杂耍演员
adj. 杂耍的

e.en: The old {vaudevillian} still remembered every punchline by heart.
e.zh: 那位老杂耍演员至今还能背出每一句笑点。

e.en: Her timing reveals her training in classic {vaudevillian} comedy.
e.zh: 她的节奏感显露出她受过经典杂耍喜剧的训练。

vault.t:
n. 金库；拱顶
v. 撑跳

e.en: The bank stores gold bars in an underground {vault}.
e.zh: 银行把金条存放在地下金库里。

e.en: The gymnast nailed her {vault} and stuck the landing.
e.zh: 那位体操运动员漂亮地完成了跳马并稳稳落地。

vaulted.t:
adj. 拱形的
v. 撑跳（过去式）

e.en: The cathedral has a beautifully {vaulted} stone ceiling.
e.zh: 这座大教堂有着精美的拱形石质天花板。

e.en: She {vaulted} over the fence and ran toward the bus.
e.zh: 她一跃跳过栅栏,朝公交车跑去。

e.en: The pole {vaulter} cleared six meters at the championships.
e.zh: 这位撑竿跳选手在锦标赛上越过了六米的高度。

e.en: Every elite {vaulter} trains for years on grip and approach.
e.zh: 每位顶尖撑竿跳选手都要花数年训练握杆和助跑。

vaulting.t:
n. 跳跃；拱顶结构
adj. 好高骛远的

e.en: Her {vaulting} ambition pushed her to start three companies.
e.zh: 她那雄心勃勃的志向促使她创办了三家公司。

e.en: The kids spent the afternoon {vaulting} over playground bars.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在游乐场的横杠上跳来跳去。

vaunt.t:
v. 夸耀
n. 自夸

e.en: He likes to {vaunt} his connections at every dinner party.
e.zh: 他喜欢在每场晚宴上炫耀自己的人脉。

e.en: True experts rarely {vaunt} their credentials in casual conversation.
e.zh: 真正的专家很少在闲聊中夸耀自己的资历。

e.en: The {vaunted} new feature turned out to be quite buggy.
e.zh: 那备受吹捧的新功能结果问题不少。

e.en: Their {vaunted} security system failed during the first attack.
e.zh: 他们号称强大的安全系统在第一次攻击时就崩溃了。

e.en: His {vaunting} speech about the merger annoyed many shareholders.
e.zh: 他关于合并的那番自夸演讲惹恼了许多股东。

e.en: She dislikes the CEO's {vaunting} tone on earnings calls.
e.zh: 她不喜欢这位CEO在财报电话会上自吹自擂的口吻。

vauxhall.t: n. 沃克斯豪尔（英国汽车品牌）

e.en: He drives an old {Vauxhall} hatchback to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天开一辆旧款沃克斯豪尔掀背车上班。

e.en: The {Vauxhall} factory once employed thousands of British workers.
e.zh: 沃克斯豪尔工厂曾雇佣了数千名英国工人。

e.en: Old {VCRs} still gather dust in many family basements.
e.zh: 许多家庭的地下室里仍堆放着积灰的老式录像机。

e.en: Streaming services completely replaced {VCRs} in the early 2000s.
e.zh: 流媒体服务在两千年代初完全取代了录像机。

e.en: The Italian restaurant is famous for its tender {veal} cutlets.
e.zh: 这家意大利餐厅以其鲜嫩的小牛肉排闻名。

e.en: Animal welfare groups oppose how most {veal} is produced.
e.zh: 动物福利组织反对大多数小牛肉的生产方式。

vector.t:
n. 向量；矢量
n. 病媒

e.en: Save the logo as a {vector} file so it scales cleanly.
e.zh: 把标志保存为矢量文件,这样放大缩小都清晰。

e.en: Mosquitoes are a major {vector} for spreading dengue fever.
e.zh: 蚊子是传播登革热的主要媒介。

e.en: Each {Veda} contains hymns, rituals, and philosophical reflections.
e.zh: 每一部吠陀经都包含赞歌、仪式和哲学思考。

e.en: Scholars consider the Rig {Veda} the oldest known Sanskrit text.
e.zh: 学者们认为《梨俱吠陀》是已知最古老的梵文文献。

e.en: She studies {Vedic} chants under a renowned Sanskrit teacher.
e.zh: 她跟随一位著名的梵文老师学习吠陀诵唱。

e.en: {Vedic} astrology differs significantly from the Western zodiac system.
e.zh: 吠陀占星学与西方的黄道体系有很大不同。

e.en: The {veep} chaired the meeting in the president's absence.
e.zh: 副总统在总统缺席时主持了会议。

e.en: She was promoted to {veep} of marketing last year.
e.zh: 她去年被提拔为市场部副总裁。

veer.t: v. 突然转向；改变方向

e.en: The car began to {veer} sharply to the right.
e.zh: 汽车开始猛地向右偏转。

e.en: Don't let the conversation {veer} off topic again.
e.zh: 别让谈话再次偏离主题。

veg.t:
n. 蔬菜（vegetable 缩写）
v. 闲躺发呆

e.en: {Vega} is one of the brightest stars in the night sky.
e.zh: 织女星是夜空中最亮的恒星之一。

e.en: Astronomers studied {Vega} for clues about young star systems.
e.zh: 天文学家研究织女星以寻找年轻恒星系统的线索。

vegan.t:
n. 严格素食者
adj. 纯素的

e.en: She switched to a {vegan} diet last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天改吃纯素饮食。

e.en: This café offers several delicious {vegan} desserts.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供几款美味的纯素甜点。

e.en: We flew to {Vegas} for the weekend bachelor party.
e.zh: 我们飞去拉斯维加斯参加周末的单身派对。

e.en: The {Vegas} strip is dazzling at night.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯大道在夜晚璀璨夺目。

e.en: Add one chopped {vegetable} to the soup pot.
e.zh: 往汤锅里加一个切碎的蔬菜。

e.en: Carrot is my favorite {vegetable} for snacking.
e.zh: 胡萝卜是我最喜欢当零食的蔬菜。

e.en: Eat more {vegetables} to stay healthy.
e.zh: 多吃蔬菜有助于保持健康。

e.en: The market sells fresh {vegetables} every morning.
e.zh: 市场每天早上都有新鲜蔬菜出售。

e.en: The perfume has a green, {vegetal} aroma.
e.zh: 这款香水带有清新的植物气息。

e.en: Scientists examined the {vegetal} matter in the soil.
e.zh: 科学家检测了土壤中的植物物质。

vegetarian.t:
n. 素食者
adj. 素食的

e.en: He's been a strict {vegetarian} for ten years.
e.zh: 他已经严格吃素十年了。

e.en: The restaurant has a great {vegetarian} menu.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的素食菜单很棒。

e.en: {Vegetarianism} is becoming more popular among young people.
e.zh: 素食主义在年轻人中越来越流行。

e.en: She wrote a book about the health benefits of {vegetarianism}.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于素食主义健康益处的书。

e.en: Many {vegetarians} avoid eggs as well as meat.
e.zh: 许多素食者既不吃肉也不吃蛋。

e.en: The buffet has plenty of options for {vegetarians}.
e.zh: 自助餐为素食者准备了很多选择。

vegetate.t: v. 过呆板生活；植物般生长

e.en: I just want to {vegetate} on the couch tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我只想瘫在沙发上发呆。

e.en: Don't {vegetate} indoors all weekend; go outside.
e.zh: 别整个周末窝在家里发呆,出去走走。

e.en: The hillside is heavily {vegetated} with native shrubs.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了本地灌木丛。

e.en: He {vegetated} in front of the TV all Sunday.
e.zh: 他整个星期天都在电视机前发呆。

e.en: Dense {vegetation} covered the abandoned village.
e.zh: 茂密的植被覆盖了废弃的村庄。

e.en: The desert has very little {vegetation}.
e.zh: 沙漠里植被非常稀少。

e.en: The patient remained in a {vegetative} state for weeks.
e.zh: 病人持续处于植物人状态数周。

e.en: Plants reproduce through both seeds and {vegetative} growth.
e.zh: 植物通过种子和无性繁殖两种方式繁衍。

e.en: I ordered a {veggie} burger with extra avocado.
e.zh: 我点了一个素汉堡,加多份牛油果。

e.en: Chop the {veggie} mix finely for the stir-fry.
e.zh: 把蔬菜切碎用来炒。

e.en: She defended her ideas with surprising {vehemence}.
e.zh: 她以出乎意料的激烈态度捍卫自己的观点。

e.en: The {vehemence} of his reaction shocked everyone.
e.zh: 他激烈的反应让所有人都很震惊。

e.en: He made a {vehement} denial of the accusations.
e.zh: 他强烈否认了这些指控。

e.en: Her {vehement} opposition forced the committee to reconsider.
e.zh: 她的强烈反对迫使委员会重新考虑。

e.en: She {vehemently} disagreed with the proposed budget cuts.
e.zh: 她强烈反对拟议的预算削减。

e.en: He {vehemently} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 他激烈地否认参与了这起丑闻。

vehicle.t:
n. 车辆；交通工具
n. 载体、媒介

e.en: Please park your {vehicle} in the visitor lot.
e.zh: 请把您的车辆停在访客停车场。

e.en: Social media became a {vehicle} for political change.
e.zh: 社交媒体成了推动政治变革的载体。

e.en: Electric {vehicles} are becoming more affordable each year.
e.zh: 电动汽车每年都变得更实惠。

e.en: All {vehicles} must yield to pedestrians here.
e.zh: 在这里所有车辆都必须让行人先行。

e.en: The bridge is closed to all {vehicular} traffic today.
e.zh: 今天大桥禁止所有车辆通行。

e.en: He was charged with {vehicular} manslaughter after the crash.
e.zh: 车祸后他被指控犯有车辆过失杀人罪。

veil.t:
n. 面纱
v. 遮盖、掩饰

e.en: The bride lifted her white {veil} at the altar.
e.zh: 新娘在圣坛前掀起了白色面纱。

e.en: A thick {veil} of fog covered the harbor.
e.zh: 厚厚的雾气笼罩着港口。

e.en: His remark was a thinly {veiled} threat.
e.zh: 他的话是赤裸裸的暗中威胁。

e.en: The mountain peak was {veiled} in morning mist.
e.zh: 山顶笼罩在晨雾之中。

e.en: Lemon {verbena} adds a bright citrus note to herbal tea.
e.zh: 柠檬马鞭草给花草茶增添了一股清新的柑橘味。

e.en: Purple {verbena} bloomed all summer along the garden path.
e.zh: 紫色的马鞭草整个夏天都开在花园小径旁。

verbiage.t: n. 冗长的话；啰嗦的表达

e.en: Cut the unnecessary {verbiage} and get to the point.
e.zh: 删掉那些多余的废话,直奔主题吧。

e.en: Legal contracts are often full of confusing {verbiage}.
e.zh: 法律合同里常常充斥着令人困惑的冗长措辞。

e.en: His emails are too {verbose} for busy colleagues to read.
e.zh: 他的邮件太啰嗦,忙碌的同事根本读不下去。

e.en: Enable {verbose} logging to debug the deployment issue.
e.zh: 开启详细日志来调试这个部署问题。

e.en: The professor's {verbosity} put half the class to sleep.
e.zh: 教授冗长啰嗦的讲法让半个班都睡着了。

e.en: You can adjust the {verbosity} level in the config file.
e.zh: 你可以在配置文件里调整日志的详细程度。

e.en: Irregular {verbs} are tricky for English learners.
e.zh: 不规则动词对英语学习者来说很棘手。

e.en: Strong {verbs} make your writing more vivid.
e.zh: 强有力的动词能让你的写作更生动。

verdant.t: adj. 青翠的；满是绿植的

e.en: The {verdant} hills stretched all the way to the coast.
e.zh: 翠绿的山峦一直延伸到海岸边。

e.en: After the rains, the valley turned lush and {verdant}.
e.zh: 雨季过后,山谷变得郁郁葱葱。

verde.t: adj. 绿色的（多用于地名）

e.en: The kitchen counters are made of polished {verde} marble.
e.zh: 厨房的台面是用抛光的绿色大理石做的。

e.en: She ordered tacos with extra salsa {verde} on the side.
e.zh: 她点了塔可,另加了一份青莎莎酱。

verderer.t: n. 王家森林的司法官

e.en: The {verderer} patrolled the royal forest for poachers.
e.zh: 那位皇家林务官在森林里巡查偷猎者。

e.en: Historically, a {verderer} enforced laws protecting the woodlands.
e.zh: 历史上,林务官负责执行保护林地的法律。

e.en: The jury reached a {verdict} after three days of deliberation.
e.zh: 陪审团经过三天审议后作出了裁决。

e.en: Critics' {verdict} on the new film was overwhelmingly positive.
e.zh: 影评人对这部新片的评价压倒性地正面。

e.en: Several {verdicts} were overturned on appeal last year.
e.zh: 去年有几项判决在上诉后被推翻了。

e.en: User reviews give mixed {verdicts} on the new phone.
e.zh: 用户评论对这款新手机的评价褒贬不一。

e.en: The copper roof had turned a soft green with {verdigris}.
e.zh: 铜质屋顶因铜绿覆盖而变成柔和的绿色。

e.en: Old bronze statues often develop a layer of {verdigris}.
e.zh: 古老的青铜雕像上常常会形成一层铜绿。

e.en: The Battle of {Verdun} was one of WWI's deadliest clashes.
e.zh: 凡尔登战役是第一次世界大战中最惨烈的战役之一。

e.en: Tourists visit {Verdun} to learn about French wartime history.
e.zh: 游客前往凡尔登了解法国的战争历史。

e.en: Spring brought fresh {verdure} to the rolling hills.
e.zh: 春天给连绵的山丘带来了一片新绿。

e.en: The garden's lush {verdure} attracted many butterflies.
e.zh: 花园里葱郁的绿意吸引了许多蝴蝶。

verge.t:
n. 边缘；濒临
v. 接近；濒于

e.en: The company is on the {verge} of launching a new product.
e.zh: 该公司即将推出一款新产品。

e.en: She was on the {verge} of tears during the goodbye speech.
e.zh: 在告别演讲时她几乎要落泪了。

verger.t: n. 教堂司事；持杖仪仗官

e.en: The {verger} quietly opened the cathedral doors before mass.
e.zh: 教堂司事在弥撒前悄悄打开了大教堂的门。

e.en: A friendly {verger} showed visitors around the old church.
e.zh: 一位和善的教堂管事带游客参观了这座老教堂。

e.en: Wikipedia values {verifiability} above personal opinion.
e.zh: 维基百科把可验证性看得比个人观点更重要。

e.en: Scientific claims must meet a high standard of {verifiability}.
e.zh: 科学论断必须达到很高的可验证性标准。

verifiable.t: adj. 可核实的；可验证的

e.en: Please support your claim with {verifiable} sources.
e.zh: 请用可核实的来源支持你的说法。

e.en: The blockchain creates a {verifiable} record of every transaction.
e.zh: 区块链为每一笔交易创建了可验证的记录。

verifiably.t: adv. 可核实地；经得起验证地

e.en: The new chip is {verifiably} faster than its predecessor.
e.zh: 这款新芯片确实可以验证比上一代更快。

e.en: His statement was {verifiably} false based on flight records.
e.zh: 根据航班记录,他的说法可以证实是假的。

e.en: You'll receive a {verification} code by text message.
e.zh: 你会通过短信收到一个验证码。

e.en: The bank requires document {verification} before opening accounts.
e.zh: 银行在开户前要求进行证件核验。

verified.t:
adj. 已核实的
v. 验证（过去式）

e.en: Her account got a {verified} badge after the application review.
e.zh: 她的账号在申请审核后获得了认证标志。

e.en: The lab {verified} the test results before publishing them.
e.zh: 实验室在公布测试结果前进行了核实。

e.en: An independent {verifier} checked the election results.
e.zh: 一位独立的验证员核查了选举结果。

e.en: The app uses a fingerprint {verifier} for secure logins.
e.zh: 这款应用使用指纹验证器来保障登录安全。

verifies.t: v. 验证；核实（第三人称单数）

e.en: The system {verifies} your identity before granting access.
e.zh: 系统会先验证你的身份再授予访问权限。

e.en: A second editor {verifies} every fact in the article.
e.zh: 另一位编辑会核实文章中的每一个事实。

e.en: Please {verify} your email address to activate the account.
e.zh: 请验证你的邮箱地址以激活账户。

e.en: It's hard to {verify} claims made on anonymous forums.
e.zh: 匿名论坛上的说法很难加以核实。

verifying.t: v. 验证中（verify 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is still {verifying} the data before publication.
e.zh: 团队仍在核实数据后再发布。

e.en: {Verifying} sources is a basic skill in journalism.
e.zh: 核实信息来源是新闻业的一项基本功。

e.en: {Verily}, this is the finest meal I've had all year.
e.zh: 说真的,这是我今年吃过最棒的一餐。

e.en: The old preacher began, "{Verily}, I say unto you..."
e.zh: 那位老牧师开口道:"我实在告诉你们……"

verisimilar.t: adj. 貌似真实的；逼真的

e.en: The novel's dialogue feels {verisimilar} and emotionally honest.
e.zh: 这本小说的对白读起来逼真而真挚。

e.en: Good historical films aim for {verisimilar} costumes and settings.
e.zh: 优秀的历史片力求服装与场景都逼真可信。

e.en: The film's {verisimilitude} comes from real wartime footage.
e.zh: 这部电影的真实感来自于真实的战时影像。

e.en: Detailed research gives the novel its remarkable {verisimilitude}.
e.zh: 细致的考证赋予了这部小说惊人的真实感。

e.en: Different genres rely on different {verisimilitudes} to feel real.
e.zh: 不同类型的作品依靠不同的真实感来令人信服。

e.en: Critics debated the various {verisimilitudes} in modern fiction.
e.zh: 评论家们讨论了当代小说中各种各样的逼真感。

veritable.t: adj. 名副其实的；十足的

e.en: The buffet was a {veritable} feast of local dishes.
e.zh: 那个自助餐简直就是一场地方菜的盛宴。

e.en: His garage is a {veritable} museum of vintage cars.
e.zh: 他的车库简直就是一座古董车博物馆。

e.en: The market was {veritably} bursting with fresh produce.
e.zh: 市场上简直堆满了新鲜的农产品。

e.en: She is {veritably} the best coder on our team.
e.zh: 她确实是我们团队里最优秀的程序员。

e.en: Few people questioned the {verity} of his testimony.
e.zh: 很少有人质疑他证词的真实性。

e.en: Friendship's value is a timeless {verity}.
e.zh: 友谊的价值是一个永恒的真理。

vermeil.t: n. 镀金的银器；朱红色

e.en: She wore a delicate {vermeil} bracelet to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一只精致的鎏金银手链出席了晚会。

e.en: The antique spoons were made of pure {vermeil}.
e.zh: 那些古董勺子是用纯鎏金银制成的。

vermicelli.t: n. 意大利细面条；粉丝

e.en: She tossed the {vermicelli} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 她把细面条和大蒜橄榄油拌在一起。

e.en: The dessert was topped with chocolate {vermicelli} sprinkles.
e.zh: 甜点上撒满了巧克力细丝糖针。

e.en: Mix {vermiculite} into the soil to improve drainage.
e.zh: 把蛭石拌进土里以改善排水。

e.en: The attic was insulated with old {vermiculite}.
e.zh: 阁楼用旧蛭石做了保温层。

vermilion.t:
n. 朱红色
adj. 朱红色的

e.en: She painted her lips a bright {vermilion}.
e.zh: 她把嘴唇涂成鲜艳的朱红色。

e.en: The temple gates were lacquered in deep {vermilion}.
e.zh: 庙门漆成了深朱红色。

e.en: The old barn was overrun with {vermin}.
e.zh: 那座旧谷仓里害虫成灾。

e.en: He treated the trespassers like common {vermin}.
e.zh: 他把那些闯入者当成下等害虫一样看待。

verminous.t: adj. 害虫滋生的；肮脏的

e.en: The abandoned house was damp and {verminous}.
e.zh: 那座废弃的房子又潮湿又满是害虫。

e.en: Inspectors condemned the {verminous} kitchen immediately.
e.zh: 检查员立刻查封了那间满是害虫的厨房。

vermins.t: n. 害虫（vermin 的复数，罕用）

e.en: Local farmers complained about the {vermins} ruining their crops.
e.zh: 当地农民抱怨这些害虫毁掉了庄稼。

e.en: Traps were set to catch the {vermins} in the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里布设了陷阱来抓那些害虫。

e.en: We drove up to {Vermont} to see the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 我们开车去佛蒙特州看秋叶。

e.en: {Vermont} is famous for its maple syrup.
e.zh: 佛蒙特州以枫糖浆闻名。

e.en: A classic martini needs gin and dry {vermouth}.
e.zh: 经典马提尼少不了金酒和干味美思。

e.en: She poured a splash of sweet {vermouth} over ice.
e.zh: 她在冰块上倒了一点甜味美思。

vernacular.t:
n. 方言；本地话
adj. 本地的

e.en: The novel captures the {vernacular} of 1920s New York.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉了1920年代纽约的本地口语。

e.en: Modern memes have their own internet {vernacular}.
e.zh: 现代表情包有自己的网络白话。

e.en: The {vernal} equinox marks the start of spring.
e.zh: 春分标志着春天的开始。

e.en: Cherry trees burst into {vernal} bloom along the river.
e.zh: 沿河的樱花树绽放出春日的花朵。

e.en: Engineers use a {vernier} caliper for precise measurements.
e.zh: 工程师用游标卡尺进行精密测量。

e.en: The {vernier} scale lets you read tenths of a millimeter.
e.zh: 游标刻度让你能读到十分之一毫米。

e.en: He grilled {venison} steaks over an open campfire.
e.zh: 他在篝火上烤了几块鹿肉牛排。

e.en: The restaurant serves a rich {venison} stew in winter.
e.zh: 这家餐厅冬天供应一道浓郁的炖鹿肉。

venn.t: n. 维恩（图）（Venn diagram 中的人名）

e.en: Draw a {Venn} diagram to compare the two product features.
e.zh: 画一个韦恩图来比较这两个产品的功能。

e.en: The slide used a {Venn} diagram to show overlapping users.
e.zh: 幻灯片用韦恩图展示了重叠的用户群。

venom.t:
n. 毒液
n. 恶意、怨毒

e.en: The snake's {venom} can kill a small animal in minutes.
e.zh: 这种蛇的毒液能在几分钟内杀死小型动物。

e.en: She replied with surprising {venom} to the harmless joke.
e.zh: 她对那个无伤大雅的玩笑回应得异常刻薄。

venomous.t:
adj. 有毒的（蛇、蝎等）
adj. 恶毒的

e.en: Australia is home to many {venomous} spiders and snakes.
e.zh: 澳大利亚是许多毒蜘蛛和毒蛇的家园。

e.en: His {venomous} comments on Twitter cost him the sponsorship.
e.zh: 他在推特上的恶毒评论让他失去了赞助。

e.en: She glared {venomously} at the colleague who interrupted her.
e.zh: 她恶狠狠地瞪着那个打断她的同事。

e.en: The critic wrote {venomously} about the new streaming series.
e.zh: 那位评论家对这部新剧集进行了恶毒抨击。

e.en: Poor {venous} circulation can cause swelling in the legs.
e.zh: 静脉循环不良可能导致腿部肿胀。

e.en: The nurse drew a sample of {venous} blood from his arm.
e.zh: 护士从他的手臂抽取了一份静脉血样本。

vent.t:
n. 通风口、出气口
v. 发泄（情绪）

e.en: She called her best friend to {vent} about work.
e.zh: 她打电话给闺蜜倾诉工作上的烦恼。

e.en: Hot air escaped through a small {vent} in the ceiling.
e.zh: 热空气从天花板上的一个小通风口逸出。

vented.t:
v. 发泄了（vent 过去式）
adj. 带通风口的

e.en: He {vented} his frustration on a punching bag at the gym.
e.zh: 他在健身房用沙袋发泄了自己的挫败感。

e.en: The dryer is properly {vented} to the outside wall.
e.zh: 烘干机的排气管已正确连接到外墙。

e.en: Open the windows to {ventilate} the kitchen after frying.
e.zh: 煎炸食物后打开窗户给厨房通风。

e.en: Doctors had to {ventilate} the patient during surgery.
e.zh: 手术中医生不得不为病人使用呼吸机。

ventilated.t:
adj. 通风的
v. 已通风

e.en: The basement is poorly {ventilated} and smells damp.
e.zh: 地下室通风很差,有一股潮湿味。

e.en: Critically ill patients are often mechanically {ventilated}.
e.zh: 重症病人常常需要机械通气。

ventilates.t: v. 使通风（第三人称单数）

e.en: This fan {ventilates} the entire workshop in minutes.
e.zh: 这台风扇几分钟就能让整个车间通风。

e.en: The new HVAC system {ventilates} every floor evenly.
e.zh: 新的暖通空调系统能让每层楼均匀通风。

e.en: We're {ventilating} the room before painting the walls.
e.zh: 我们在粉刷墙壁前先给房间通风。

e.en: The crew is {ventilating} the smoke-filled apartment now.
e.zh: 消防员正在给充满烟雾的公寓排烟。

e.en: Good {ventilation} reduces the risk of airborne illness indoors.
e.zh: 良好的通风能降低室内空气传播疾病的风险。

e.en: The tunnel needs better {ventilation} during rush hour.
e.zh: 这条隧道在高峰时段需要更好的通风。

e.en: Different mine shafts require different {ventilations} for safety.
e.zh: 不同的矿井为安全起见需要不同的通风方案。

e.en: The engineer compared two {ventilations} in his report.
e.zh: 工程师在报告中比较了两种通风方式。

ventilator.t:
n. 呼吸机
n. 通风设备

e.en: She spent two weeks on a {ventilator} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后她在呼吸机上度过了两周。

e.en: Hospitals ran short of {ventilator} units during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间医院的呼吸机一度短缺。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {ventilatory} failure overnight.
e.zh: 病人夜间出现了通气衰竭的症状。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {ventilatory} rate throughout the night.
e.zh: 医生整夜监测他的通气频率。

venting.t:
v. 发泄（情绪）
n. 通风

e.en: He's just {venting} — don't take his words too seriously.
e.zh: 他只是在发泄,别太把他的话当真。

e.en: Proper {venting} prevents moisture from damaging the attic.
e.zh: 良好的排气能防止潮气损坏阁楼。

e.en: The shark has a pale {ventral} surface for camouflage.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的腹部呈浅色,起到伪装作用。

e.en: Surgeons made a small incision on the {ventral} side.
e.zh: 外科医生在腹侧切开了一个小口。

ventricle.t:
n. 心室
n. 脑室

e.en: The left {ventricle} pumps blood to the rest of the body.
e.zh: 左心室将血液泵送到全身各处。

e.en: An enlarged {ventricle} can be a sign of heart disease.
e.zh: 心室增大可能是心脏病的征兆。

e.en: The ECG showed signs of a {ventricular} arrhythmia.
e.zh: 心电图显示出室性心律失常的迹象。

e.en: She was diagnosed with mild {ventricular} hypertrophy.
e.zh: 她被诊断出轻度心室肥大。

e.en: He learned {ventriloquism} from YouTube tutorials during lockdown.
e.zh: 他在封城期间通过YouTube教程学习了腹语术。

e.en: {Ventriloquism} requires keeping your lips almost completely still.
e.zh: 腹语术要求嘴唇几乎完全不动。

e.en: The {ventriloquist} performed with a wooden puppet on her knee.
e.zh: 那位腹语师膝上放着木偶进行表演。

e.en: A famous {ventriloquist} won the talent show last year.
e.zh: 一位著名的腹语师去年赢得了选秀节目。

e.en: We drove up the coast to {Ventura} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸开车到文图拉度过周末。

e.en: {Ventura} County has some of California's best surfing spots.
e.zh: 文图拉县拥有加州一些最好的冲浪地点。

venture.t:
n. 冒险事业、风险投资
v. 冒险去做

e.en: His latest startup is a risky but exciting {venture}.
e.zh: 他最新的创业项目虽有风险却令人兴奋。

e.en: Few hikers {venture} this far into the canyon alone.
e.zh: 很少有徒步者敢独自深入到峡谷这么远。

ventured.t: v. 冒险（过去式）、斗胆说

e.en: She {ventured} into the crypto market last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天涉足了加密货币市场。

e.en: Nobody {ventured} an answer to the awkward question.
e.zh: 没有人敢冒险回答那个尴尬的问题。

e.en: The young {venturer} started three companies before turning thirty.
e.zh: 这位年轻的创业者在三十岁前创办了三家公司。

e.en: Every successful {venturer} has a story full of failures.
e.zh: 每个成功的创业者背后都有充满失败的故事。

ventures.t:
n. 风险企业（复数）
v. 冒险（单三）

e.en: The fund invests in early-stage tech {ventures} across Asia.
e.zh: 该基金投资于亚洲各地的早期科技创业项目。

e.en: He rarely {ventures} outside his comfort zone at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中很少走出自己的舒适区。

venturesome.t: adj. 敢于冒险的、大胆的

e.en: Only the most {venturesome} hikers attempt that trail.
e.zh: 只有最勇于冒险的徒步者才会尝试那条小径。

e.en: She has a {venturesome} spirit and loves trying new things.
e.zh: 她有冒险精神,喜欢尝试新鲜事物。

venturi.t: n. 文丘里管（流体测量装置）

e.en: The {venturi} tube measures fluid flow in the pipeline.
e.zh: 文丘里管用来测量管道中的流体流量。

e.en: Engineers added a {venturi} to improve the engine's efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师加装了文丘里管以提高发动机效率。

e.en: She's {venturing} into the world of online business.
e.zh: 她正涉足在线商业领域。

e.en: The cubs were cautiously {venturing} out of the den.
e.zh: 幼崽们小心翼翼地走出洞穴。

e.en: The {venturous} traveler hiked alone through the Himalayas.
e.zh: 那位喜欢冒险的旅行者独自徒步穿越喜马拉雅山。

e.en: Startups need a {venturous} spirit to survive early failures.
e.zh: 创业公司需要敢于冒险的精神才能熬过早期挫折。

e.en: The concert {venue} holds about ten thousand people.
e.zh: 这个演唱会场地大约能容纳一万人。

e.en: They changed the wedding {venue} to a beachside resort.
e.zh: 他们把婚礼场地改到了一家海边度假村。

e.en: The festival uses five {venues} across downtown.
e.zh: 这个节日在市中心使用了五个场馆。

e.en: Streaming platforms have become major {venues} for new music.
e.zh: 流媒体平台已成为新音乐的重要发布渠道。

venus.t:
n. 金星
n. 维纳斯（爱神）

e.en: {Venus} appears as the brightest star in the evening sky.
e.zh: 金星在夜空中看起来是最亮的星。

e.en: Scientists are still studying the thick clouds of {Venus}.
e.zh: 科学家们仍在研究金星浓厚的云层。

venusian.t:
adj. 金星的
n. 金星人

e.en: The probe survived briefly in the {Venusian} atmosphere.
e.zh: 探测器在金星大气中只短暂存活了一会儿。

e.en: Old sci-fi novels often imagined {Venusian} jungles full of life.
e.zh: 老科幻小说常常想象金星上长满生命的丛林。

e.en: The witness gave a {veracious} account of the accident.
e.zh: 那位目击者对事故作出了真实的陈述。

e.en: Readers trust her because her reporting is consistently {veracious}.
e.zh: 读者信任她,因为她的报道一贯真实可靠。

e.en: Editors checked the {veracity} of every claim in the article.
e.zh: 编辑核实了文章中每一项说法的真实性。

e.en: Doubts were raised about the {veracity} of the leaked emails.
e.zh: 人们对那些泄露邮件的真实性提出了质疑。

e.en: We had breakfast on the shaded {veranda} every morning.
e.zh: 我们每天早晨都在阴凉的走廊上吃早餐。

e.en: A cat slept lazily on the wooden {veranda}.
e.zh: 一只猫懒洋洋地睡在木制走廊上。

verandah.t: n. 走廊、阳台（veranda 变体）

e.en: The old colonial house has a wide wraparound {verandah}.
e.zh: 这座殖民时期的老房子有一圈宽阔的走廊。

e.en: Guests gathered on the {verandah} to watch the sunset.
e.zh: 客人们聚在走廊上观赏日落。

e.en: Many tropical homes feature deep {verandahs} for shade.
e.zh: 许多热带住宅都有深深的走廊用来遮阳。

e.en: The hotel's {verandahs} overlook the rice terraces below.
e.zh: 酒店的走廊俯瞰着下方的梯田。

e.en: In English, every complete sentence needs a {verb}.
e.zh: 在英语中,每个完整句子都需要一个动词。

e.en: "Run" is a {verb} that describes an action.
e.zh: "Run"是一个表示动作的动词。

verbal.t:
adj. 口头的、言语的
adj. 动词的

e.en: We had a {verbal} agreement before signing the contract.
e.zh: 我们在签合同之前有过口头协议。

e.en: The job interview tested her {verbal} reasoning skills.
e.zh: 那次面试考察了她的语言推理能力。

verbalise.t: v. 用言语表达（英式拼写）

e.en: Children sometimes struggle to {verbalise} their feelings.
e.zh: 小孩有时很难用语言表达自己的感受。

e.en: Try to {verbalise} your concerns instead of bottling them up.
e.zh: 试着把担忧说出来,而不是憋在心里。

e.en: Therapy encourages the {verbalization} of buried emotions.
e.zh: 心理治疗鼓励把压抑的情绪用语言表达出来。

e.en: His {verbalization} of the plan helped the team understand it.
e.zh: 他把计划讲出来,帮助团队理解了它。

e.en: It's hard to {verbalize} exactly why the design feels wrong.
e.zh: 很难准确说出这个设计为什么让人觉得不对。

e.en: Good leaders {verbalize} their vision clearly to the team.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会向团队清晰地表达自己的愿景。

verbalized.t: v. 用言语表达了（过去式）

e.en: She finally {verbalized} the doubts she'd kept inside.
e.zh: 她终于把一直憋在心里的疑虑说了出来。

e.en: He never {verbalized} his gratitude, but everyone felt it.
e.zh: 他从没把感激说出口,但每个人都感受到了。

e.en: The offer was confirmed {verbally} over the phone.
e.zh: 这个录用通知是通过电话口头确认的。

e.en: Some people express ideas better {verbally} than in writing.
e.zh: 有些人用口语表达想法比写作更顺畅。

verbatim.t:
adv. 逐字地
adj. 逐字的

e.en: The reporter quoted the speech {verbatim} in her article.
e.zh: 那位记者在文章中一字不差地引用了那段演讲。

e.en: Don't copy the textbook {verbatim} — use your own words.
e.zh: 不要逐字照抄课本——用自己的话来表达。

veiling.t:
n. 面纱料；遮蔽
v. 掩盖（veil 的现在分词）

e.en: Heavy clouds were {veiling} the moon all night.
e.zh: 厚重的云层整夜遮蔽着月亮。

e.en: She bought delicate {veiling} for her wedding hat.
e.zh: 她为婚礼帽买了精致的薄纱。

vein.t:
n. 静脉；纹理
n. 矿脉

e.en: The nurse found a {vein} on the first try.
e.zh: 护士一下子就找到了血管。

e.en: Miners discovered a rich {vein} of silver underground.
e.zh: 矿工在地下发现了一条富银矿脉。

veined.t: adj. 有纹理的；有脉络的

e.en: The countertop is made of beautifully {veined} marble.
e.zh: 台面是用纹理优美的大理石做的。

e.en: She admired the delicately {veined} autumn leaves.
e.zh: 她欣赏着叶脉细致的秋叶。

e.en: The marble's gold {veining} caught the afternoon light.
e.zh: 大理石的金色纹路在午后光线中熠熠生辉。

e.en: Notice the fine {veining} on each leaf surface.
e.zh: 注意每片叶子表面细密的脉络。

e.en: Blood flows through the {veins} back to the heart.
e.zh: 血液经由静脉流回心脏。

e.en: You can see the {veins} on the back of his hand.
e.zh: 你能看到他手背上的血管。

veiny.t: adj. 青筋凸起的；多纹理的

e.en: The bodybuilder showed off his {veiny} arms.
e.zh: 那位健美运动员展示着他青筋暴起的手臂。

e.en: Her hands looked {veiny} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步后她的双手青筋显露。

e.en: The kids' shoes close with {velcro} instead of laces.
e.zh: 孩子们的鞋子用魔术贴而不是鞋带。

e.en: My jacket has a {velcro} strap at the wrist.
e.zh: 我的夹克手腕处有一条魔术贴。

e.en: Lions roamed freely across the South African {veld}.
e.zh: 狮子在南非的草原上自由游荡。

e.en: The open {veld} stretched to the distant horizon.
e.zh: 开阔的草原延伸到远方的地平线。

veldt.t: n. 南非草原（veld 的异体）

e.en: Zebras grazed peacefully on the sunlit {veldt}.
e.zh: 斑马在阳光普照的草原上安静地吃草。

e.en: They drove across the {veldt} for hours without seeing anyone.
e.zh: 他们开车穿越草原数小时,没遇到任何人。

e.en: Medieval monks copied scripture onto fine {vellum}.
e.zh: 中世纪僧侣将经文抄写在优质的羊皮纸上。

e.en: The invitations were printed on cream-colored {vellum}.
e.zh: 请柬印在奶白色的仿羊皮纸上。

e.en: The {velociraptor} was much smaller than movies suggest.
e.zh: 伶盗龙比电影里展示的要小得多。

e.en: Paleontologists unearthed a {velociraptor} skeleton in Mongolia.
e.zh: 古生物学家在蒙古挖掘出一具伶盗龙骨架。

e.en: The car reached a {velocity} of 200 kilometers per hour.
e.zh: 这辆车的速度达到了每小时两百公里。

e.en: Information now spreads with incredible {velocity} online.
e.zh: 如今信息在网上以惊人的速度传播。

velodrome.t: n. 室内自行车赛车场

e.en: The Olympic cyclists trained at the new indoor {velodrome}.
e.zh: 奥运自行车选手在新建的室内自行车赛车场训练。

e.en: Spectators packed the {velodrome} for the championship race.
e.zh: 观众挤满了自行车赛车场观看冠军赛。

e.en: She wore a soft pink {velour} tracksuit.
e.zh: 她穿着一套柔软的粉色丝绒运动套装。

e.en: The seats were upholstered in deep blue {velour}.
e.zh: 座椅用深蓝色丝绒包裹着。

velvet.t:
n. 天鹅绒；丝绒
adj. 柔软光滑的

e.en: She wore a stunning red {velvet} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件惊艳的红色天鹅绒礼服出席晚会。

e.en: The jewelry box was lined with black {velvet}.
e.zh: 珠宝盒内衬是黑色天鹅绒。

e.en: The child clutched her old {velveteen} rabbit tightly.
e.zh: 小女孩紧紧抱着她那只旧的棉绒兔子。

e.en: He wore a vintage {velveteen} jacket to the party.
e.zh: 他穿着一件复古棉绒夹克去派对。

velvety.t: adj. 像天鹅绒般柔滑的

e.en: The chocolate cake had a rich, {velvety} texture.
e.zh: 巧克力蛋糕有着浓郁丝滑的口感。

e.en: Her singing voice is warm and {velvety}.
e.zh: 她的歌声温暖而柔润。

ven.t: n. 静脉（vena 的缩写/词根）

vena.t: n. 静脉（拉丁语医学术语）

e.en: The {vena} cava returns blood to the heart.
e.zh: 腔静脉将血液送回心脏。

e.en: Surgeons carefully avoided cutting the {vena} cava.
e.zh: 外科医生小心避免切到腔静脉。

venal.t: adj. 贪赃的；唯利是图的

e.en: The {venal} judge accepted bribes from both sides.
e.zh: 那位贪赃枉法的法官从双方都收受贿赂。

e.en: Voters were tired of the city's {venal} politicians.
e.zh: 选民们厌倦了这座城市贪腐的政客。

venality.t: n. 贪污受贿；唯利是图

e.en: The journalist exposed the {venality} of local officials.
e.zh: 那位记者揭露了当地官员的贪腐行径。

e.en: Widespread {venality} undermined trust in the government.
e.zh: 普遍的贪腐削弱了民众对政府的信任。

vend.t: v. 贩卖；出售（尤指小商品）

e.en: Local farmers {vend} fresh produce at the weekend market.
e.zh: 当地农民周末在集市上贩卖新鲜农产品。

e.en: The company is licensed to {vend} snacks in the stadium.
e.zh: 该公司获准在体育场内售卖零食。

e.en: A street {vender} was selling roasted chestnuts on the corner.
e.zh: 街角有个小贩在卖烤栗子。

e.en: The hot dog {vender} closed up shop at sunset.
e.zh: 卖热狗的小贩日落时收摊了。

e.en: He pursued a personal {vendetta} against his old boss.
e.zh: 他对老上司展开了一场私人复仇。

e.en: The two families have carried on a {vendetta} for generations.
e.zh: 两个家族世代之间存在着血仇。

vending.t:
n. 售卖；自动售货
v. 贩卖（vend 的现在分词）

e.en: I bought a soda from the {vending} machine downstairs.
e.zh: 我在楼下的自动售货机买了一瓶汽水。

e.en: Street {vending} is tightly regulated in this city.
e.zh: 这座城市对街头摆摊管控得很严。

vendor.t:
n. 供应商；卖家
n. 小贩

e.en: We chose a cloud {vendor} after weeks of evaluation.
e.zh: 我们经过几周评估后选定了一家云服务供应商。

e.en: A street {vendor} sold roasted chestnuts on the corner.
e.zh: 街角有个小贩在卖炒栗子。

veneer.t:
n. 饰面薄板；表面假象
v. 贴面

e.en: The desk has an oak {veneer} over cheap plywood.
e.zh: 这张桌子表面贴的是橡木薄板,里面是便宜胶合板。

e.en: His politeness was just a thin {veneer}.
e.zh: 他的礼貌只是一层薄薄的伪装。

veneered.t:
adj. 贴了饰面的
v. 贴面（过去式）

e.en: The cabinet is {veneered} with rich walnut.
e.zh: 这个柜子表面贴有华丽的胡桃木薄皮。

e.en: His tough manner was {veneered} with charming smiles.
e.zh: 他强硬的作风外面包着一层迷人的微笑。

venerable.t: adj. 德高望重的；令人敬仰的

e.en: The {venerable} professor still lectures at the university every Monday.
e.zh: 那位德高望重的教授每周一仍在大学讲课。

e.en: This {venerable} bookstore has stood on the corner for 150 years.
e.zh: 这家有着悠久历史的书店在街角矗立了150年。

e.en: Many fans {venerate} the director as a true artistic genius.
e.zh: 许多粉丝把这位导演敬奉为真正的艺术天才。

e.en: Local communities {venerate} the ancient tree as a sacred symbol.
e.zh: 当地社区将这棵古树尊崇为神圣的象征。

venerated.t:
v. 受到敬仰（过去式）
adj. 被崇敬的

e.en: Bruce Lee is {venerated} by martial artists around the world.
e.zh: 李小龙受到世界各地武术家的敬仰。

e.en: The {venerated} chef trained three generations of cooks.
e.zh: 这位备受尊敬的大厨培养了三代厨师。

venerates.t: v. 尊敬；崇敬（第三人称单数）

e.en: The startup {venerates} its founder almost like a guru.
e.zh: 这家初创公司几乎把创始人奉为导师般敬重。

e.en: She {venerates} her grandmother's handwritten recipe book.
e.zh: 她非常珍视奶奶手写的食谱本。

venerating.t: v. 尊敬；崇拜（现在分词）

e.en: Fans were {venerating} the late musician with candles outside the venue.
e.zh: 歌迷们在场馆外点起蜡烛缅怀这位已故音乐人。

e.en: The documentary keeps {venerating} the company's founder a bit too much.
e.zh: 这部纪录片对公司创始人的赞颂稍显过度。

e.en: His new book treats Steve Jobs with near-religious {veneration}.
e.zh: 他的新书对乔布斯几乎抱有近乎宗教般的崇敬。

e.en: In Japan, cherry blossoms inspire deep cultural {veneration}.
e.zh: 在日本,樱花引发着深厚的文化敬意。

e.en: The temple hosts seasonal {venerations} honoring local ancestors.
e.zh: 这座寺庙举办季节性的祭祀活动以缅怀先祖。

e.en: Different cultures express their {venerations} through unique rituals.
e.zh: 不同文化通过独特的仪式表达各自的敬奉。

e.en: The clinic offers free testing for common {venereal} diseases.
e.zh: 该诊所提供常见性病的免费检测。

e.en: Doctors used to call these infections {venereal} rather than STIs.
e.zh: 医生过去把这些感染称为花柳病,而不是性传播感染。

venetian.t:
adj. 威尼斯的
n. 威尼斯人

e.en: She bought a beautiful {Venetian} glass vase on her trip.
e.zh: 她在旅行中买了一只漂亮的威尼斯玻璃花瓶。

e.en: The hotel installed wooden {Venetian} blinds in every room.
e.zh: 酒店在每个房间都安装了木制百叶窗。

veneto.t: n. 威尼托（意大利大区）

e.en: The {Veneto} region produces some of Italy's finest white wines.
e.zh: 威尼托大区出产意大利一些最优质的白葡萄酒。

e.en: We rented a quiet farmhouse in {Veneto} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在威尼托租了一间安静的农舍。

venezia.t: n. 威尼斯（意大利语名）

e.en: Our train arrived at {Venezia} Santa Lucia just before sunset.
e.zh: 我们的火车在日落前抵达了威尼斯圣露西亚站。

e.en: Tourists crowd {Venezia} every summer despite the rising water.
e.zh: 尽管水位上涨,每年夏天威尼斯仍挤满了游客。

e.en: {Venezuela} holds some of the world's largest oil reserves.
e.zh: 委内瑞拉拥有世界上最大的石油储量之一。

e.en: Many families have left {Venezuela} due to the economic crisis.
e.zh: 许多家庭因经济危机离开了委内瑞拉。

venezuelan.t:
adj. 委内瑞拉的
n. 委内瑞拉人

e.en: My neighbor cooks amazing {Venezuelan} arepas every weekend.
e.zh: 我邻居每个周末都做超棒的委内瑞拉玉米饼。

e.en: The {Venezuelan} baseball team made it to the finals.
e.zh: 委内瑞拉棒球队挺进了决赛。

e.en: He swore {vengeance} after his brother was betrayed.
e.zh: 哥哥被背叛后,他发誓要报仇。

e.en: Inflation came back with a {vengeance} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度通胀以更猛烈的势头卷土重来。

vengeful.t: adj. 复仇心切的；报复性的

e.en: The novel's villain is bitter, lonely, and deeply {vengeful}.
e.zh: 小说中的反派痛苦、孤独,且充满复仇欲。

e.en: Don't post anything {vengeful} online when you're still angry.
e.zh: 还在气头上时,别在网上发任何报复性言论。

e.en: He stared {vengefully} at the rival who had stolen his idea.
e.zh: 他充满怨恨地盯着那个偷走他点子的对手。

e.en: She replied {vengefully}, deleting every photo of him.
e.zh: 她带着报复心态回应,把他的每张照片都删除了。

e.en: Therapy helped her let go of years of {vengefulness}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她放下了多年的复仇心理。

e.en: The character's {vengefulness} drives the entire plot forward.
e.zh: 这个角色的复仇心推动了整个剧情的发展。

venial.t: adj. 可原谅的；轻微的（过错）

e.en: Forgetting his birthday was a {venial} mistake, easily forgiven.
e.zh: 忘记他的生日只是个小过失,很容易被原谅。

e.en: The audit found only {venial} errors in the accounts.
e.zh: 审计在账目中只发现了一些无关紧要的小错误。

venice.t: n. 威尼斯（意大利城市）

e.en: We took a gondola ride through the canals of {Venice}.
e.zh: 我们乘坐贡多拉游览了威尼斯的水道。

e.en: Rising sea levels are slowly threatening the city of {Venice}.
e.zh: 海平面上升正慢慢威胁着威尼斯这座城市。

verona.t: n. 维罗纳（意大利城市）

e.en: Romeo and Juliet is set in fair {Verona}.
e.zh: 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》的故事发生在美丽的维罗纳。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend exploring {Verona}.
e.zh: 我们在维罗纳度过了一个阳光明媚的周末。

veronese.t:
adj. 维罗纳的
n. 委罗内塞（画家）

e.en: The museum acquired a stunning {Veronese} altarpiece.
e.zh: 博物馆购入了一幅惊艳的委罗内塞祭坛画。

e.en: Critics praised the rich color palette of {Veronese}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞委罗内塞丰富的色彩。

veronica.t:
n. 维罗妮卡（女名）
n. 婆婆纳（植物）

e.en: The garden was carpeted with tiny blue {veronica}.
e.zh: 花园里铺满了小小的蓝色婆婆纳花。

e.en: The matador executed a graceful {veronica} with his cape.
e.zh: 斗牛士用披风做了一个优雅的横挥动作。

e.en: She wore a glittering {Versace} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她身穿一件闪亮的范思哲礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: {Versace} unveiled its new collection in Milan.
e.zh: 范思哲在米兰发布了新系列。

e.en: Tourists flock to the gilded halls of {Versailles}.
e.zh: 游客蜂拥前往凡尔赛宫金碧辉煌的大厅。

e.en: The treaty was signed at the Palace of {Versailles}.
e.zh: 条约是在凡尔赛宫签署的。

versatile.t: adj. 多才多艺的；用途广泛的

e.en: Olive oil is the most {versatile} ingredient in my kitchen.
e.zh: 橄榄油是我厨房里用途最广的食材。

e.en: She's a {versatile} actress comfortable in any genre.
e.zh: 她是一位戏路宽广的演员,什么类型都能驾驭。

versatilities.t: n. 多才多艺；多功能（复数）

e.en: The book explores the {versatilities} of bamboo across cultures.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了竹子在各种文化中的多种用途。

e.en: Reviewers praised the actor's many {versatilities} on stage.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这位演员在舞台上的多面才能。

e.en: The phone's {versatility} makes it perfect for work and play.
e.zh: 这款手机用途多样,工作娱乐两相宜。

e.en: Her {versatility} as a musician impressed the judges.
e.zh: 她作为音乐人的多才多艺打动了评委。

e.en: He wrote a short {verse} for his mother's birthday.
e.zh: 他为母亲的生日写了一首小诗。

e.en: The chorus is catchy, but the second {verse} drags.
e.zh: 副歌很抓耳,但第二段主歌有点拖沓。

e.en: She is well {versed} in machine learning techniques.
e.zh: 她对机器学习技术非常精通。

e.en: You should be {versed} in the basics before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前你应该熟练掌握基础知识。

e.en: The critic dismissed him as a mere {versemonger}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为一个不入流的打油诗匠。

e.en: Every café in town had its resident {versemonger}.
e.zh: 镇上每家咖啡馆都有自己的常驻劣等诗人。

e.en: She memorized several {verses} from the poem.
e.zh: 她背下了那首诗里的好几节。

e.en: The pastor read familiar {verses} from the Bible.
e.zh: 牧师朗读了几节熟悉的圣经经文。

e.en: The {versicolor} fungus has a beautiful banded pattern.
e.zh: 这种杂色真菌有着漂亮的环状花纹。

e.en: He treated a stubborn case of tinea {versicolor}.
e.zh: 他治疗了一例顽固的花斑癣。

e.en: The poet's {versification} follows strict iambic meter.
e.zh: 这位诗人的格律严格遵循抑扬格。

e.en: Students studied the {versification} of classical Chinese poetry.
e.zh: 学生们研究中国古典诗歌的格律。

e.en: He likes to {versify} small moments from daily life.
e.zh: 他喜欢把生活中的小片段写成诗。

e.en: It's hard to {versify} a complex political idea.
e.zh: 把一个复杂的政治理念写成诗并不容易。

versing.t: v. 作诗（verse 的现在分词）

e.en: The kids were {versing} each other in a rap battle.
e.zh: 孩子们正在一场说唱对决中互相较量。

e.en: Our team is {versing} the champions tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们队明天要对阵卫冕冠军。

e.en: Please update to the latest {version} of the app.
e.zh: 请更新到这个应用的最新版本。

e.en: His {version} of the story differs from hers.
e.zh: 他对这件事的说法和她不一样。

e.en: The software supports older {versions} of Windows.
e.zh: 该软件支持较旧的Windows版本。

e.en: There are two {versions} of what happened that night.
e.zh: 那晚发生的事有两种说法。

e.en: The illustration appears on the {verso} of page 12.
e.zh: 插图出现在第12页的背面。

e.en: Footnotes are printed on the {verso} of each leaf.
e.zh: 脚注印在每一页的反面。

e.en: Tonight's game is the Lakers {versus} the Celtics.
e.zh: 今晚的比赛是湖人对凯尔特人。

e.en: It's a debate of quality {versus} quantity.
e.zh: 这是一场质量与数量的辩论。

vert.t:
n. 绿色（纹章）
v. 转向（俚）

e.en: The skater dropped into the {vert} ramp fearlessly.
e.zh: 滑板手毫无畏惧地冲下垂直坡道。

e.en: Heraldic shields often feature {vert} as a background.
e.zh: 纹章盾牌常以绿色作底色。

e.en: She fractured a {vertebra} in the skiing accident.
e.zh: 她在滑雪事故中摔裂了一节脊椎骨。

e.en: Each {vertebra} cushions the spine with a soft disc.
e.zh: 每节椎骨之间都有软盘缓冲脊柱。

e.en: The MRI revealed a {vertebral} disc problem.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示椎间盘有问题。

e.en: Yoga can ease pressure on the {vertebral} column.
e.zh: 瑜伽可以减轻脊柱的压力。

vertebrate.t:
n. 脊椎动物
adj. 有脊椎的

e.en: Fish were the earliest {vertebrate} animals on Earth.
e.zh: 鱼是地球上最早的脊椎动物。

e.en: Every {vertebrate} has a backbone made of bone or cartilage.
e.zh: 每种脊椎动物都有由骨头或软骨构成的脊柱。

e.en: Click the {vertex} to drag the triangle's corner.
e.zh: 点击顶点可以拖动三角形的角。

e.en: The graph algorithm visits each {vertex} once.
e.zh: 该图算法对每个顶点访问一次。

vertical.t:
adj. 垂直的
n. 垂直方向；垂类

e.en: The website looks better on a {vertical} screen.
e.zh: 这个网站在竖屏上看起来更好。

e.en: He drew a {vertical} line through the center.
e.zh: 他穿过中心画了一条垂直线。

e.en: The skyscraper's {verticality} dominates the skyline.
e.zh: 这座摩天楼的垂直感主宰了整片天际线。

e.en: The dancer's leap emphasized pure {verticality}.
e.zh: 舞者的跃起强调出纯粹的垂直感。

e.en: Stack the boxes {vertically} to save floor space.
e.zh: 把箱子竖着叠起来以节省地面空间。

e.en: Text in this column reads {vertically}, top to bottom.
e.zh: 这一栏的文字从上到下竖排阅读。

vertiginous.t: adj. 令人眩晕的；旋转的

e.en: The cliff offered a {vertiginous} view of the sea.
e.zh: 悬崖上望下去是令人头晕目眩的海景。

e.en: Crypto prices saw a {vertiginous} rise last year.
e.zh: 加密货币价格去年经历了一轮令人眩晕的飙升。

e.en: Looking down from the bridge gave her {vertigo}.
e.zh: 从桥上往下看让她头晕目眩。

e.en: He suffers from {vertigo} whenever he flies.
e.zh: 他每次坐飞机都会犯眩晕症。

e.en: The collector hunted rare objects of {vertu} in Paris.
e.zh: 那位收藏家在巴黎搜寻稀有的工艺珍玩。

e.en: Her shelves were lined with curios and {vertu}.
e.zh: 她的架子上摆满了古董和精致工艺品。

e.en: Herbalists brew {vervain} tea to ease anxiety.
e.zh: 草药师会泡马鞭草茶来缓解焦虑。

e.en: Bees love the small purple flowers of {vervain}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜欢马鞭草那些小小的紫色花朵。

e.en: She delivered the speech with style and {verve}.
e.zh: 她演讲得既有风格又充满激情。

e.en: The young chef cooks with remarkable {verve}.
e.zh: 这位年轻厨师做菜活力十足。

e.en: The two dancers brought contrasting {verves} to the stage.
e.zh: 两位舞者为舞台带来风格迥异的活力。

e.en: Critics noted the distinct {verves} of each performer.
e.zh: 评论家注意到每位表演者各自鲜明的活力。

e.en: A curious {vervet} monkey snatched fruit from the table.
e.zh: 一只好奇的长尾黑颚猴从桌上抢走了水果。

e.en: Researchers study how {vervet} monkeys warn each other.
e.zh: 研究人员研究长尾黑颚猴如何互相报警。

very.t:
adv. 非常
adj. 正是的，恰好的

e.en: The coffee here is {very} strong, just how I like it.
e.zh: 这里的咖啡很浓,正合我意。

e.en: That is the {very} book I was looking for.
e.zh: 这正是我要找的那本书。

e.en: Each {vesicle} carries proteins between parts of the cell.
e.zh: 每个囊泡在细胞各部分之间运送蛋白质。

e.en: A small {vesicle} formed on her lip after the sunburn.
e.zh: 她的嘴唇晒伤后起了一个小水泡。

e.en: The patient developed a {vesicular} rash overnight.
e.zh: 患者一夜之间起了水疱性皮疹。

e.en: Volcanic rocks often have a {vesicular} texture full of holes.
e.zh: 火山岩常常有布满小孔的多孔状结构。

e.en: The monks gathered for {vesper} prayers at sunset.
e.zh: 修士们在日落时聚集做晚祷。

e.en: A single {vesper} bell rang across the quiet valley.
e.zh: 一声晚祷的钟声响彻寂静的山谷。

e.en: The monks gathered at sunset for {vespers} in the chapel.
e.zh: 修士们在日落时聚集在小教堂做晚祷。

e.en: She loved the quiet music sung at {vespers}.
e.zh: 她喜欢晚祷时吟唱的宁静乐曲。

e.en: A cargo {vessel} entered the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 一艘货船在黎明时分驶入港口。

e.en: Pour the hot soup into a heatproof {vessel}.
e.zh: 把热汤倒入耐热的容器里。

e.en: Several fishing {vessels} were anchored near the coast.
e.zh: 几艘渔船停泊在海岸附近。

e.en: Tiny blood {vessels} burst when she rubbed her eyes.
e.zh: 她揉眼睛时一些细小的血管破裂了。

vest.t:
n. 背心；马甲
v. 授予（权利）

e.en: He wore a black {vest} over his white shirt.
e.zh: 他在白衬衫外面穿了一件黑色背心。

e.en: The officer's bulletproof {vest} saved his life.
e.zh: 那位警官的防弹背心救了他一命。

vesta.t: n. 维斯塔（罗马女神）；火柴

e.en: He struck a {vesta} to light his pipe.
e.zh: 他划了一根火柴点烟斗。

e.en: Old British shops once sold tins of {vesta} matches.
e.zh: 旧时英国商店曾经卖一盒盒的火柴。

vestal.t:
adj. 贞洁的
n. 贞女

e.en: The {vestal} priestesses tended the sacred fire in Rome.
e.zh: 贞女祭司们在罗马看守圣火。

e.en: She lived an almost {vestal} life devoted to study.
e.zh: 她过着几乎像贞女般专注于学习的生活。

e.en: Banks have a {vested} interest in keeping rates high.
e.zh: 银行在维持高利率方面有切身利益。

e.en: Her stock options finally {vested} after four years.
e.zh: 她的股票期权在四年后终于归属生效。

e.en: The {vestibular} system in your inner ear controls balance.
e.zh: 内耳的前庭系统负责控制平衡。

e.en: Doctors ran tests for a possible {vestibular} disorder.
e.zh: 医生做了检查以排查前庭功能紊乱。

e.en: Guests left their coats in the {vestibule}.
e.zh: 客人们把外套放在门厅里。

e.en: A small heater warmed the church {vestibule}.
e.zh: 一台小暖气让教堂的前厅暖和起来。

e.en: Not a {vestige} of the old castle remains today.
e.zh: 那座古老城堡如今没有留下一丝痕迹。

e.en: He showed no {vestige} of regret for his actions.
e.zh: 他对自己的行为没有流露出一丝悔意。

e.en: The appendix is a {vestigial} organ in humans.
e.zh: 阑尾是人类身上一个退化的器官。

e.en: Some snakes still have {vestigial} hip bones.
e.zh: 有些蛇仍然保留着退化的髋骨。

vestigially.t: adv. 作为残迹地；退化地

e.en: Whales still possess hind limbs, though only {vestigially}.
e.zh: 鲸鱼仍然有后肢,只是已退化残留。

e.en: The trait survives {vestigially} in modern breeds.
e.zh: 这一特征在现代品种中以退化形式残留。

vesting.t:
n. (股权、权益) 归属
v. 授予 (vest 的现在分词)

e.en: Most startups use a four-year {vesting} schedule.
e.zh: 大多数创业公司采用四年的股权归属计划。

e.en: Her shares finish {vesting} next March.
e.zh: 她的股份将在明年三月完成归属。

e.en: The priest wore a richly embroidered {vestment}.
e.zh: 神父穿着一件绣工精美的法衣。

e.en: Each {vestment} is folded carefully after the service.
e.zh: 礼拜结束后每一件法衣都被仔细地叠好。

vestry.t: n. 教堂祭衣室；教区会议

e.en: The choir changed into robes in the {vestry}.
e.zh: 唱诗班在更衣室里换上了长袍。

e.en: The church {vestry} met to discuss the budget.
e.zh: 教堂理事会开会讨论预算问题。

e.en: As a {vestryman}, he helped manage church finances.
e.zh: 作为教区委员,他协助管理教会的财务。

e.en: Each {vestryman} serves a three-year term.
e.zh: 每位教区委员任期三年。

vesture.t: n. 衣服；覆盖物（文学用语）

e.en: The statue wore a flowing {vesture} of white marble.
e.zh: 雕像身披白色大理石雕成的飘逸衣袍。

e.en: Autumn covered the hills in golden {vesture}.
e.zh: 秋天给山峦披上了金色的外衣。

vesuvius.t: n. 维苏威火山（意大利）

e.en: Mount {Vesuvius} buried Pompeii in 79 AD.
e.zh: 维苏威火山在公元79年掩埋了庞贝城。

e.en: Tourists hiked to the crater of {Vesuvius}.
e.zh: 游客们徒步登上了维苏威火山口。

vet.t:
n. 兽医；老兵
v. 审查、核查

vetch.t: n. 野豌豆（一种豆科植物）

e.en: Farmers plant {vetch} to enrich the soil with nitrogen.
e.zh: 农民种植野豌豆以增加土壤中的氮含量。

e.en: Wild {vetch} climbed along the garden fence.
e.zh: 野豌豆沿着花园的篱笆攀爬生长。

veteran.t:
n. 老兵；老手
adj. 经验丰富的

e.en: The {veteran} reporter has covered five elections.
e.zh: 这位资深记者已经报道过五次大选。

e.en: My grandfather is a {veteran} of the Korean War.
e.zh: 我祖父是一位朝鲜战争的老兵。

veterans.t: n. 老兵、退伍军人（复数）

e.en: Many {veterans} struggle with mental health after service.
e.zh: 许多退伍军人在服役后面临心理健康问题。

e.en: The parade honored {veterans} from three different wars.
e.zh: 游行向参加过三次战争的退伍军人致敬。

e.en: Our {veterinarian} said the puppy needs more exercise.
e.zh: 我们的兽医说这只小狗需要多运动。

e.en: She trained as a {veterinarian} specializing in horses.
e.zh: 她受训成为一名专门治疗马匹的兽医。

veterinary.t: adj. 兽医的；治疗动物的

e.en: He is studying {veterinary} medicine at Cornell.
e.zh: 他在康奈尔大学攻读兽医学。

e.en: The {veterinary} clinic opens early on weekdays.
e.zh: 这家兽医诊所工作日开门很早。

veto.t:
v. 否决
n. 否决权

e.en: The president threatened to {veto} the new bill.
e.zh: 总统威胁要否决这项新法案。

e.en: Mom has final {veto} power over weekend plans.
e.zh: 妈妈对周末的安排有最终否决权。

vets.t:
n. 兽医；老兵（复数）
v. 审查 (vet 的三单)

e.en: The agency carefully {vets} every job applicant.
e.zh: 该机构会仔细审查每一位求职者。

e.en: Local {vets} held a free clinic for stray cats.
e.zh: 当地兽医为流浪猫举办了免费义诊。

e.en: The hiring team is still {vetting} the final candidates.
e.zh: 招聘团队仍在审核最后几名候选人。

e.en: Background {vetting} can take several weeks to complete.
e.zh: 背景审查可能需要几周才能完成。

veuve.t: n. 寡妇（法语，多见于品牌名）

e.en: They opened a bottle of {Veuve} Clicquot to celebrate.
e.zh: 他们开了一瓶凯歌香槟来庆祝。

e.en: In French, '{veuve}' simply means widow.
e.zh: 在法语中,“veuve”就是寡妇的意思。

vexation.t: n. 烦恼；令人恼火的事

e.en: She sighed in {vexation} at yet another delay.
e.zh: 她对又一次延误感到恼火,叹了口气。

e.en: Slow internet is a constant source of {vexation}.
e.zh: 网速慢是持续不断的烦恼来源。

vexatious.t: adj. 烦人的；无理缠讼的

e.en: The judge dismissed the {vexatious} lawsuit immediately.
e.zh: 法官当即驳回了这宗无理缠讼。

e.en: Mosquitoes are particularly {vexatious} on summer evenings.
e.zh: 蚊子在夏天的傍晚特别恼人。

e.en: Climate policy remains a {vexed} political issue.
e.zh: 气候政策仍然是一个棘手的政治议题。

e.en: She looked {vexed} after reading the email.
e.zh: 看完那封邮件后她显得很烦恼。

vexing.t: adj. 令人烦恼的；棘手的

e.en: The bug is a particularly {vexing} one to reproduce.
e.zh: 这个bug特别难以复现,令人头疼。

e.en: Traffic noise at night can be quite {vexing}.
e.zh: 夜里的交通噪音可能相当恼人。

vga.t: n. 视频图形阵列（显示接口标准）

vhf.t: abbr. 甚高频（30–300 MHz 无线电）

vhs.t: n. VHS 家用录像带制式

via.t: prep. 经由；通过（某种方式）

e.en: The team questioned the {viability} of the business model.
e.zh: 团队对该商业模式的可行性提出了质疑。

e.en: Doctors assess the {viability} of the embryo carefully.
e.zh: 医生会仔细评估胚胎的存活能力。

e.en: Solar power is now a {viable} alternative to coal.
e.zh: 太阳能现在已成为煤炭的可行替代方案。

e.en: We need a {viable} plan before the meeting tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天开会前我们需要一个切实可行的方案。

e.en: The train crossed a stone {viaduct} above the valley.
e.zh: 火车驶过山谷上方的一座石砌高架桥。

e.en: Engineers are inspecting the old railway {viaduct}.
e.zh: 工程师们正在检查那座旧铁路高架桥。
