e.en: The nurse drew a small {vial} of blood.
e.zh: 护士抽了一小瓶血。

e.en: He carried a {vial} of perfume in his pocket.
e.zh: 他口袋里装着一小瓶香水。

e.en: The banquet table groaned under exotic {viands}.
e.zh: 宴席的桌子上摆满了异国佳肴。

e.en: Travelers shared simple {viands} around the fire.
e.zh: 旅行者们围着火堆分享简单的食物。

vibe.t: n. 氛围、感觉（网络常用）

e.en: This café has a really chill {vibe} on weekends.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆周末的氛围特别放松。

e.en: I'm getting a weird {vibe} from that guy.
e.zh: 我从那家伙身上感觉到一种怪怪的气场。

e.en: The painting is full of color and {vibrancy}.
e.zh: 这幅画充满了色彩与活力。

e.en: Tokyo's nightlife is famous for its {vibrancy}.
e.zh: 东京的夜生活以充满活力而闻名。

vibrant.t: adj. 充满活力的；（色彩）鲜艳的

e.en: She wore a {vibrant} red dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一件鲜艳的红色连衣裙去参加派对。

e.en: The neighborhood has a {vibrant} arts scene.
e.zh: 这个街区有着充满活力的艺术氛围。

vibrantly.t: adv. 充满活力地；鲜艳地

e.en: The autumn leaves glowed {vibrantly} in the sunlight.
e.zh: 秋叶在阳光下绚烂地闪着光。

e.en: The market buzzed {vibrantly} from morning to night.
e.zh: 集市从早到晚都热闹非凡。

vibraphone.t: n. 颤音琴（爵士打击乐器）

e.en: The jazz quartet features a {vibraphone} instead of a piano.
e.zh: 这个爵士四重奏用颤音琴代替了钢琴。

e.en: She has played the {vibraphone} since she was twelve.
e.zh: 她从十二岁起就开始弹颤音琴。

e.en: Set your phone to {vibrate} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时把手机设为震动模式。

e.en: The bridge began to {vibrate} as the truck crossed it.
e.zh: 卡车驶过时,桥梁开始震动起来。

vibrated.t: v. vibrate 的过去式，振动

e.en: My phone {vibrated} silently in my pocket all morning.
e.zh: 我的手机整个上午都在口袋里静静震动。

e.en: The whole room {vibrated} when the bass dropped.
e.zh: 低音响起时整个房间都在震动。

e.en: This watch {vibrates} gently to remind you to stand up.
e.zh: 这只手表会轻轻震动,提醒你起身活动。

e.en: The string {vibrates} faster when you tighten it.
e.zh: 琴弦拉紧后震动得更快。

vibrating.t:
v. 振动（现在分词）
adj. 振动的

e.en: My phone kept {vibrating} on the table during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时我的手机在桌上一直震动。

e.en: The bridge was {vibrating} slightly in the strong wind.
e.zh: 大桥在强风中微微地颤动。

e.en: I felt a sudden {vibration} from my pocket.
e.zh: 我感到口袋里突然震动了一下。

e.en: The engine produces too much {vibration} at high speeds.
e.zh: 发动机在高速时震动过大。

vibrational.t: adj. 振动的；与振动有关的

e.en: Sensors detect {vibrational} patterns to predict machine failure.
e.zh: 传感器通过检测振动模式来预测机器故障。

e.en: Each molecule has its own {vibrational} frequency.
e.zh: 每个分子都有自己独特的振动频率。

e.en: Strong {vibrations} from the subway shake the old building.
e.zh: 地铁的强烈震动使这栋老楼摇晃。

e.en: This café has really good {vibrations} for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡店学习的氛围特别好。

e.en: The singer added a beautiful {vibrato} to the final note.
e.zh: 歌手在最后一个音上加了优美的颤音。

e.en: Violinists practice for years to control their {vibrato}.
e.zh: 小提琴手要练多年才能掌控好揉弦。

e.en: The phone's {vibrator} motor stopped working after the drop.
e.zh: 手机摔了之后震动马达就坏了。

e.en: Construction workers used a concrete {vibrator} to settle the mix.
e.zh: 工人用混凝土振动器使料浆密实。

vibratory.t: adj. 振动的；引起振动的

e.en: The factory uses {vibratory} feeders to sort small parts.
e.zh: 工厂用振动送料机来分拣小零件。

e.en: He felt a {vibratory} hum through the floor.
e.zh: 他感到地板传来一阵震动的嗡嗡声。

e.en: Doctors warned that raw oysters can carry {vibrio} bacteria.
e.zh: 医生警告生蚝可能携带弧菌。

e.en: A {vibrio} infection can cause severe stomach illness.
e.zh: 弧菌感染会引起严重的肠胃疾病。

e.en: She planted a {viburnum} by the front gate for spring blooms.
e.zh: 她在前门旁种了一株荚蒾,春天会开花。

e.en: The {viburnum} berries turn bright red in autumn.
e.zh: 荚蒾的浆果到秋天会变成鲜红色。

e.en: The village {vicar} gave a moving sermon on Sunday.
e.zh: 村里的牧师周日做了一次感人的布道。

e.en: Our new {vicar} is very popular with young families.
e.zh: 我们的新牧师很受年轻家庭欢迎。

e.en: The old {vicarage} has been turned into a guesthouse.
e.zh: 那座老牧师住宅已被改成了民宿。

e.en: Tea was served in the garden of the {vicarage}.
e.zh: 茶点摆在牧师宅邸的花园里招待客人。

vicarious.t: adj. 感同身受的；代理的

e.en: Parents often get {vicarious} pleasure from their kids' achievements.
e.zh: 父母常常从孩子的成就中获得替代性的快乐。

e.en: Travel vlogs offer a {vicarious} sense of adventure.
e.zh: 旅行视频让人间接体验到冒险的感觉。

vicariously.t: adv. 间接感受地；替代地

e.en: I live {vicariously} through my friend's travel photos.
e.zh: 我通过朋友的旅行照片体验着别样的人生。

e.en: Fans experience victory {vicariously} when their team wins.
e.zh: 球队获胜时,球迷也会感同身受地体会到胜利。

e.en: Several {vicars} attended the bishop's annual conference.
e.zh: 几位牧师出席了主教的年度会议。

e.en: Local {vicars} take turns leading the community service.
e.zh: 当地的牧师轮流主持社区礼拜。

vice.t:
n. 恶习；坏毛病
adj. 副的（vice president）

e.en: Gambling became his secret {vice} after retirement.
e.zh: 赌博成了他退休后不为人知的恶习。

e.en: She was promoted to {vice} president of marketing.
e.zh: 她被提升为市场部副总裁。

e.en: The {viceregal} residence is open to tourists on weekends.
e.zh: 总督官邸周末向游客开放。

e.en: He attended a formal {viceregal} reception in Ottawa.
e.zh: 他参加了在渥太华举办的正式总督招待会。

viceroy.t: n. 总督（代君主治理殖民地者）

e.en: The {viceroy} ruled the colony in the king's name.
e.zh: 总督以国王的名义统治殖民地。

e.en: A {viceroy} butterfly often mimics the monarch for protection.
e.zh: 副王蝶常模仿帝王蝶以躲避捕食者。

viceroyalty.t: n. 总督职位；总督辖区

e.en: The {viceroyalty} of New Spain covered most of Mexico.
e.zh: 新西班牙总督辖区涵盖了墨西哥大部分地区。

e.en: His {viceroyalty} lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他的总督任期持续了近十年。

e.en: Coffee and late nights are my only real {vices}.
e.zh: 咖啡和熬夜是我仅有的两个坏习惯。

e.en: The novel explores the {vices} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这本小说探讨了小镇生活中的种种恶习。

e.en: She ordered a glass of {vichy} water at the café.
e.zh: 她在咖啡馆点了一杯维希矿泉水。

e.en: The {vichy} regime collaborated with Nazi Germany during the war.
e.zh: 维希政权在战争期间与纳粹德国合作。

vichyssoise.t: n. 维希冷浓汤（土豆韭葱奶油汤）

e.en: We started dinner with a chilled bowl of {vichyssoise}.
e.zh: 我们以一碗冰镇的法式韭葱浓汤开始晚餐。

e.en: Her {vichyssoise} recipe uses leeks and cream.
e.zh: 她的法式冷汤食谱用到韭葱和奶油。

e.en: Wildfires were reported in several mountain {vicinities}.
e.zh: 山区附近多个地带都报告了野火。

e.en: Crime rates differ across the city's {vicinities}.
e.zh: 该市不同地段的犯罪率差异很大。

e.en: There are several good restaurants in the {vicinity} of the hotel.
e.zh: 酒店附近有好几家不错的餐厅。

e.en: Police searched the {vicinity} for the missing child.
e.zh: 警方在附近一带搜寻失踪的孩子。

e.en: The dog gave a {vicious} bark when strangers approached.
e.zh: 陌生人靠近时,那只狗凶狠地狂吠。

e.en: Online comments can be surprisingly {vicious}.
e.zh: 网上的评论有时恶毒得让人意外。

e.en: The wind blew {viciously} across the open field.
e.zh: 狂风猛烈地刮过空旷的田野。

e.en: Critics {viciously} attacked the politician's new book.
e.zh: 评论家们恶毒地抨击了那位政客的新书。

e.en: The {viciousness} of the attack shocked the whole town.
e.zh: 袭击的凶残程度震惊了整个小镇。

e.en: There's a real {viciousness} in his recent posts online.
e.zh: 他最近发的网帖里有种真正的恶意。

e.en: Every {vicissitude} of the journey taught her something new.
e.zh: 旅途中每一次起伏都让她学到了新东西。

e.en: He accepted each {vicissitude} with quiet patience.
e.zh: 他以沉静的耐心接受每一次人生波折。

e.en: Her {vicissitudinous} career took her from teacher to CEO.
e.zh: 她跌宕起伏的职业生涯使她从教师变为首席执行官。

e.en: The novel follows the {vicissitudinous} life of an immigrant.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位移民跌宕起伏的人生。

e.en: The scam {victim} lost her entire savings overnight.
e.zh: 那位诈骗受害者一夜之间损失了全部积蓄。

e.en: He fell {victim} to a phishing email last week.
e.zh: 他上周中了钓鱼邮件的圈套。

victimisation.t: n. 迫害；使受害（英式拼写）

e.en: The report exposed widespread {victimisation} of minority workers.
e.zh: 该报告揭露了少数族裔员工普遍遭受迫害的现象。

e.en: Laws now protect employees from {victimisation} after complaints.
e.zh: 现在的法律保护员工在投诉后免遭报复。

victimise.t: v. 使受害；欺压（英式拼写）

e.en: Bullies often {victimise} the quietest kids in class.
e.zh: 霸凌者常常欺负班上最安静的孩子。

e.en: Scammers tend to {victimise} elderly people online.
e.zh: 骗子往往在网上专门坑害老年人。

victimization.t: n. 迫害；使成为受害者

e.en: The study measured {victimization} rates among college students.
e.zh: 该研究测量了大学生遭受侵害的比例。

e.en: Repeated {victimization} can cause long-term anxiety.
e.zh: 反复受到侵害会导致长期的焦虑。

victimize.t: v. 使成为受害者；欺压

e.en: Online predators often {victimize} teenagers in chat rooms.
e.zh: 网络掠夺者常在聊天室里侵害青少年。

e.en: Don't let one bad review {victimize} the whole team.
e.zh: 不要让一条差评连累整个团队受委屈。

victimized.t:
adj. 被欺压的
v. victimize 的过去式

e.en: She felt {victimized} by the company's sudden layoff decision.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被公司突然的裁员决定坑害了。

e.en: Many small businesses were {victimized} by the ransomware attack.
e.zh: 许多小企业在那次勒索软件攻击中受害。

e.en: The {victimizer} was finally identified through security footage.
e.zh: 通过监控录像,作恶者最终被辨认了出来。

e.en: Therapy helps survivors stop seeing themselves through the {victimizer}'s eyes.
e.zh: 治疗帮助幸存者不再以加害者的视角看待自己。

victimless.t: adj. 无受害者的（如某些犯罪）

e.en: Some argue that gambling alone is a {victimless} crime.
e.zh: 有人认为独自赌博是一种没有受害者的犯罪。

e.en: Downloading pirated movies isn't really a {victimless} act.
e.zh: 下载盗版电影其实并非毫无受害者。

e.en: Donations are pouring in for the earthquake {victims}.
e.zh: 善款正源源不断地涌向地震的受害者。

e.en: Most fraud {victims} never recover their lost money.
e.zh: 大多数诈骗受害者再也拿不回被骗的钱。

e.en: The clear {victor} of the debate was the younger candidate.
e.zh: 这场辩论的明显赢家是那位较年轻的候选人。

e.en: After five sets, she emerged the {victor}.
e.zh: 打满五盘之后,她最终胜出。

victoria.t: n. 维多利亚（人名/地名）

e.en: Queen {Victoria} ruled Britain for over sixty years.
e.zh: 维多利亚女王统治英国六十多年。

e.en: They took a horse-drawn {victoria} around the old town.
e.zh: 他们坐着一辆敞篷四轮马车游览了老城。

victorian.t:
adj. 维多利亚时代的
n. 维多利亚时代的人

e.en: They bought a charming {Victorian} house in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他们在郊区买了一栋迷人的维多利亚式房子。

e.en: The novel paints a vivid picture of {Victorian} London.
e.zh: 这部小说生动描绘了维多利亚时代的伦敦。

victoriana.t: n. 维多利亚时代的艺术品与收藏品

e.en: The shop is full of {victoriana} like lace gloves and cameos.
e.zh: 那家店里全是蕾丝手套和浮雕饰品之类的维多利亚时期物品。

e.en: Collectors of {victoriana} attend the antique fair every year.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期物品的收藏者每年都去逛古董集市。

e.en: The team celebrated three straight {victories} this week.
e.zh: 球队这周连续庆祝了三场胜利。

e.en: Small daily {victories} keep me motivated at work.
e.zh: 日常的小胜利让我在工作中保持干劲。

e.en: The {victorious} team paraded through the city streets.
e.zh: 获胜的球队在城里的街道上游行庆祝。

e.en: She emerged {victorious} from the long legal battle.
e.zh: 她在漫长的官司中最终胜出。

e.en: The runner raised her arms {victoriously} at the finish line.
e.zh: 那位跑者在终点处胜利地举起双臂。

e.en: He smiled {victoriously} after solving the last puzzle.
e.zh: 解开最后一道谜题后,他露出胜利的微笑。

e.en: The come-from-behind {victory} thrilled fans worldwide.
e.zh: 这场逆转的胜利让全球球迷兴奋不已。

e.en: Finishing the marathon felt like a personal {victory}.
e.zh: 跑完马拉松感觉像是个人的一次胜利。

victual.t:
n. 食物（多用复数）
v. 供应食物

e.en: The hikers stopped at an inn to {victual} for the night.
e.zh: 徒步者在一家小客栈停下来准备过夜的食物。

e.en: Each {victual} was carefully packed for the long voyage.
e.zh: 每一份食物都为漫长的航程精心打包好了。

victualler.t: n. 食物供应者；酒馆老板

e.en: The licensed {victualler} ran the village inn for decades.
e.zh: 那位持牌酒馆老板经营村里的客栈几十年了。

e.en: A naval {victualler} supplied food to the fleet.
e.zh: 一名海军军需官为舰队提供食物。

e.en: They packed enough {victuals} for a week-long hike.
e.zh: 他们带上了足够一周徒步用的食物。

e.en: The innkeeper served hearty {victuals} to weary travelers.
e.zh: 客栈老板为疲惫的旅人端上丰盛的饭菜。

vicuna.t: n. 小羊驼；其毛制成的织物

e.en: A {vicuna} coat can cost over twenty thousand dollars.
e.zh: 一件骆马毛大衣的价格可超过两万美元。

e.en: Wild {vicuna} graze high in the Andes mountains.
e.zh: 野生骆马在安第斯山的高处吃草。

vide.t: v. 参见（拉丁语，文献引用用语）

e.en: For details on the model, {vide} appendix B.
e.zh: 关于该模型的细节,请参见附录B。

e.en: The footnote read '{vide} page forty-two'.
e.zh: 脚注上写着“参见第四十二页”。

video.t:
n. 视频
adj. 视频的

e.en: She posted a funny {video} of her cat online.
e.zh: 她在网上发了一段她家猫的搞笑视频。

e.en: We had a {video} call with the team in Berlin.
e.zh: 我们和柏林的团队进行了一次视频通话。

e.en: He mounted a small {videocam} on his bicycle helmet.
e.zh: 他在自行车头盔上装了一个小摄像机。

e.en: The old {videocam} still records surprisingly clear footage.
e.zh: 那台旧摄像机录出来的画面依然出奇地清晰。

e.en: My parents kept every wedding {videocassette} from 1995.
e.zh: 我父母保留了1995年所有的婚礼录像带。

e.en: He found a dusty {videocassette} in the attic.
e.zh: 他在阁楼里找到一盘满是灰尘的录像带。

e.en: We held a {videoconference} with clients across three continents.
e.zh: 我们和三大洲的客户开了一场视频会议。

e.en: The {videoconference} kept freezing because of poor wifi.
e.zh: 视频会议因为wifi不好一直卡顿。

videoconferencing.t: n. 视频会议（技术或行为）

e.en: {Videoconferencing} became essential for remote teams during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间视频会议成了远程团队的必备工具。

e.en: The company invested heavily in {videoconferencing} equipment.
e.zh: 公司在视频会议设备上投入了大量资金。

e.en: Collectors still hunt for rare laser {videodisc} releases.
e.zh: 收藏家仍在寻找罕见的激光影碟版本。

e.en: The library archived old films on {videodisc}.
e.zh: 图书馆把老电影存档在影碟上。

e.en: We hired a {videographer} to film the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 我们请了一位摄像师来拍摄婚礼。

e.en: The freelance {videographer} edits clips for travel vloggers.
e.zh: 这位自由摄像师为旅行博主剪辑视频。

videography.t: n. 摄像技术；视频制作

e.en: Her {videography} captures emotion in every frame.
e.zh: 她的摄像作品在每一帧中都捕捉到了情感。

e.en: He studies {videography} at film school.
e.zh: 他在电影学院学习摄像技术。

e.en: My grandmother uses a {videophone} to call relatives abroad.
e.zh: 我奶奶用可视电话与海外亲戚通话。

e.en: The hospital installed a {videophone} for remote consultations.
e.zh: 医院安装了可视电话用于远程问诊。

e.en: She watches cooking {videos} every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都看烹饪视频。

e.en: The platform recommends short {videos} based on your interests.
e.zh: 该平台根据你的兴趣推荐短视频。

videotape.t:
n. 录像带
v. 用录像带录制

e.en: He found an old {videotape} of his childhood birthday.
e.zh: 他找到了一盘记录童年生日的旧录像带。

e.en: The library is digitizing every {videotape} in its archive.
e.zh: 图书馆正在将馆藏的每盘录像带数字化。

videotaped.t: v. 录像（videotape 的过去式）

e.en: The journalist {videotaped} the entire press conference.
e.zh: 那位记者把整场新闻发布会都录了下来。

e.en: Coaches {videotaped} the practice to review mistakes later.
e.zh: 教练们把训练录下来,以便事后回看错误。

e.en: They are {videotaping} the concert for a documentary.
e.zh: 他们正在为一部纪录片录制这场音乐会。

e.en: The teacher began {videotaping} her lectures during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间这位老师开始把讲课录成视频。

vienna.t: n. 维也纳（奥地利首都）

e.en: We spent three days exploring museums in {Vienna}.
e.zh: 我们在维也纳花了三天逛博物馆。

e.en: {Vienna} is famous for its classical music heritage.
e.zh: 维也纳以其古典音乐传统而闻名。

vienne.t: n. 维埃纳（法国地名/河流）

e.en: The river flows past the historic town of {Vienne}.
e.zh: 这条河流经历史悠久的维埃纳镇。

e.en: We visited Roman ruins in {Vienne}, France.
e.zh: 我们参观了法国维埃纳的罗马遗迹。

viennese.t:
adj. 维也纳的
n. 维也纳人

e.en: The café serves traditional {Viennese} pastries every morning.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每天早上都供应传统的维也纳糕点。

e.en: She fell in love with the {Viennese} waltz.
e.zh: 她爱上了维也纳华尔兹。

e.en: The {Viet} people have a rich culinary tradition.
e.zh: 越族人民拥有丰富的饮食传统。

e.en: He studies {Viet} history at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学里研究越南历史。

vietcong.t: n. 越共；越南南方民族解放阵线

e.en: The documentary describes {Vietcong} tactics during the war.
e.zh: 这部纪录片介绍了战争期间越共的战术。

e.en: American soldiers often clashed with {Vietcong} fighters in the jungle.
e.zh: 美军士兵经常在丛林中与越共战士交火。

vietminh.t: n. 越盟（越南独立同盟会）

e.en: The {Vietminh} fought for independence from French rule.
e.zh: 越盟为脱离法国殖民统治而战。

e.en: Ho Chi Minh founded the {Vietminh} in 1941.
e.zh: 胡志明于1941年创立了越盟。

e.en: We're flying to {Vietnam} for our honeymoon next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要飞往越南度蜜月。

e.en: {Vietnam} is known for its delicious street food.
e.zh: 越南以美味的街头小吃而闻名。

vietnamese.t:
adj. 越南的
n. 越南人；越南语

e.en: I love eating {Vietnamese} pho on cold days.
e.zh: 我喜欢在寒冷的日子里吃越南河粉。

e.en: She is learning {Vietnamese} for her upcoming trip.
e.zh: 她正在为即将到来的旅行学越南语。

vieux.t: adj. 旧的（法语，常见于地名）

e.en: We strolled through the {Vieux} Quarter of New Orleans.
e.zh: 我们漫步穿过新奥尔良的旧城区。

e.en: The {Vieux} Port in Marseille bustles with boats.
e.zh: 马赛的旧港里船只往来繁忙。

view.t:
v. 查看；浏览
n. 视图；观点

e.en: The hotel room has a stunning {view} of the ocean.
e.zh: 这间酒店房间能看到壮丽的海景。

e.en: In my {view}, remote work boosts productivity.
e.zh: 在我看来,远程办公能提升效率。

viewable.t: adj. 可查看的；可观看的

e.en: The video is only {viewable} to subscribers.
e.zh: 该视频仅订阅用户可观看。

e.en: All meeting notes are {viewable} on the shared drive.
e.zh: 所有会议记录都可以在共享盘上查看。

viewdata.t: n. 可视图文信息系统

e.en: Old {viewdata} systems delivered text via television sets.
e.zh: 旧式可视图文系统通过电视机传送文字信息。

e.en: The travel agency relied on {viewdata} terminals in the eighties.
e.zh: 这家旅行社在八十年代依赖可视图文终端。

viewed.t: v. 查看（view 的过去式）

e.en: The clip has been {viewed} over a million times.
e.zh: 这段短片已被观看超过一百万次。

e.en: He is {viewed} as a rising star in tech.
e.zh: 他被视为科技行业的后起之秀。

viewer.t: n. 观看者；查看器（软件）

e.en: Every {viewer} can leave a comment under the video.
e.zh: 每位观众都可以在视频下方留言。

e.en: The image {viewer} supports zoom and rotation.
e.zh: 这款图像查看器支持缩放和旋转。

e.en: The live stream attracted millions of {viewers} worldwide.
e.zh: 这场直播吸引了全球数百万观众。

e.en: Loyal {viewers} tuned in every Sunday night.
e.zh: 忠实观众每周日晚都会准时收看。

e.en: She framed the shot through the camera's {viewfinder}.
e.zh: 她透过相机的取景器构图。

e.en: The new mirrorless camera has an electronic {viewfinder}.
e.zh: 这款新无反相机配有电子取景器。

viewing.t:
n. 观看；收看
v. 查看（进行时）

e.en: Thanks for {viewing} our channel today.
e.zh: 感谢您今天观看我们的频道。

e.en: We scheduled a house {viewing} for Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们把看房安排在周六下午。

e.en: From a parent's {viewpoint}, screen time is concerning.
e.zh: 从家长的角度看,屏幕时间令人担忧。

e.en: The hill offers a perfect {viewpoint} for sunset photos.
e.zh: 这座小山是拍日落照片的绝佳观景点。

e.en: The panel featured speakers with very different {viewpoints}.
e.zh: 该研讨会的发言人持有截然不同的观点。

e.en: Tourists snapped photos at several mountain {viewpoints}.
e.zh: 游客在几个山间观景点拍照。

viewport.t: n. 视口（网页/图形显示区域）

e.en: The website adapts to any {viewport} size automatically.
e.zh: 该网站会自动适配任何视口尺寸。

e.en: Set the {viewport} meta tag for mobile responsiveness.
e.zh: 设置视口元标签以实现移动端响应式布局。

views.t:
n. 浏览量；观点（复数）
v. 查看

e.en: The video racked up a million {views} overnight.
e.zh: 这条视频一夜之间获得了百万播放量。

e.en: Her political {views} have shifted over the years.
e.zh: 多年来她的政治观点有所转变。

e.en: Mourners held a candlelight {vigil} for the victims.
e.zh: 哀悼者为遇难者举行了烛光守夜活动。

e.en: She kept a long {vigil} by his hospital bed.
e.zh: 她在他的病床边长时间守候。

e.en: Cybersecurity requires constant {vigilance} from every employee.
e.zh: 网络安全需要每位员工时刻保持警惕。

e.en: Border guards maintain strict {vigilance} day and night.
e.zh: 边防人员日夜保持严格的警戒。

e.en: Stay {vigilant} when entering your password on public Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 在公共Wi-Fi上输入密码时要保持警惕。

e.en: Parents must remain {vigilant} about online predators.
e.zh: 家长必须时刻警惕网络上的不法分子。

e.en: A {vigilante} group patrolled the neighborhood at night.
e.zh: 一群治安自卫队员夜间在社区巡逻。

e.en: The film portrays a lonely {vigilante} fighting crime.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一位孤独的义警与犯罪作斗争。

vigilantism.t: n. 法外私刑；义警行为

e.en: The mayor condemned all forms of {vigilantism} in the city.
e.zh: 市长谴责了城市中一切形式的私刑行为。

e.en: Online {vigilantism} can ruin innocent people's lives.
e.zh: 网络私刑会毁掉无辜者的生活。

e.en: The lifeguard {vigilantly} watched the swimmers in the pool.
e.zh: 救生员警觉地注视着泳池里的游泳者。

e.en: She {vigilantly} checked her bank statements for fraud.
e.zh: 她警觉地查看银行对账单以防诈骗。

e.en: The novel opens with a charming {vignette} of village life.
e.zh: 小说以一段乡村生活的迷人小品开篇。

e.en: Add a subtle {vignette} to draw focus to the subject.
e.zh: 加一点淡淡的暗角效果,把焦点引向主体。

e.en: She tackled the new project with youthful {vigor}.
e.zh: 她以年轻人的活力投入到新项目中。

e.en: Daily exercise restored his {vigor} after the illness.
e.zh: 每天锻炼让他在病后重新焕发了活力。

vigorous.t: adj. 精力充沛的；强有力的

e.en: The doctor recommends {vigorous} exercise three times a week.
e.zh: 医生建议每周进行三次剧烈运动。

e.en: There was a {vigorous} debate about the proposed policy.
e.zh: 针对该提议的政策展开了激烈的辩论。

vigorously.t: adv. 精力充沛地；强有力地

e.en: He shook his head {vigorously} to disagree.
e.zh: 他用力摇头表示不同意。

e.en: The lawyer {vigorously} defended her client in court.
e.zh: 律师在法庭上据理力争为当事人辩护。

vigors.t: n. 活力（vigor 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The young athlete brought new {vigors} to the team.
e.zh: 这位年轻运动员为球队注入了新的活力。

e.en: Spring renews the {vigors} of every living thing.
e.zh: 春天让万物焕发新的生机。

vigour.t: n. 活力（vigor 的英式拼写）

e.en: The campaign was conducted with great {vigour}.
e.zh: 这场活动开展得轰轰烈烈。

e.en: He attacked the meal with surprising {vigour}.
e.zh: 他出人意料地大快朵颐。

vigours.t: n. 活力（vigour 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The countryside renewed her {vigours} after months indoors.
e.zh: 乡村让她在室内待了数月后恢复了活力。

e.en: Spring weather brought fresh {vigours} to the garden.
e.zh: 春天的天气为花园带来了新的生机。

e.en: King Henry {VIII} had six wives during his reign.
e.zh: 亨利八世在位期间有过六位妻子。

e.en: Chapter {VIII} discusses the fall of the empire.
e.zh: 第八章讨论了帝国的衰落。

e.en: The museum displays a restored {Viking} longship.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘修复的维京长船。

e.en: He dressed as a {Viking} warrior for Halloween.
e.zh: 他万圣节扮成了维京战士。

vila.t: n. 维拉港（瓦努阿图首都）

e.en: We landed in Port {Vila}, the capital of Vanuatu.
e.zh: 我们降落在瓦努阿图的首都维拉港。

e.en: Port {Vila} is famous for its turquoise lagoons.
e.zh: 维拉港以其碧绿的潟湖而闻名。

e.en: The coffee tasted absolutely {vile} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上的咖啡味道糟透了。

e.en: He was arrested for posting {vile} comments online.
e.zh: 他因在网上发布恶毒评论而被捕。

e.en: The prisoners were {vilely} mistreated by their captors.
e.zh: 囚犯遭到俘虏者卑鄙的虐待。

e.en: He spoke {vilely} about his former colleagues.
e.zh: 他对前同事们出言不逊。

e.en: The {vileness} of the crime shocked the community.
e.zh: 这起罪行的卑劣令整个社区震惊。

e.en: She was disgusted by the {vileness} of his words.
e.zh: 她对他言语的恶毒感到厌恶。

e.en: The senator endured years of public {vilification}.
e.zh: 这位参议员忍受了多年的公众诋毁。

e.en: Online {vilification} has become a serious mental health issue.
e.zh: 网络诽谤已成为严重的心理健康问题。

e.en: The whistleblower was {vilified} by his former employers.
e.zh: 这位告密者遭到前雇主的诽谤中伤。

e.en: She was unfairly {vilified} in the tabloid press.
e.zh: 她在小报上遭到不公平的诋毁。

e.en: Critics often {vilify} politicians without checking the facts.
e.zh: 评论者常在不核实事实的情况下诋毁政客。

e.en: Don't {vilify} someone just because you disagree with them.
e.zh: 别仅仅因为意见不合就诽谤别人。

e.en: They rented a {villa} in Tuscany for the summer.
e.zh: 他们在托斯卡纳租了一栋别墅过暑假。

e.en: The seaside {villa} has six bedrooms and a pool.
e.zh: 那栋海边别墅有六间卧室和一个游泳池。

e.en: She grew up in a small fishing {village}.
e.zh: 她在一个小渔村长大。

e.en: The whole {village} gathered for the harvest festival.
e.zh: 全村人都聚在一起庆祝丰收节。

e.en: Every {villager} helped rebuild the school after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后,每位村民都帮忙重建了学校。

e.en: An elderly {villager} told us the legend of the lake.
e.zh: 一位年长的村民给我们讲了那个湖的传说。

e.en: The {villagers} protested the new highway plan.
e.zh: 村民们抗议新的高速公路规划。

e.en: Local {villagers} guided the hikers through the forest.
e.zh: 当地村民带着徒步者穿过森林。

e.en: Several mountain {villages} lost power during the storm.
e.zh: 风暴期间几个山村都停电了。

e.en: The road connects three remote {villages} to the city.
e.zh: 这条路把三个偏远村庄连到了城里。

e.en: The {villain} in the new Marvel movie steals every scene.
e.zh: 新漫威电影里的反派每场戏都很抢眼。

e.en: Sugar is often portrayed as the {villain} of modern diets.
e.zh: 糖经常被描绘成现代饮食里的罪魁祸首。

e.en: The {villainess} in the drama plots against the queen.
e.zh: 剧中的女反派密谋对付王后。

e.en: She loves playing the glamorous {villainess} on stage.
e.zh: 她喜欢在舞台上演那种魅力十足的女反派。

e.en: He gave a {villainous} laugh as the trap closed.
e.zh: 陷阱合上时他发出一阵奸笑。

e.en: The CEO's {villainous} scheme was exposed by reporters.
e.zh: 首席执行官的恶毒阴谋被记者揭露了。

e.en: The novel exposes the {villainy} of corrupt officials.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了腐败官员的恶行。

e.en: There is no end to his cunning and {villainy}.
e.zh: 他的狡诈与邪恶毫无止境。

e.en: Luxury {villas} line the coast of southern France.
e.zh: 豪华别墅沿着法国南部的海岸排开。

e.en: The resort offers private {villas} with ocean views.
e.zh: 度假村提供带海景的私人别墅。

ville.t: n. 城镇（法语词，常作地名后缀）

e.en: He grew up in a sleepy little {ville} in Quebec.
e.zh: 他在魁北克一个安静的小城长大。

e.en: American place names often end in {ville}, like Nashville.
e.zh: 美国地名常以 ville 结尾,比如纳什维尔。

e.en: A medieval {villein} owed labor to the local lord.
e.zh: 中世纪的农奴要为当地领主服劳役。

e.en: The lord could not legally sell a {villein} away from the land.
e.zh: 领主依法不能把农奴与土地分开出售。

villette.t: n. 人名/地名；夏洛蒂·勃朗特小说《维莱特》

e.en: Charlotte Brontë's {Villette} is a haunting psychological novel.
e.zh: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特的《维莱特》是一部令人难忘的心理小说。

e.en: We strolled through Parc de la {Villette} on Sunday.
e.zh: 我们星期天在拉维莱特公园里散了步。

villous.t: adj. 有绒毛的（医学/生物）

e.en: The intestinal lining has a {villous} surface that absorbs nutrients.
e.zh: 肠道内壁有绒毛状表面,可以吸收营养。

e.en: Doctors removed a {villous} polyp during the colonoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在结肠镜检查中切除了一个绒毛状息肉。

vilnius.t: n. 维尔纽斯（立陶宛首都）

e.en: {Vilnius} is the historic capital of Lithuania.
e.zh: 维尔纽斯是立陶宛的历史首都。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the old town of {Vilnius}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览维尔纽斯老城。

e.en: She played a haunting raga on the {vina}.
e.zh: 她用维纳琴演奏了一段动人的拉格。

e.en: The {vina} is one of India's oldest stringed instruments.
e.zh: 维纳琴是印度最古老的弦乐器之一。

e.en: Toss the salad with a light lemon {vinaigrette}.
e.zh: 用清爽的柠檬油醋汁拌一下沙拉。

e.en: He whisked olive oil and mustard into a quick {vinaigrette}.
e.zh: 他把橄榄油和芥末快速搅成了一份油醋汁。

vincennes.t: n. 地名，文森（法国/美国）

e.en: The Château de {Vincennes} is just east of Paris.
e.zh: 文森城堡就在巴黎的东边。

e.en: We took the metro to {Vincennes} to visit the zoo.
e.zh: 我们坐地铁去文森看动物园。

e.en: Leonardo da {Vinci} sketched flying machines centuries before flight.
e.zh: 达·芬奇早在飞行实现前几个世纪就画过飞行器草图。

e.en: The da {Vinci} surgical robot helps doctors perform delicate procedures.
e.zh: 达芬奇手术机器人帮助医生完成精细操作。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {vincristine} as part of her chemotherapy.
e.zh: 医生开了长春新碱作为她化疗方案的一部分。

e.en: {Vincristine} is derived from the Madagascar periwinkle plant.
e.zh: 长春新碱是从马达加斯加长春花中提取出来的。

e.en: He ordered a fiery chicken {vindaloo} at the curry house.
e.zh: 他在咖喱店点了一份火辣的咖喱鸡。

e.en: This {vindaloo} is too spicy for me to finish.
e.zh: 这道咖喱我辣得吃不完。

e.en: New evidence may finally {vindicate} the wrongly convicted man.
e.zh: 新证据也许终于能为那位被冤枉的人洗清罪名。

e.en: The trial results {vindicate} years of careful research.
e.zh: 试验结果证明了多年仔细研究的正确性。

e.en: She felt completely {vindicated} when the report cleared her name.
e.zh: 报告还了她清白后,她觉得完全被证实是对的。

e.en: The whistleblower was eventually {vindicated} in court.
e.zh: 那位举报人最终在法庭上得到了昭雪。

vindicates.t: v. 证明清白（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new study {vindicates} the doctor's controversial diagnosis.
e.zh: 这项新研究证实了那位医生有争议的诊断是对的。

e.en: Time often {vindicates} ideas that were once mocked.
e.zh: 时间往往会证明那些曾被嘲笑的想法是正确的。

vindicating.t: v. 证明清白（现在分词）

e.en: The DNA test was key in {vindicating} the prisoner.
e.zh: DNA 检测是为这名囚犯洗清罪名的关键。

e.en: He spent years {vindicating} his late father's reputation.
e.zh: 他花了多年来为已故父亲恢复名誉。

e.en: Winning the appeal was a long-awaited {vindication}.
e.zh: 上诉胜诉是一次期盼已久的平反。

e.en: The CEO called the verdict a complete {vindication}.
e.zh: 首席执行官称这一判决是完全的清白证明。

e.en: The book lists historic {vindications} of falsely accused scientists.
e.zh: 这本书列举了被冤枉科学家在历史上得到平反的案例。

e.en: Late {vindications} cannot fully repair a ruined reputation.
e.zh: 迟来的平反无法完全挽回受损的名誉。

e.en: The lawyer became a respected {vindicator} of immigrant rights.
e.zh: 那位律师成了备受敬重的移民权益捍卫者。

e.en: History often serves as the ultimate {vindicator} of truth.
e.zh: 历史常常是真相最终的证明者。

e.en: Her ex-boss got petty and {vindictive} after she resigned.
e.zh: 她辞职后前老板变得既小气又记仇。

e.en: Don't let a {vindictive} comment online ruin your day.
e.zh: 别让网上一句怀恨的评论毁了你一天的心情。

e.en: The judge criticized the prosecutor's apparent {vindictiveness}.
e.zh: 法官批评了检察官明显的报复心。

e.en: There's no room for {vindictiveness} in good leadership.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者身上不该有报复心。

e.en: A grape {vine} climbed up the wooden trellis.
e.zh: 一株葡萄藤攀上了木架。

e.en: He ripped a tomato off the {vine} and ate it whole.
e.zh: 他从藤上摘下一个西红柿,整颗吃掉了。

e.en: Add a splash of {vinegar} to balance the sauce.
e.zh: 加一点醋来平衡酱汁的味道。

e.en: White {vinegar} is great for cleaning windows.
e.zh: 白醋擦窗户特别好用。

e.en: The shop sells artisan {vinegars} from across Italy.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自意大利各地的手工醋。

e.en: Aged balsamic {vinegars} can cost hundreds of dollars per bottle.
e.zh: 陈年香醋一瓶可能要好几百美元。

e.en: The pickles had a sharp, {vinegary} taste.
e.zh: 那些泡菜有一种浓烈的醋味。

e.en: He made a face at the {vinegary} salad dressing.
e.zh: 他对那带酸醋味的沙拉酱皱了皱眉。

e.en: Thick {vines} covered the abandoned stone wall.
e.zh: 粗壮的藤蔓爬满了那堵废弃的石墙。

e.en: The winery's old {vines} produce intensely flavored grapes.
e.zh: 这家酒庄的老藤葡萄风味浓郁。

e.en: We toured a small {vineyard} in Tuscany last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了托斯卡纳的一个小葡萄园。

e.en: The {vineyard} produces about ten thousand bottles a year.
e.zh: 这个葡萄园每年生产约一万瓶葡萄酒。

e.en: Most fine wines come from Vitis {vinifera} grapes.
e.zh: 大多数优质葡萄酒都来自欧亚种葡萄。

e.en: Oregon farmers grow several {vinifera} varieties on these slopes.
e.zh: 俄勒冈的农户在这些坡地上种植多种酿酒葡萄。

e.en: Let's open a bottle of {vino} with dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时我们开瓶葡萄酒吧。

e.en: He brought cheap {vino} to the picnic.
e.zh: 他带了便宜的红酒来野餐。

vintage.t:
adj. 复古的；经典的
n. 葡萄酒年份

e.en: She found a {vintage} dress at the thrift store.
e.zh: 她在二手店淘到一件复古连衣裙。

e.en: 2015 was an exceptional {vintage} for Bordeaux wines.
e.zh: 2015年是波尔多葡萄酒非常出色的年份。

vintner.t: n. 酒商；葡萄酒酿造商

e.en: The local {vintner} offered us a tasting flight.
e.zh: 当地的酿酒师给我们提供了一组品酒。

e.en: Each {vintner} in the valley has a distinct style.
e.zh: 山谷里每位酿酒商都有独特的风格。

e.en: He still buys his favorite albums on {vinyl}.
e.zh: 他还是喜欢买黑胶唱片版的专辑。

e.en: The kitchen floor is covered with cheap {vinyl} tiles.
e.zh: 厨房地板铺着便宜的乙烯基地砖。

e.en: The Baroque ensemble featured a six-string {viol}.
e.zh: 这支巴洛克乐团使用了一把六弦古提琴。

e.en: She studied the {viol} at a conservatory in Vienna.
e.zh: 她在维也纳一所音乐学院学习古提琴。

e.en: She plays the {viola} in the school orchestra.
e.zh: 她在学校乐团里拉中提琴。

e.en: A purple {viola} bloomed beside the garden path.
e.zh: 一朵紫色的堇花在花园小径旁绽放。

e.en: Posting that photo would {violate} our privacy policy.
e.zh: 发布那张照片会违反我们的隐私政策。

e.en: Drivers who {violate} traffic laws face heavy fines.
e.zh: 违反交通法规的司机将面临高额罚款。

violated.t: v. 违反了；侵犯了（过去式）

e.en: The app was banned for having {violated} user privacy.
e.zh: 该应用因侵犯用户隐私而被下架。

e.en: Several countries {violated} the ceasefire agreement last week.
e.zh: 上周有几个国家违反了停火协议。

violates.t: v. 违反；侵犯（第三人称单数）

e.en: This post {violates} our community guidelines.
e.zh: 这条帖子违反了我们的社区守则。

e.en: Skipping the queue {violates} basic fairness.
e.zh: 插队违背了基本的公平原则。

violating.t: v. 违反；侵犯（现在分词）

e.en: He was fined for {violating} parking regulations downtown.
e.zh: 他因违反市中心的停车规定被罚款。

e.en: The account was suspended for {violating} platform rules.
e.zh: 该账号因违反平台规定被封禁。

e.en: Speeding is the most common traffic {violation}.
e.zh: 超速是最常见的交通违规行为。

e.en: The data leak was a serious {violation} of trust.
e.zh: 这次数据泄露严重辜负了用户的信任。

violations.t: n. 违规；违反行为（复数）

e.en: The factory was cited for multiple safety {violations}.
e.zh: 该工厂因多项安全违规被通报。

e.en: Repeated {violations} can get your account permanently banned.
e.zh: 反复违规可能导致你的账号被永久封禁。

e.en: The court ruled the policy {violative} of free speech.
e.zh: 法院裁定该政策侵犯了言论自由。

e.en: Such surveillance is {violative} of basic privacy rights.
e.zh: 这种监控侵犯了基本的隐私权。

e.en: The repeat {violator} lost his driver's license.
e.zh: 这名屡次违规者被吊销了驾照。

e.en: Any {violator} of the rules will be removed from the chat.
e.zh: 任何违反规则的人都会被移出群聊。

e.en: The film was banned for its graphic {violence}.
e.zh: 这部电影因画面过于暴力而被禁。

e.en: Protesters called for an end to police {violence}.
e.zh: 抗议者呼吁停止警察暴力。

e.en: A {violent} storm knocked out power across the city.
e.zh: 一场猛烈的风暴导致全城停电。

e.en: He has a history of {violent} outbursts at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中有过暴力发作的记录。

e.en: The door slammed {violently} in the wind.
e.zh: 门在风中猛烈地撞上了。

e.en: She shook her head {violently} in disagreement.
e.zh: 她剧烈地摇头表示不同意。

violet.t:
n. 紫罗兰
adj. 紫色的

e.en: The sky turned a deep {violet} after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后天空变成了深紫罗兰色。

e.en: She picked a small {violet} from the garden.
e.zh: 她从花园里摘了一朵小紫罗兰。

e.en: He started learning the {violin} at age six.
e.zh: 他六岁开始学小提琴。

e.en: Her {violin} solo brought the audience to tears.
e.zh: 她的小提琴独奏让观众感动落泪。

e.en: The young {violinist} won first prize at the competition.
e.zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手在比赛中获得了一等奖。

e.en: She is widely regarded as the country's finest {violinist}.
e.zh: 她被公认为该国最杰出的小提琴家。

e.en: The orchestra has twelve {violins} in its string section.
e.zh: 乐团的弦乐部有十二把小提琴。

e.en: Antique {violins} can sell for millions of dollars.
e.zh: 古董小提琴的售价可达数百万美元。

e.en: The {violist} sat between the cellist and the violinists.
e.zh: 中提琴手坐在大提琴手和小提琴手之间。

e.en: She works as a professional {violist} in Berlin.
e.zh: 她在柏林做职业中提琴演奏家。

vip.t: n. 贵宾；要人（Very Important Person 缩写）

e.en: A {viper} bit the hiker on the ankle.
e.zh: 一条蝰蛇咬了登山者的脚踝。

e.en: Be careful — that bush is hiding a {viper}.
e.zh: 小心,那丛灌木里藏着一条毒蛇。

e.en: The novel's heroine is a fearless {virago} who challenges the king.
e.zh: 小说的女主角是一位敢于挑战国王的悍妇。

e.en: His mother-in-law has the reputation of a {virago}.
e.zh: 他的岳母素有泼辣女人之名。

viral.t: adj. 病毒式的（走红）；病毒的

e.en: Her dance video went {viral} overnight.
e.zh: 她的舞蹈视频一夜之间爆红网络。

e.en: Doctors confirmed it was a {viral} infection, not bacterial.
e.zh: 医生确认这是病毒感染,不是细菌感染。

e.en: The medieval poem ends with an elegant {vire}.
e.zh: 这首中世纪诗歌以一首优雅的回旋诗结尾。

e.en: Scholars debate the structure of the old French {vire}.
e.zh: 学者们对古法语回旋诗的结构有争议。

e.en: A red-eyed {vireo} sang from the treetop all morning.
e.zh: 一只红眼莺雀整个上午在树梢上鸣唱。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {vireo} near the lake.
e.zh: 观鸟者在湖边发现了一只罕见的莺雀。

virgilian.t: adj. 维吉尔的；维吉尔风格的

e.en: The poem has a distinctly {virgilian} tone and grandeur.
e.zh: 这首诗具有鲜明的维吉尔式语调与气势。

e.en: Critics praised the novel's {virgilian} depiction of rural life.
e.zh: 评论家称赞小说对乡村生活的维吉尔式描绘。

virgin.t:
n. 处女
adj. 原始的；未使用的

e.en: The hikers explored a stretch of {virgin} forest.
e.zh: 徒步者们探索了一片原始森林。

e.en: This is her {virgin} voyage as a ship captain.
e.zh: 这是她作为船长的处女航。

e.en: The painting captures her {virginal} innocence and grace.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了她少女般的纯真与优雅。

e.en: Snow covered the field in a {virginal} white blanket.
e.zh: 雪给田野盖上了一层洁白无瑕的毯子。

virginia.t: n. 弗吉尼亚州；女子名

e.en: They drove through {Virginia} on their way to Washington.
e.zh: 他们去华盛顿的路上经过了弗吉尼亚州。

e.en: {Virginia} is famous for its colonial-era history.
e.zh: 弗吉尼亚州以其殖民时期的历史而闻名。

virginian.t:
n. 弗吉尼亚人
adj. 弗吉尼亚的

e.en: He speaks with a soft {Virginian} accent.
e.zh: 他说话带着柔和的弗吉尼亚口音。

e.en: The old {Virginian} family has lived here for generations.
e.zh: 这个古老的弗吉尼亚家族在这里已经住了好几代。

e.en: Many cultures attach symbolic meaning to {virginity}.
e.zh: 许多文化都赋予童贞以象征意义。

e.en: The film explores how teenagers think about {virginity}.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了青少年对童贞的看法。

e.en: As a {Virgo}, she's known for being detail-oriented.
e.zh: 作为处女座,她以注重细节著称。

e.en: The constellation {Virgo} is visible in spring skies.
e.zh: 室女星座在春季的夜空中可见。

e.en: The Latin word {viri} means "of the man" in grammar lessons.
e.zh: 在语法课上,拉丁词 viri 意为"男人的"。

e.en: Students memorized the declension forms including {viri}.
e.zh: 学生们背诵了包括 viri 在内的变格形式。

e.en: She painted the leaves in a rich {viridian} green.
e.zh: 她用浓郁的铬绿色画出了叶子。

e.en: The ocean shifted to {viridian} as the clouds parted.
e.zh: 云层散开时,海面变成了铬绿色。

virile.t: adj. 阳刚的；有男子气概的

e.en: The actor was cast for his tall, {virile} appearance.
e.zh: 那位演员因高大而充满男子气概的外表被选中。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {virile} energy of youth.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂了青春旺盛的活力。

e.en: The ad shamelessly promised to restore lost {virility}.
e.zh: 那则广告厚颜无耻地承诺恢复失去的男子气概。

e.en: Ancient cultures often associated bulls with {virility}.
e.zh: 古代文化常将公牛与雄性活力联系起来。

virilocal.t: adj. 从夫居的（婚后住男方家）

e.en: In {virilocal} societies, the wife moves to the husband's home.
e.zh: 在从夫居的社会中,妻子搬到丈夫家居住。

e.en: Anthropologists studied the village's {virilocal} marriage customs.
e.zh: 人类学家研究了该村庄的从夫居婚俗。

e.en: The crowd chanted "{vive} la France!" on Bastille Day.
e.zh: 国庆日人群高呼"法兰西万岁!"。

e.en: Protesters held signs reading "{vive} la liberté".
e.zh: 抗议者举着写有"自由万岁"的标语。

e.en: I had a {vivid} dream about flying last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我做了一个关于飞行的鲜活梦境。

e.en: The OLED screen produces incredibly {vivid} colors.
e.zh: 这块OLED屏幕能呈现极其鲜艳的色彩。

e.en: I {vividly} remember my first day of school.
e.zh: 我清晰地记得自己上学的第一天。

e.en: The author {vividly} describes life in old Shanghai.
e.zh: 作者生动地描绘了老上海的生活。

e.en: Critics praised the painting's color and {vividness}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这幅画的色彩与生动感。

e.en: The {vividness} of her memory surprised the therapist.
e.zh: 她记忆的鲜明程度让治疗师感到惊讶。

e.en: A few good photos can {vivify} a boring slide deck.
e.zh: 几张好照片就能让乏味的幻灯片生动起来。

e.en: Fresh paint helped {vivify} the old café.
e.zh: 新刷的油漆让这家老咖啡馆焕发生机。

e.en: Most mammals are {viviparous}, giving birth to live young.
e.zh: 大多数哺乳动物是胎生的,直接生下幼崽。

e.en: Some sharks are surprisingly {viviparous} rather than egg-laying.
e.zh: 有些鲨鱼竟是胎生而非产卵的。

e.en: Activists protested against {vivisection} in medical labs.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议医学实验室进行的活体解剖。

e.en: The book is a sharp {vivisection} of corporate culture.
e.zh: 这本书是对企业文化的尖锐剖析。

vivo.t: adj. 活体的（in vivo 体内）

e.en: The drug was tested in {vivo} on lab mice.
e.zh: 该药物在实验小鼠体内进行了活体测试。

e.en: {Vivo} smartphones sell well across Southeast Asia.
e.zh: vivo手机在东南亚销量很好。

e.en: A {vixen} led her cubs across the snowy field.
e.zh: 一只母狐带着幼崽穿过雪地。

e.en: The novel's villain is a scheming {vixen}.
e.zh: 小说中的反派是个工于心计的妖女。

viyella.t: n. 维也纳（棉毛混纺织物品牌）

e.en: He wore a soft {viyella} shirt to the dinner.
e.zh: 他穿着一件柔软的维耶拉衬衫去赴宴。

e.en: {Viyella} fabric blends cotton with merino wool.
e.zh: 维耶拉面料是棉与美利奴羊毛的混纺。

vizcaya.t: n. 比斯开（西班牙省名）

e.en: We toured the gardens of {vizcaya} on our Miami trip.
e.zh: 我们在迈阿密之行中游览了维兹卡亚庄园。

e.en: {Vizcaya} is a stunning Italian-style estate in Florida.
e.zh: 维兹卡亚是佛罗里达一座精美的意式庄园。

vizier.t: n. 维齐尔（伊斯兰国家高官）

e.en: The sultan trusted his {vizier} with state secrets.
e.zh: 苏丹将国家机密托付给他的大臣。

e.en: In the tale, the {vizier} plotted against the young prince.
e.zh: 故事中,那位大臣密谋陷害年轻王子。

vladivostok.t: n. 符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）

e.en: The train journey ends in {vladivostok} on the Pacific coast.
e.zh: 这趟火车之旅在太平洋沿岸的符拉迪沃斯托克结束。

e.en: {Vladivostok} hosts Russia's main Pacific naval fleet.
e.zh: 符拉迪沃斯托克是俄罗斯太平洋舰队的主要驻地。

vlsi.t: n. 超大规模集成电路

e.en: She studies {vlsi} chip design at graduate school.
e.zh: 她在研究生院研究超大规模集成电路芯片设计。

e.en: Modern smartphones rely on advanced {vlsi} technology.
e.zh: 现代智能手机依赖先进的超大规模集成电路技术。

vms.t: n. VMS（操作系统）；虚拟机复数

e.en: I review Spanish {vocab} on the app every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上在应用上复习西班牙语词汇。

e.en: Her {vocab} got way better after a year abroad.
e.zh: 在国外待了一年后,她的词汇量进步很大。

e.en: Different sciences develop their own technical {vocabularies}.
e.zh: 不同学科都会发展出自己的专业词汇体系。

e.en: Bilingual children often have smaller {vocabularies} in each language.
e.zh: 双语儿童在每种语言中的词汇量往往较小。

e.en: Reading widely is the best way to grow your {vocabulary}.
e.zh: 广泛阅读是扩大词汇量的最好方法。

e.en: That word isn't in my everyday {vocabulary}.
e.zh: 那个词不在我日常的词汇里。

vocal.t:
adj. 嗓音的；直言的
n. 声乐部分

e.en: She's been very {vocal} about the new company policy.
e.zh: 她对公司的新政策一直直言不讳。

e.en: The singer trained her {vocal} cords for years.
e.zh: 那位歌手锻炼了多年的声带。

e.en: Whales use complex {vocalisation} to communicate underwater.
e.zh: 鲸鱼用复杂的发声方式在水下交流。

e.en: The baby's first {vocalisation} delighted the whole family.
e.zh: 宝宝第一次发声让全家人都很开心。

e.en: Try to {vocalise} your concerns instead of bottling them up.
e.zh: 把你的担忧说出来,别憋在心里。

e.en: Singers warm up by {vocalise} on simple scales.
e.zh: 歌手通过练习简单音阶来开嗓。

e.en: The band is searching for a new lead {vocalist}.
e.zh: 这支乐队正在寻找新的主唱。

e.en: She's the most talented {vocalist} I've ever heard live.
e.zh: 她是我现场听过的最有才华的歌手。

e.en: Backing {vocalists} added depth to the chorus.
e.zh: 伴唱歌手为副歌增添了层次感。

e.en: Three {vocalists} auditioned for the lead role today.
e.zh: 今天有三位歌手来试唱主角。

e.en: Birds use {vocalization} to defend their territory.
e.zh: 鸟类通过鸣叫来守护自己的领地。

e.en: Clear {vocalization} is essential for stage actors.
e.zh: 清晰的发声对舞台演员来说至关重要。

e.en: It helps to {vocalize} your goals out loud each morning.
e.zh: 每天早上把目标大声说出来很有帮助。

e.en: Toddlers begin to {vocalize} simple words around one year.
e.zh: 幼儿大约一岁时开始能说出简单的词。

e.en: He {vocally} opposed the merger at the board meeting.
e.zh: 他在董事会上公开反对此次合并。

e.en: Fans {vocally} supported the team through the losing streak.
e.zh: 球迷们在球队连败期间大声为他们加油。

e.en: Teaching is more than a job—it's her {vocation}.
e.zh: 教学对她而言不只是工作,更是天职。

e.en: He found his true {vocation} working with refugees.
e.zh: 他在帮助难民的工作中找到了真正的使命。

vocational.t: adj. 职业的；职业培训的

e.en: She enrolled in a {vocational} school to study welding.
e.zh: 她报读了一所职业学校学习焊接。

e.en: {Vocational} training opens doors to skilled trade jobs.
e.zh: 职业培训为进入技术行业打开了大门。

e.en: The course is {vocationally} oriented toward IT careers.
e.zh: 这门课程以IT职业为导向。

e.en: He felt {vocationally} fulfilled after switching to nursing.
e.zh: 转行做护士后,他在职业上感到很有成就感。

vociferous.t: adj. 喧嚷的；大声疾呼的

e.en: A {vociferous} crowd gathered outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一群人在法院外大声喧哗地聚集着。

e.en: She's a {vociferous} critic of the new housing law.
e.zh: 她是新住房法的强烈批评者。

e.en: Residents protested {vociferously} against the proposed highway.
e.zh: 居民们大声抗议拟建的高速公路。

e.en: He {vociferously} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 他高声否认与这起丑闻有任何牵连。

e.en: She switched her phone plan to {Vodafone} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月把手机套餐换成了沃达丰。

e.en: {Vodafone} announced new 5G coverage across rural areas.
e.zh: 沃达丰宣布在农村地区推出新的5G覆盖。

e.en: He ordered a {vodka} tonic at the hotel bar.
e.zh: 他在酒店酒吧点了一杯伏特加汤力。

e.en: Russian {vodka} is often served chilled in small glasses.
e.zh: 俄罗斯伏特加通常冰镇后用小杯饮用。

voe.t: n. 小海湾（设得兰群岛用语）

e.en: Bucket hats are back in {vogue} this summer.
e.zh: 渔夫帽今年夏天又流行起来了。

e.en: She landed her first {Vogue} cover at nineteen.
e.zh: 她十九岁就登上了第一个《Vogue》封面。

voice.t:
n. 声音；嗓音
v. 表达

e.en: Her {voice} cracked during the emotional speech.
e.zh: 她在那段动情的演讲中声音哽咽了。

e.en: Young employees want a {voice} in company decisions.
e.zh: 年轻员工希望在公司决策中有发言权。

e.en: Several residents {voiced} concerns about the new highway.
e.zh: 几位居民对新建高速公路表达了担忧。

e.en: The letter B is a {voiced} consonant in English.
e.zh: 字母B在英语里是一个浊辅音。

e.en: The flu left her completely {voiceless} for three days.
e.zh: 那场流感让她整整三天说不出话。

e.en: Migrant workers often feel {voiceless} in policy debates.
e.zh: 外来务工者在政策讨论中常感到无人替他们发声。

e.en: Please leave a {voicemail} after the beep.
e.zh: 请在哔声后留下语音留言。

e.en: I have twelve unread {voicemail} messages from yesterday.
e.zh: 我有十二条昨天没听的语音留言。

volunteered.t: v. 自愿做；主动提供（过去式）

e.en: She {volunteered} to lead the school fundraising drive.
e.zh: 她主动请缨去主持学校的募捐活动。

e.en: He {volunteered} information the police hadn't asked for.
e.zh: 他主动提供了警方没问到的信息。

volunteering.t: v. 自愿参加；做志愿者

e.en: {Volunteering} at the hospital changed her career path.
e.zh: 在医院做志愿者改变了她的职业方向。

e.en: He's been {volunteering} every Saturday for years.
e.zh: 他多年来每周六都坚持做志愿者。

volunteerism.t: n. 志愿服务精神；义工风气

e.en: The college encourages {volunteerism} among its students.
e.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生参与志愿服务。

e.en: {Volunteerism} surged after the earthquake hit the region.
e.zh: 地震发生后,该地区的志愿活动激增。

volunteers.t:
n. 志愿者
v. 自愿参加

e.en: Hundreds of {volunteers} helped clean up the beach.
e.zh: 数百名志愿者帮忙清理了海滩。

e.en: The charity {volunteers} her time twice a week.
e.zh: 她每周两次为这家慈善机构义务服务。

voluptuous.t: adj. 性感的；丰满诱人的

e.en: The painting features a {voluptuous} figure reclining on silk.
e.zh: 画中一位丰腴的人物斜倚在丝绸上。

e.en: She enjoyed the {voluptuous} aroma of the rose garden.
e.zh: 她沉醉于玫瑰园里浓郁醉人的香气。

voluptuously.t: adv. 妖娆地；充满肉欲地

e.en: The cat stretched {voluptuously} in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 猫在午后阳光下惬意地伸了个懒腰。

e.en: She danced {voluptuously} across the candlelit stage.
e.zh: 她在烛光舞台上舞姿曼妙撩人。

e.en: The novel praises the {voluptuousness} of Mediterranean life.
e.zh: 小说赞美了地中海生活的丰盈感官之美。

e.en: Critics noted the {voluptuousness} of the sculpture's curves.
e.zh: 评论家注意到这座雕塑曲线的丰美感。

volute.t:
n. 涡卷形（装饰）
adj. 螺旋形的

e.en: The column ended in an elegantly carved {volute}.
e.zh: 柱顶以一个雕刻精美的涡卷形装饰收尾。

e.en: She collected a spiral {volute} shell on the beach.
e.zh: 她在海滩上捡到一枚螺旋形的涡螺壳。

volvo.t: n. 沃尔沃（瑞典汽车品牌）

e.en: He drives an old {volvo} station wagon to work.
e.zh: 他开着一辆老款沃尔沃旅行车去上班。

e.en: {Volvo} announced a new line of electric SUVs.
e.zh: 沃尔沃发布了一系列全新的电动SUV。

vomit.t:
v. 呕吐
n. 呕吐物

e.en: The smell almost made me {vomit} on the spot.
e.zh: 那股味道差点让我当场吐出来。

e.en: The puppy left a puddle of {vomit} on the rug.
e.zh: 小狗在地毯上吐了一摊。

vomiting.t:
n. 呕吐
v. 正在呕吐

e.en: She's been {vomiting} all night with the stomach flu.
e.zh: 她得了肠胃炎,吐了一整晚。

e.en: Persistent {vomiting} can lead to serious dehydration.
e.zh: 持续呕吐可能导致严重脱水。

vomits.t: v. 呕吐（第三人称单数）

e.en: The volcano {vomits} ash high into the sky.
e.zh: 火山把火山灰高高地喷向天空。

e.en: My toddler often {vomits} after eating too quickly.
e.zh: 我家小孩吃得太快经常会吐。

von.t: prep. 冯（德语姓氏前缀，表贵族出身）

e.en: Tourists visited a {voodoo} museum in New Orleans.
e.zh: 游客们参观了新奥尔良的伏都教博物馆。

e.en: He called the new tax plan economic {voodoo}.
e.zh: 他把这项新税收方案斥为经济上的歪门邪道。

vor.t: n. 甚高频全向信标（航空导航）

voracious.t: adj. 贪吃的；如饥似渴的

e.en: She has a {voracious} appetite for crime novels.
e.zh: 她对犯罪小说有着如饥似渴的胃口。

e.en: The puppy is a {voracious} eater at every meal.
e.zh: 这只小狗每顿都吃得狼吞虎咽。

voraciously.t: adv. 狼吞虎咽地；如饥似渴地

e.en: He read {voraciously} through every book on the shelf.
e.zh: 他贪婪地读完了书架上的每一本书。

e.en: The locusts fed {voraciously} on the wheat fields.
e.zh: 蝗虫贪婪地啃食着麦田。

e.en: The documentary contrasts the {voracities} of different predators.
e.zh: 这部纪录片对比了不同捕食者的贪婪程度。

e.en: Modern markets show strange {voracities} for new tech.
e.zh: 当今市场对新技术展现出种种贪婪的胃口。

e.en: His {voracity} for knowledge impressed every professor.
e.zh: 他对知识的渴求让每位教授都印象深刻。

e.en: The shark hunts with terrifying speed and {voracity}.
e.zh: 鲨鱼以惊人的速度和贪婪进行捕猎。

e.en: The boat got pulled into a swirling {vortex}.
e.zh: 小船被卷入了一个旋转的漩涡。

e.en: Social media can feel like a {vortex} of distractions.
e.zh: 社交媒体感觉就像一个让人分心的漩涡。

e.en: Tiny {vortices} form behind the airplane's wings in flight.
e.zh: 飞行中机翼后方会形成细小的涡流。

e.en: Storms create powerful {vortices} that sailors fear.
e.zh: 风暴会形成令水手畏惧的强大涡旋。

vos.t: (罕用) pron. 西语中的“你/你们”

e.en: She ordered a bottle of {Voss} water at the restaurant.
e.zh: 她在餐厅点了一瓶芙丝矿泉水。

e.en: The hotel stocks {Voss} sparkling water in the minibar.
e.zh: 酒店的迷你吧里备有芙丝气泡水。

e.en: He became a devoted {votary} of classical music in college.
e.zh: 他在大学时成了古典音乐的狂热爱好者。

e.en: She is a lifelong {votary} of environmental causes.
e.zh: 她终身致力于环保事业。

vote.t:
v. 投票；表决
n. 选票

e.en: Don't forget to {vote} in next week's election.
e.zh: 别忘了在下周的选举中投票。

e.en: The proposal passed by a narrow {vote} of 51 to 49.
e.zh: 该提案以51比49的微弱票数获得通过。

voted.t: v. 投了票；表决通过（过去式）

e.en: Most members {voted} in favor of the new policy.
e.zh: 大多数成员投票赞成新政策。

e.en: She {voted} for the first time in last year's election.
e.zh: 她在去年的选举中第一次投票。

e.en: Every registered {voter} received a ballot in the mail.
e.zh: 每位登记选民都收到了邮寄选票。

e.en: The candidate tried to appeal to the undecided {voter}.
e.zh: 那位候选人努力争取尚未表态的选民。

e.en: Young {voters} turned out in record numbers this year.
e.zh: 今年年轻选民的投票人数创下历史新高。

e.en: Many {voters} are concerned about rising housing costs.
e.zh: 许多选民对不断上涨的住房成本感到担忧。

votes.t:
n. 选票
v. 投票（第三人称单数）

e.en: She won the election by just two hundred {votes}.
e.zh: 她仅以两百票的优势赢得了选举。

e.en: The senator {votes} along party lines most of the time.
e.zh: 这位参议员大多数时候都按党派立场投票。

voting.t:
n. 投票；表决
v. 正在投票

e.en: Online {voting} could increase participation among younger citizens.
e.zh: 网络投票或许能提高年轻公民的参与度。

e.en: The committee is {voting} on the budget proposal today.
e.zh: 委员会今天就预算提案进行表决。

votings.t: n. 多次投票；表决活动

e.en: Multiple {votings} were held to decide the final candidate.
e.zh: 举行了多轮投票以决定最终人选。

e.en: The chairman scheduled three {votings} for the afternoon session.
e.zh: 主席为下午会议安排了三次表决。

e.en: She lit a {votive} candle at the small chapel.
e.zh: 她在那座小教堂里点了一支还愿蜡烛。

e.en: Tiny {votive} offerings filled the shelves around the shrine.
e.zh: 神龛周围的架子上摆满了小小的还愿供品。

e.en: I can {vouch} for her honesty and work ethic.
e.zh: 我可以担保她的诚实和职业操守。

e.en: Several colleagues will {vouch} for his qualifications.
e.zh: 好几位同事会为他的资历作证。

e.en: Use this {voucher} for ten percent off your next purchase.
e.zh: 使用此优惠券下次购物可享九折优惠。

e.en: The airline gave passengers a meal {voucher} during the delay.
e.zh: 航空公司在延误期间给乘客发放了餐食券。

e.en: The king refused to {vouchsafe} a reply to the letter.
e.zh: 国王拒绝赏脸回复那封信。

e.en: She would not {vouchsafe} any details about her plans.
e.zh: 她不肯透露任何关于她计划的细节。

vow.t:
n. 誓言
v. 发誓

e.en: He {vowed} to never lie to his partner again.
e.zh: 他发誓再也不对伴侣撒谎了。

e.en: The mayor {vowed} to clean up the city's parks.
e.zh: 市长承诺要整治市内的公园。

e.en: The letter "a" is a common English {vowel}.
e.zh: 字母"a"是一个常见的英语元音。

e.en: Children learn each {vowel} sound in early reading classes.
e.zh: 孩子们在早期阅读课上学习每个元音的发音。

e.en: English has five main {vowels}: a, e, i, o, u.
e.zh: 英语有五个主要元音字母:a、e、i、o、u。

e.en: Try pronouncing the {vowels} more clearly when you speak.
e.zh: 说话时试着把元音发得更清晰些。

vowing.t: v. 立誓；发誓（现在分词）

e.en: She left the meeting {vowing} to never return.
e.zh: 她离开会议时发誓再也不回来。

e.en: The team walked off the field {vowing} to win next time.
e.zh: 球队走下球场时发誓下次一定要赢。

vows.t:
n. 誓言（复数）
v. 发誓

e.en: The couple exchanged {vows} in a quiet garden ceremony.
e.zh: 这对新人在一场静谧的花园婚礼上交换了誓言。

e.en: He {vows} to finish writing the novel by December.
e.zh: 他发誓要在十二月前写完这部小说。

voyage.t:
n. 航行；旅程
v. 航海旅行

e.en: The ship began its long {voyage} across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 那艘船开始了横渡大西洋的漫长航程。

e.en: Reading his memoir was a {voyage} into another era.
e.zh: 读他的回忆录就像一次穿越到另一个时代的旅程。

e.en: The {voyager} kept a detailed journal of every port visited.
e.zh: 那位航海家详细记录了每个停靠港口的见闻。

e.en: NASA's {Voyager} probe is still sending data from deep space.
e.zh: 美国航天局的旅行者号探测器仍在从深空传回数据。

voyages.t:
n. 航行（复数）
v. 航行

e.en: Magellan's {voyages} changed how Europeans understood the world.
e.zh: 麦哲伦的航行改变了欧洲人对世界的认知。

e.en: The cruise line offers luxury {voyages} to remote islands.
e.zh: 该游轮公司提供前往偏远岛屿的豪华航程。

voyageur.t: n. 早期北美皮毛运输者

e.en: The {voyageur} paddled his canoe along the Canadian rivers.
e.zh: 那位皮货商划着独木舟沿加拿大的河流前行。

e.en: Museums display tools once used by every {voyageur} fur trader.
e.zh: 博物馆展出着每位皮货商人曾用过的工具。

e.en: Police arrested the {voyeur} who was peering into windows.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了那个窥视窗户的偷窥狂。

e.en: Reality TV turns viewers into a kind of cultural {voyeur}.
e.zh: 真人秀把观众变成了某种文化层面的窥视者。

e.en: Social media has normalized a casual form of {voyeurism}.
e.zh: 社交媒体让随意的窥视行为变得习以为常。

e.en: The film explores themes of obsession and {voyeurism}.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了痴迷与窥视的主题。

voyeuristic.t: adj. 偷窥的；猎奇窥私的

e.en: The documentary takes a {voyeuristic} look at celebrity life.
e.zh: 这部纪录片以窥探的视角审视名人生活。

e.en: Some viewers found the show's {voyeuristic} tone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 一些观众觉得节目带有窥视意味的基调让人不适。

voiceprint.t: n. 声纹（声音识别特征）

e.en: The bank uses your {voiceprint} to verify identity by phone.
e.zh: 银行通过你的声纹在电话中验证身份。

e.en: Forensic experts matched the suspect's {voiceprint} to the recording.
e.zh: 法医专家把嫌疑人的声纹与录音匹配上了。

voices.t:
n. 声音（voice 的复数）
v. 表达（voice 的第三人称单数）

e.en: I could hear muffled {voices} through the thin wall.
e.zh: 透过薄薄的墙我能听到模糊的说话声。

e.en: The app supports five different AI {voices} for narration.
e.zh: 这款应用提供五种不同的AI配音嗓音。

voicing.t: v. 表达；发声（voice 的现在分词）

e.en: Parents are {voicing} concerns about screen time at school.
e.zh: 家长们正在表达对学校屏幕使用时间的担忧。

e.en: She is {voicing} the lead character in the new animation.
e.zh: 她在为这部新动画的主角配音。

void.t:
adj. 无效的；空的
n. 空白；虚空

e.en: The contract is {void} if either party withdraws.
e.zh: 任何一方退出，合同即告失效。

e.en: His sudden departure left a {void} in the team.
e.zh: 他突然离开，给团队留下了一个空缺。

voidable.t: adj. 可作废的；可撤销的

e.en: A contract signed under duress is legally {voidable}.
e.zh: 在胁迫下签订的合同在法律上可被撤销。

e.en: Minors' agreements are generally {voidable} at their option.
e.zh: 未成年人签订的协议通常可由其选择撤销。

voided.t: v. 使无效；作废（void 的过去式）

e.en: The referee {voided} the goal after reviewing the replay.
e.zh: 裁判看了回放后判定该进球无效。

e.en: She {voided} the check by writing 'VOID' across it.
e.zh: 她在支票上写了"VOID"使其作废。

voila.t: int. 瞧；看（法语借词，表示展示）

e.en: Add a little salt, stir, and {voila} — dinner is ready.
e.zh: 加点盐，搅一搅，瞧——晚餐就好了。

e.en: Press this button and {voila}, the screen turns on.
e.zh: 按下这个按钮，瞧，屏幕就亮了。

voile.t: n. 巴里纱（一种薄纱织物）

e.en: The bedroom window had soft white {voile} curtains.
e.zh: 卧室窗户挂着柔软的白色巴里纱窗帘。

e.en: Her summer dress was made of lightweight cotton {voile}.
e.zh: 她的夏装是用轻薄的棉巴里纱做的。

vojvodina.t: n. 伏伊伏丁那（塞尔维亚自治省）

e.en: {Vojvodina} is an autonomous province in northern Serbia.
e.zh: 伏伊伏丁那是塞尔维亚北部的一个自治省。

e.en: Many ethnic Hungarians live in {Vojvodina} today.
e.zh: 如今有许多匈牙利族人居住在伏伊伏丁那。

vol.t: n. 卷（volume 的缩写）；音量

volar.t: adj. 掌侧的；跖侧的（解剖学）

e.en: The doctor examined the {volar} surface of her wrist.
e.zh: 医生检查了她手腕的掌侧表面。

e.en: Pain on the {volar} side often signals tendon injury.
e.zh: 掌侧的疼痛常常提示肌腱受伤。

volatile.t:
adj. 易变的；不稳定的
adj. 易挥发的

e.en: Crypto prices remain extremely {volatile} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度加密货币价格依然极不稳定。

e.en: He has a {volatile} temper and snaps without warning.
e.zh: 他脾气暴躁，毫无预兆就发火。

e.en: Investors are bracing for more market {volatility} this year.
e.zh: 投资者正在为今年更剧烈的市场波动做准备。

e.en: The {volatility} of the chemical makes it dangerous to store.
e.zh: 这种化学品挥发性强，储存时很危险。

volcanic.t: adj. 火山的；火山爆发般的

e.en: Iceland is famous for its dramatic {volcanic} landscapes.
e.zh: 冰岛以其壮观的火山景观而闻名。

e.en: The CEO has a {volcanic} temper that scares employees.
e.zh: 这位CEO脾气火爆，员工都怕他。

e.en: Hawaii remains one of the most {volcanically} active regions.
e.zh: 夏威夷仍是火山活动最频繁的地区之一。

e.en: The island was formed {volcanically} over millions of years.
e.zh: 这座岛屿是经过数百万年的火山作用形成的。

volcanism.t: n. 火山活动；火山作用

e.en: Ancient {volcanism} shaped much of the Pacific seafloor.
e.zh: 古代火山活动塑造了太平洋海底的大部分地形。

e.en: Scientists study {volcanism} on Mars using satellite images.
e.zh: 科学家通过卫星图像研究火星上的火山活动。

e.en: The {volcano} erupted suddenly, forcing thousands to evacuate.
e.zh: 那座火山突然喷发，迫使数千人撤离。

e.en: Mount Fuji is Japan's most iconic {volcano}.
e.zh: 富士山是日本最具代表性的火山。

e.en: Indonesia has more active {volcanoes} than any other country.
e.zh: 印度尼西亚的活火山数量比其他任何国家都多。

e.en: Underwater {volcanoes} can create entirely new islands.
e.zh: 海底火山可以形成全新的岛屿。

e.en: The {volcanologist} collected lava samples near the crater rim.
e.zh: 火山学家在火山口边缘采集了熔岩样本。

e.en: She trained as a {volcanologist} after visiting Mount Etna.
e.zh: 她参观埃特纳火山后立志成为火山学家。

e.en: A small {vole} scurried across the garden path.
e.zh: 一只小田鼠飞快地穿过了花园小径。

e.en: Owls hunt {vole} populations in the open meadow.
e.zh: 猫头鹰在空旷的草地上捕食田鼠。

volga.t: n. 伏尔加河（俄罗斯河流）

e.en: The {Volga} is the longest river in Europe.
e.zh: 伏尔加河是欧洲最长的河流。

e.en: We took a cruise down the {Volga} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿伏尔加河乘船游览。

e.en: She quit her job of her own {volition}.
e.zh: 她是出于自愿辞掉了那份工作。

e.en: He attended the meeting against his own {volition}.
e.zh: 他是违背自己的意愿去参加那个会议的。

e.en: Breathing can be both automatic and {volitional}.
e.zh: 呼吸既可以是自动的,也可以是有意识控制的。

e.en: The decision was a fully {volitional} act on her part.
e.zh: 那个决定完全是她出于自主意志作出的。

volk.t: n. 人民（德语借词，指民族）

e.en: Nazi propaganda glorified the German {Volk} above all else.
e.zh: 纳粹宣传将德意志民族凌驾于一切之上。

e.en: The speech appealed to the spirit of the {Volk}.
e.zh: 那场演说诉诸于民族精神。

volkskammer.t: n. 人民议会（前东德议会）

e.en: The East German {Volkskammer} dissolved itself in 1990.
e.zh: 东德人民议会于1990年自行解散。

e.en: Members of the {Volkskammer} voted on reunification terms.
e.zh: 人民议会的议员们就统一条款进行了表决。

volkswagen.t: n. 大众汽车（德国汽车品牌）

e.en: My first car was a used {Volkswagen} Beetle.
e.zh: 我的第一辆车是一辆二手大众甲壳虫。

e.en: {Volkswagen} announced a new line of electric vehicles.
e.zh: 大众汽车发布了一系列新款电动车。

volley.t:
n. 齐射；一连串
v. 凌空抽球

e.en: He hit a brilliant forehand {volley} at the net.
e.zh: 他在网前打出了一记漂亮的正手截击。

e.en: The senator faced a {volley} of questions from reporters.
e.zh: 那位参议员面对记者们一连串的提问。

e.en: We play beach {volleyball} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 我们每周六上午都打沙滩排球。

e.en: She joined the school {volleyball} team last year.
e.zh: 她去年加入了学校的排球队。

e.en: The coach inflated five new {volleyballs} for practice.
e.zh: 教练为训练充好了五个新排球。

e.en: Several {volleyballs} rolled across the gym floor.
e.zh: 几个排球在体育馆地板上滚来滚去。

e.en: The encyclopedia comes in twenty leather-bound {vols}.
e.zh: 这套百科全书共有二十卷皮面装订本。

e.en: The complete works span six {vols} on the shelf.
e.zh: 全集在书架上共有六卷。

e.en: This battery delivers exactly one {volt} of output.
e.zh: 这块电池输出电压正好是一伏特。

e.en: A nine-{volt} battery powers the smoke detector.
e.zh: 一节九伏电池为烟雾报警器供电。

e.en: The sonnet's {volta} signals a shift in tone.
e.zh: 十四行诗中的转折点标志着语气的转变。

e.en: Alessandro {Volta} invented the first electric battery.
e.zh: 亚历山德罗·伏特发明了世界上第一块电池。

e.en: High {voltage} can damage sensitive electronic components.
e.zh: 高电压可能会损坏敏感的电子元件。

e.en: Check the {voltage} before plugging in the device.
e.zh: 在插上设备之前先检查一下电压。

voltaic.t: adj. 电压的；伽伐尼电的

e.en: The {voltaic} cell converts chemical energy into electricity.
e.zh: 伏打电池将化学能转化为电能。

e.en: Students built a simple {voltaic} pile in class.
e.zh: 学生们在课上做了一个简单的伏打电堆。

voltaire.t: n. 伏尔泰（法国思想家）

e.en: {Voltaire} championed freedom of speech and religious tolerance.
e.zh: 伏尔泰倡导言论自由和宗教宽容。

e.en: We read a satirical novella by {Voltaire} last week.
e.zh: 我们上周读了伏尔泰写的一部讽刺中篇小说。

e.en: Use a {voltmeter} to measure the battery's charge.
e.zh: 用电压表来测量电池的电量。

e.en: The technician connected a {voltmeter} across the resistor.
e.zh: 技术员把电压表接在电阻两端。

voluble.t: adj. 健谈的；滔滔不绝的

e.en: Our {voluble} host kept everyone entertained all evening.
e.zh: 我们这位健谈的主人整晚都让大家开心不已。

e.en: He became surprisingly {voluble} after a glass of wine.
e.zh: 他喝了一杯酒后变得出奇地能说。

e.en: He spoke {volubly} about his travels for over an hour.
e.zh: 他滔滔不绝地讲了一个多小时的旅行经历。

e.en: She defended her thesis {volubly} before the panel.
e.zh: 她在评审组面前口若悬河地为论文辩护。

volume.t:
n. 音量；容量
n. 卷；册

e.en: Please turn down the {volume} on the TV.
e.zh: 请把电视的音量调小一点。

e.en: The shop saw a huge {volume} of orders this weekend.
e.zh: 这家店本周末订单量非常大。

volumes.t: n. 音量；容量；卷册（volume 的复数）

e.en: Her silence on the matter spoke {volumes}.
e.zh: 她对此事的沉默已经说明了一切。

e.en: The library holds thousands of {volumes} on history.
e.zh: 这家图书馆藏有数千卷历史书籍。

e.en: The tank uses a {volumetric} sensor to track fuel levels.
e.zh: 油箱用容积传感器来监测燃油液位。

e.en: Engineers ran a {volumetric} analysis of the new chamber.
e.zh: 工程师对新腔体做了体积分析。

voluminous.t: adj. 庞大的；卷帙浩繁的

e.en: She wore a {voluminous} red dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条蓬松的红色礼服参加晚会。

e.en: The lawyer reviewed {voluminous} case files overnight.
e.zh: 律师连夜翻阅了大量案卷。

e.en: She {voluntarily} stepped down from the board last month.
e.zh: 她上个月主动从董事会辞职。

e.en: Many staff {voluntarily} joined the weekend cleanup.
e.zh: 许多员工自愿参加了周末的清洁活动。

e.en: The judge questioned the {voluntariness} of the confession.
e.zh: 法官质疑这份供词是否出于自愿。

e.en: Researchers stressed the {voluntariness} of participation.
e.zh: 研究人员强调参与完全是自愿的。

voluntarism.t: n. 唯意志论；自愿主义

e.en: Community {voluntarism} keeps the food bank running.
e.zh: 社区志愿精神让这家食物银行得以运转。

e.en: The party promotes {voluntarism} over state intervention.
e.zh: 该党主张志愿主义,反对政府干预。

voluntaristic.t: adj. 唯意志论的；自愿主义的

e.en: He took a {voluntaristic} approach to social reform.
e.zh: 他对社会改革采取了唯意志论的取向。

e.en: The charity follows a strictly {voluntaristic} model.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构严格遵循自愿主义模式。

e.en: Attendance at the workshop is entirely {voluntary}.
e.zh: 参加这场工作坊完全是自愿的。

e.en: The company offered a {voluntary} redundancy package.
e.zh: 公司提供了一份自愿离职方案。

volunteer.t:
n. 志愿者
v. 自愿做

e.en: I'd like to {volunteer} at the animal shelter on weekends.
e.zh: 我想周末去动物收容所做志愿者。

e.en: Each {volunteer} received a free t-shirt and lunch.
e.zh: 每位志愿者都领到了免费T恤和午餐。

visits.t:
n. 访问量；拜访
v. 拜访；访问（网站）

e.en: She {visits} her parents every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每个周日下午都去看望父母。

e.en: The blog gets over ten thousand {visits} a day.
e.zh: 这个博客每天的访问量超过一万次。

e.en: He pulled down his {visor} to block the sun.
e.zh: 他放下遮阳板来挡住阳光。

e.en: The motorcyclist flipped up his helmet {visor}.
e.zh: 摩托车手把头盔的护目板掀了起来。

e.en: The knight wore a heavy {visored} helmet into battle.
e.zh: 骑士戴着一顶沉重的护面头盔上阵。

e.en: A {visored} cap protected him from the harsh sunlight.
e.zh: 一顶带帽檐的帽子帮他挡住了刺眼的阳光。

e.en: The hiking trail opens onto a stunning mountain {vista}.
e.zh: 这条徒步小径通向令人惊叹的山景全景。

e.en: Remote work opened up a new {vista} of opportunities.
e.zh: 远程办公开启了全新的机遇前景。

e.en: The {Vistula} is the longest river in Poland.
e.zh: 维斯瓦河是波兰最长的河流。

e.en: Warsaw sits on the banks of the {Vistula}.
e.zh: 华沙坐落在维斯瓦河畔。

visual.t:
adj. 视觉的；视力的
n. 视觉素材

e.en: The presentation needs more {visual} elements to engage viewers.
e.zh: 演示文稿需要更多的视觉元素来吸引观众。

e.en: She has a strong {visual} memory for faces.
e.zh: 她对人脸有很强的视觉记忆能力。

e.en: The data {visualisation} made the trends easy to spot.
e.zh: 这个数据可视化让趋势一目了然。

e.en: Athletes use mental {visualisation} to prepare for big races.
e.zh: 运动员通过心理意象训练来备战大型比赛。

e.en: Try to {visualise} the final layout before you start coding.
e.zh: 开始写代码前,试着先在脑海里想象最终的布局。

e.en: Athletes often {visualise} success before a big competition.
e.zh: 运动员常常会在大赛前在脑中预演成功的场景。

e.en: The exhibition explores the {visuality} of digital culture.
e.zh: 这次展览探讨了数字文化的视觉性。

e.en: Comics rely on {visuality} as much as on text.
e.zh: 漫画依赖视觉性,跟文字一样重要。

visualization.t: n. 可视化；数据图形化

e.en: The dashboard offers a clear {visualization} of weekly sales.
e.zh: 这个仪表盘清晰地展示了每周的销售数据。

e.en: Data {visualization} helps non-technical teams understand trends.
e.zh: 数据可视化能帮助非技术团队理解趋势。

visualize.t: v. 使可视化；在脑中想象

e.en: Close your eyes and {visualize} a calm beach.
e.zh: 闭上眼睛,想象一片宁静的海滩。

e.en: Designers use Figma to {visualize} the user interface early.
e.zh: 设计师用 Figma 在早期就把用户界面可视化出来。

visualized.t: v. visualize 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: The team {visualized} server traffic on a real-time map.
e.zh: 团队在实时地图上把服务器流量可视化呈现出来。

e.en: She {visualized} her speech going perfectly before stepping onstage.
e.zh: 上台前她在脑海里把演讲完美地演练了一遍。

e.en: The new homepage is {visually} much cleaner than the old one.
e.zh: 新首页在视觉上比旧版干净多了。

e.en: The app is designed to be friendly to {visually} impaired users.
e.zh: 这款应用对视障用户也很友好。

visuals.t: n. 视觉素材；画面效果

e.en: The talk had great content but weak {visuals}.
e.zh: 那场演讲内容不错,但视觉效果较弱。

e.en: Concert {visuals} synced perfectly with every drumbeat.
e.zh: 演唱会的视觉效果和每一下鼓点都精准同步。

visuospatial.t: adj. 视觉空间的（认知能力）

e.en: Architects rely heavily on strong {visuospatial} skills.
e.zh: 建筑师非常依赖较强的视觉空间能力。

e.en: The puzzle tests a child's {visuospatial} reasoning.
e.zh: 这个拼图测试的是孩子的视觉空间推理能力。

e.en: Please attach your latest {vita} to the application.
e.zh: 请把你最新的简历附在申请材料里。

e.en: Her academic {vita} runs over twenty pages long.
e.zh: 她的学术简历有二十多页长。

vitae.t: n. vita 的复数；生平经历

e.en: Send your curriculum {vitae} as a single PDF file.
e.zh: 请把你的简历整合成一个 PDF 文件发过来。

e.en: The committee reviewed each candidate's {vitae} carefully.
e.zh: 委员会仔细审阅了每位候选人的简历。

vital.t: adj. 至关重要的；充满活力的

e.en: Sleep is {vital} for a healthy immune system.
e.zh: 睡眠对健康的免疫系统至关重要。

e.en: Clear communication is {vital} in any remote team.
e.zh: 清晰的沟通对任何远程团队都至关重要。

e.en: Modern biology has largely abandoned the doctrine of {vitalism}.
e.zh: 现代生物学基本上已经抛弃了活力论。

e.en: {Vitalism} held that living things possess a unique life force.
e.zh: 活力论认为生物拥有一种独特的生命力。

vitalist.t:
n. 活力论者
adj. 活力论的

e.en: He held a {vitalist} view that life cannot be reduced to chemistry.
e.zh: 他持有一种活力论观点,认为生命不能完全归结为化学反应。

e.en: Early {vitalist} thinkers believed organisms had a special essence.
e.zh: 早期的活力论者相信生物体拥有某种特殊本质。

e.en: Yoga helps her keep her energy and {vitality}.
e.zh: 瑜伽帮助她保持精力和活力。

e.en: Small businesses bring real {vitality} to the neighborhood.
e.zh: 小商铺给这个街区带来了真正的生气。

e.en: A morning walk can {vitalize} you for the whole day.
e.zh: 早上散步能让你一整天都精神饱满。

e.en: New funding will {vitalize} the struggling arts program.
e.zh: 新的资金将为陷入困境的艺术项目注入活力。

e.en: Clean water is {vitally} important for public health.
e.zh: 清洁的水对公共卫生至关重要。

e.en: This update {vitally} improves the app's performance.
e.zh: 此次更新极大地提升了应用的性能。

e.en: Oranges are a great source of {vitamin} C.
e.zh: 橙子是维生素C的极佳来源。

e.en: She takes a daily {vitamin} with breakfast.
e.zh: 她每天早餐时服用一片维生素。

vitamine.t: n. 维生素（vitamin 的旧拼写）

e.en: The old textbook still spells it {vitamine} with an e.
e.zh: 那本旧教科书仍把它拼成带e的vitamine。

e.en: Funk coined the term {vitamine} in 1912.
e.zh: 丰克在1912年创造了vitamine这个词。

e.en: Leafy greens are packed with essential {vitamins}.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜富含必需的维生素。

e.en: My doctor said I need more {vitamins} in my diet.
e.zh: 医生说我饮食中需要补充更多维生素。

e.en: The French dashboard displays speed as {vitesse} in km/h.
e.zh: 法国的仪表盘以vitesse显示时速。

e.en: She admired the {vitesse} of the new sports car.
e.zh: 她赞叹这辆新跑车的速度。

e.en: One bad clause can {vitiate} the entire contract.
e.zh: 一个不当条款就可能使整份合同失效。

e.en: Loud ads {vitiate} the user experience of the app.
e.zh: 刺耳的广告会损害应用的用户体验。

e.en: Napa Valley is famous for its {viticulture}.
e.zh: 纳帕谷以其葡萄栽培业闻名。

e.en: He studied {viticulture} before opening a winery.
e.zh: 开酒庄前他学习了葡萄种植学。

e.en: Winnie Harlow is a model with {vitiligo}.
e.zh: 温妮·哈洛是一位患有白癜风的模特。

e.en: Doctors are researching new treatments for {vitiligo}.
e.zh: 医生正在研究治疗白癜风的新方法。

vitreous.t: adj. 玻璃样的；玻璃体的

e.en: The pottery has a smooth {vitreous} glaze.
e.zh: 这件陶器有光滑的玻璃釉面。

e.en: Floaters appear in the eye's {vitreous} humor.
e.zh: 飞蚊出现在眼球的玻璃体内。

e.en: Intense heat will {vitrify} the sand into glass.
e.zh: 高温会把沙子玻璃化变成玻璃。

e.en: Engineers {vitrify} nuclear waste for safer storage.
e.zh: 工程师将核废料玻璃化以便更安全地储存。

e.en: The museum displayed jade carvings in a lit {vitrine}.
e.zh: 博物馆将玉雕陈列在一个带灯的玻璃柜中。

e.en: Designer handbags lined the boutique's front {vitrine}.
e.zh: 名牌手袋摆满了精品店前面的玻璃陈列柜。

e.en: Geologists measure {vitrinite} reflectance to assess coal maturity.
e.zh: 地质学家测量镜质体反射率以评估煤的成熟度。

e.en: The sample contained mostly {vitrinite} and some inertinite.
e.zh: 该样品主要含镜质体和少量惰质体。

vitriol.t: n. 尖刻的言辞；硫酸盐

e.en: The comment section was full of online {vitriol}.
e.zh: 评论区充斥着网络上的恶毒攻击。

e.en: She faced {vitriol} after posting her opinion.
e.zh: 她发表观点后遭到了猛烈的辱骂。

e.en: The critic wrote a {vitriolic} review of the film.
e.zh: 那位影评人写了一篇尖刻刻薄的影评。

e.en: His {vitriolic} tweets cost him sponsorships.
e.zh: 他刻薄恶毒的推文让他失去了赞助。

e.en: The cowboys gathered around for some hot {vittles}.
e.zh: 牛仔们围坐在一起吃热腾腾的饭菜。

e.en: Grandma cooked up tasty {vittles} every Sunday.
e.zh: 奶奶每个星期天都会做美味的饭菜。

vittoria.t: n. 维托里亚（人名/地名）

e.en: The Italian crowd shouted "{vittoria}!" after the goal.
e.zh: 进球后意大利观众高呼"胜利!"。

e.en: {Vittoria} tires are popular among road cyclists.
e.zh: 维多利亚轮胎在公路自行车手中很受欢迎。

e.en: Pundits {vituperate} politicians on cable news nightly.
e.zh: 评论员每晚在有线新闻上痛骂政客。

e.en: It's unprofessional to {vituperate} colleagues in meetings.
e.zh: 在会议上痛骂同事是很不专业的行为。

e.en: The losing coach faced harsh {vituperation} from fans.
e.zh: 输球的教练遭到球迷严厉的痛斥。

e.en: Her speech contained no {vituperation}, only calm reasoning.
e.zh: 她的演讲没有谩骂,只有冷静的说理。

e.en: The debate turned into a {vituperative} shouting match.
e.zh: 那场辩论沦为了一场谩骂式的争吵。

e.en: He deleted his {vituperative} post the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上他删掉了那条恶语相向的帖子。

vitus.t: n. 维图斯（人名，如圣维图斯）

e.en: Saint {Vitus} is the patron saint of dancers.
e.zh: 圣维特是舞者的主保圣人。

e.en: Doctors once called the disorder Saint {Vitus}'s dance.
e.zh: 医生曾把这种病叫做圣维特舞蹈症。

viva.t:
int. 万岁
n. 口试（英式）

e.en: She passed her PhD {viva} with minor corrections.
e.zh: 她通过了博士论文答辩,只需做小修改。

e.en: The crowd shouted "{viva} la revolución!" in the square.
e.zh: 人群在广场上高呼"革命万岁!"。

e.en: Our new host is funny and {vivacious}.
e.zh: 我们的新主持人风趣又活泼。

e.en: She gave a {vivacious} performance on the talk show.
e.zh: 她在脱口秀上的表现充满活力。

e.en: The toddler's {vivacity} brightened the whole room.
e.zh: 小宝宝的活泼让整个房间都明亮起来。

e.en: Her writing has a charm and {vivacity} readers love.
e.zh: 她的文字有一种读者喜爱的魅力与活力。

e.en: {Vivaldi} composed The Four Seasons in the 1720s.
e.zh: 维瓦尔第在1720年代创作了《四季》。

e.en: I use the {Vivaldi} browser for its tab management.
e.zh: 我用Vivaldi浏览器,因为它的标签管理很好。

vroom.t:
n. 引擎轰鸣声
v. 轰鸣着疾驰

e.en: The sports car went {vroom} as it sped past us.
e.zh: 那辆跑车呼啸着从我们身边飞驰而过。

e.en: He made {vroom} sounds while pushing the toy car.
e.zh: 他一边推着玩具车一边发出"呜呜"的声音。

vuitton.t: n. 路易威登（奢侈品牌）

e.en: She carried a classic Louis {Vuitton} handbag to the gala.
e.zh: 她拎着一只经典的路易威登手袋出席晚会。

e.en: The boutique sells genuine Louis {Vuitton} luggage.
e.zh: 这家精品店出售正品路易威登行李箱。

e.en: Spock raised his hand in the famous {Vulcan} salute.
e.zh: 史波克举手做出了那个著名的瓦肯人致敬礼。

e.en: In Roman mythology, {Vulcan} was the god of fire and forges.
e.zh: 在罗马神话中,瓦肯是火与锻造之神。

e.en: His {vulgar} jokes made everyone at the dinner uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他粗俗的笑话让晚餐上的每个人都很尴尬。

e.en: The painting was criticized as {vulgar} and tasteless.
e.zh: 这幅画被批评为庸俗且毫无品味。

vulgaris.t: adj. 寻常的（拉丁学名用语）

e.en: Acne {vulgaris} affects most teenagers at some point.
e.zh: 寻常痤疮在某个阶段会影响大多数青少年。

e.en: The plant species Beta {vulgaris} includes common beetroot.
e.zh: 甜菜属植物Beta vulgaris包括常见的红菜头。

e.en: The show was criticized for its excessive {vulgarity}.
e.zh: 该节目因过度的低俗内容而受到批评。

e.en: She found the {vulgarity} of his language deeply offensive.
e.zh: 她觉得他言语的粗俗令人深感冒犯。

e.en: Critics complained about the {vulgarization} of classical music in pop remixes.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨流行混音对古典音乐的庸俗化。

e.en: He resisted any {vulgarization} of his philosophical ideas.
e.zh: 他抵制对自己哲学思想的任何庸俗化解读。

e.en: The mansion was {vulgarly} decorated with gold everywhere.
e.zh: 那座豪宅装饰得俗气,到处都是金子。

e.en: He behaved {vulgarly} at the formal reception.
e.zh: 他在正式招待会上举止粗俗。

vulnerabilities.t: n. 漏洞、脆弱点（vulnerability 复数）

e.en: The security team patched several {vulnerabilities} in the app.
e.zh: 安全团队修补了应用中的多个漏洞。

e.en: Therapy helped her acknowledge her emotional {vulnerabilities}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助她正视自己情感上的脆弱面。

e.en: A critical {vulnerability} was discovered in the login system.
e.zh: 登录系统中发现了一个严重的安全漏洞。

e.en: Sharing his story took real {vulnerability} and courage.
e.zh: 分享他的故事需要真正的坦露与勇气。

vulnerable.t: adj. 易受攻击的、脆弱的

e.en: Elderly people are especially {vulnerable} to the flu virus.
e.zh: 老年人特别容易感染流感病毒。

e.en: She felt {vulnerable} after opening up about her past.
e.zh: 她在敞开心扉谈及过去后感到很脆弱。

e.en: He gave her a {vulpine} smile that hinted at mischief.
e.zh: 他向她露出一个狐狸般狡黠的微笑。

e.en: The detective had a sharp, {vulpine} cunning about him.
e.zh: 那位侦探身上有一种狐狸般的精明狡黠。

vulture.t:
n. 秃鹫
n. 趁火打劫的人

e.en: A {vulture} circled high above the desert carcass.
e.zh: 一只秃鹫在沙漠中的尸体上方盘旋。

e.en: Reporters descended like a {vulture} on the grieving family.
e.zh: 记者们像秃鹫一样扑向悲痛的家人。

e.en: The doctor explained how to keep the {vulva} clean and healthy.
e.zh: 医生解释了如何保持外阴清洁与健康。

e.en: Many sex education courses still avoid naming the {vulva}.
e.zh: 许多性教育课程仍回避直接说出外阴这个词。

vying.t: v. 争夺、竞争（vie 现在分词）

e.en: Two startups are {vying} for the same market share.
e.zh: 两家创业公司正在争夺同一块市场份额。

e.en: The siblings were always {vying} for their father's attention.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹们总是在争夺父亲的关注。

vzv.t: n. 水痘带状疱疹病毒

e.en: The {virologist} explained how the new variant spreads.
e.zh: 那位病毒学家解释了新变种是如何传播的。

e.en: She trained as a {virologist} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 她在大流行期间接受了病毒学家的训练。

e.en: He earned a PhD in {virology} from Oxford.
e.zh: 他在牛津获得了病毒学博士学位。

e.en: Modern {virology} has advanced rapidly in recent decades.
e.zh: 现代病毒学在近几十年来发展迅速。

virtu.t: n. 古玩；对艺术品的爱好

e.en: The collector has a real eye for objects of {virtu}.
e.zh: 那位收藏家对古玩珍品很有眼光。

e.en: The museum displays Renaissance items of {virtu}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了文艺复兴时期的艺术珍品。

virtual.t:
adj. 虚拟的（网络、数字）
adj. 实际上的

e.en: We held the meeting in a {virtual} conference room.
e.zh: 我们在一个虚拟会议室开了会。

e.en: The new headset offers an immersive {virtual} reality experience.
e.zh: 这款新头显提供沉浸式的虚拟现实体验。

e.en: Philosophers debate the nature of {virtuality} versus reality.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论虚拟性与真实性的本质。

e.en: The exhibit explores how {virtuality} shapes modern identity.
e.zh: 展览探讨了虚拟性如何塑造现代身份。

virtually.t:
adv. 几乎、实际上
adv. 以虚拟方式

e.en: The two phones are {virtually} identical in design.
e.zh: 这两款手机的设计几乎完全相同。

e.en: We {virtually} attended the conference from home.
e.zh: 我们在家以线上方式参加了会议。

e.en: Patience is a {virtue} worth cultivating.
e.zh: 耐心是一种值得培养的美德。

e.en: The app's main {virtue} is its simplicity.
e.zh: 这款应用最大的优点是简洁。

e.en: The book lists the {virtues} of daily exercise.
e.zh: 这本书列举了每日锻炼的好处。

e.en: Honesty and kindness are {virtues} he learned from his mother.
e.zh: 诚实和善良是他从母亲那里学到的美德。

e.en: Her {virtuosic} piano performance left the audience speechless.
e.zh: 她精湛的钢琴表演让观众惊叹无言。

e.en: The film features {virtuosic} camera work throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影通篇展现了精湛的摄影技巧。

e.en: The concert showcased the {virtuosities} of three young soloists.
e.zh: 这场音乐会展示了三位年轻独奏家的高超技艺。

e.en: Critics admired the singer's vocal {virtuosities}.
e.zh: 评论家们赞叹这位歌手的多种精湛唱功。

e.en: The guitarist played with stunning technical {virtuosity}.
e.zh: 这位吉他手以惊人的技术造诣演奏着。

e.en: Her {virtuosity} on the violin amazed everyone.
e.zh: 她在小提琴上的精湛技艺让所有人惊叹。

virtuoso.t: n. 艺术大师、技艺高手

e.en: The young {virtuoso} performed with the symphony last night.
e.zh: 那位年轻的演奏大师昨晚和交响乐团合作演出。

e.en: He's a coding {virtuoso} who can debug anything.
e.zh: 他是个编程高手,什么 bug 都能调试出来。

virtuosoes.t: n. 艺术大师（复数，较少见拼法）

e.en: The festival gathered piano {virtuosoes} from around the world.
e.zh: 这个音乐节汇集了来自世界各地的钢琴大师。

e.en: Few {virtuosoes} can match her level of skill.
e.zh: 很少有演奏大师能达到她那样的水平。

e.en: He lived a quiet, {virtuous} life in the countryside.
e.zh: 他在乡下过着平静而高尚的生活。

e.en: Recycling creates a {virtuous} cycle of reuse.
e.zh: 回收形成了一种良性的再利用循环。

e.en: She {virtuously} declined the bribe and reported it.
e.zh: 她正直地拒绝了贿赂并将其举报。

e.en: He smiled {virtuously} after finishing his vegetables.
e.zh: 他吃完蔬菜后露出一副得意正经的笑容。

e.en: Scientists are studying the {virulence} of the new variant.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究这一新变种的毒性强度。

e.en: The {virulence} of his criticism shocked the room.
e.zh: 他批评的尖刻程度让全场震惊。

e.en: The disease is caused by a {virulent} strain of bacteria.
e.zh: 这种疾病由一种剧毒的细菌菌株引起。

e.en: He launched a {virulent} attack on the policy online.
e.zh: 他在网上对该政策发起了恶毒的攻击。

e.en: She was {virulently} opposed to the merger.
e.zh: 她强烈地反对这次合并。

e.en: The pundit spoke {virulently} against the new law.
e.zh: 那位评论员对新法律进行了激烈的抨击。

virus.t: n. 病毒（生物 / 电脑）

e.en: My laptop got infected by a nasty {virus}.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑感染了一个恶性病毒。

e.en: Doctors are tracking how the {virus} spreads.
e.zh: 医生们正在追踪这种病毒的传播方式。

vis-a-vis.t:
prep. 关于、相对于
n. 对方

e.en: What is your position {vis-a-vis} the new policy?
e.zh: 你对这项新政策的立场是什么?

e.en: Sales are up sharply {vis-a-vis} last quarter.
e.zh: 与上一季度相比,销售额大幅上升。

e.en: I'm still waiting for my student {visa} to be approved.
e.zh: 我还在等学生签证获批。

e.en: You'll need a tourist {visa} to enter the country.
e.zh: 你需要旅游签证才能入境。

e.en: His stern {visage} softened when he saw the puppy.
e.zh: 看到小狗时,他严肃的面容柔和了下来。

e.en: The portrait captured her noble {visage} perfectly.
e.zh: 这幅肖像完美地捕捉了她高贵的面容。

e.en: Both {visas} were approved within a week.
e.zh: 两份签证都在一周内获批。

e.en: Some countries no longer require tourist {visas}.
e.zh: 一些国家不再要求旅游签证。

e.en: The surgeon carefully examined the patient's {viscera}.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了病人的内脏。

e.en: Ancient priests read omens from animal {viscera}.
e.zh: 古代祭司通过动物内脏来解读预兆。

visceral.t:
adj. 发自本能的
adj. 内脏的

e.en: I had a {visceral} reaction to the horror film.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片让我产生了发自内心的反应。

e.en: There's a {visceral} thrill to riding a roller coaster.
e.zh: 坐过山车有一种本能的刺激感。

viscerally.t: adv. 本能地、发自内心地

e.en: The film {viscerally} captures the chaos of war.
e.zh: 这部电影直击内心地呈现了战争的混乱。

e.en: I {viscerally} reacted to the sudden loud noise.
e.zh: 我对那突如其来的巨响产生了本能的反应。

e.en: The leaves were coated with a {viscid} sap.
e.zh: 叶子上覆盖着一层粘稠的树液。

e.en: A {viscid} film formed on top of the soup.
e.zh: 汤面上结了一层黏糊糊的薄膜。

e.en: The mattress uses {viscoelastic} foam for better support.
e.zh: 这款床垫采用粘弹性泡沫以提供更好的支撑。

e.en: Engineers tested the {viscoelastic} properties of the polymer.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种聚合物的粘弹性特性。

visconti.t: n. 维斯康蒂（意大利姓氏）

e.en: {Visconti} directed several classics of Italian cinema.
e.zh: 维斯孔蒂执导了多部意大利电影经典之作。

e.en: The museum displayed a portrait of a {Visconti} duke.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅维斯孔蒂家族公爵的肖像。

e.en: The dress is made from soft {viscose} fabric.
e.zh: 这条裙子是用柔软的粘胶纤维面料做的。

e.en: {Viscose} feels cool against the skin in summer.
e.zh: 粘胶纤维在夏天贴肤时感觉很凉爽。

e.en: Honey has a much higher {viscosity} than water.
e.zh: 蜂蜜的粘度比水高得多。

e.en: Engine oil loses {viscosity} as it heats up.
e.zh: 机油在升温时会失去粘度。

e.en: The {viscount} inherited a vast country estate.
e.zh: 这位子爵继承了一片广阔的乡村庄园。

e.en: A young {viscount} attended the royal banquet.
e.zh: 一位年轻的子爵出席了王室宴会。

e.en: The {viscountess} hosted a charity ball last weekend.
e.zh: 子爵夫人上周末举办了一场慈善舞会。

e.en: She became a {viscountess} after marrying the nobleman.
e.zh: 她嫁给那位贵族后成了子爵夫人。

e.en: The lava moved slowly because it was so {viscous}.
e.zh: 熔岩因为太粘稠所以流动得很慢。

e.en: Pour the {viscous} syrup carefully over the pancakes.
e.zh: 小心地把那粘稠的糖浆倒在薄饼上。

e.en: He clamped the wood firmly in the {vise}.
e.zh: 他把木头牢牢夹在台钳里。

e.en: The mechanic tightened the bolt using a metal {vise}.
e.zh: 机修工用金属台钳拧紧了螺栓。

vishnu.t: n. 毗湿奴（印度教神祇）

e.en: Hindus worship {Vishnu} as the preserver of the universe.
e.zh: 印度教徒将毗湿奴奉为宇宙的守护者。

e.en: The temple features a beautiful statue of {Vishnu}.
e.zh: 这座寺庙里有一尊精美的毗湿奴神像。

visibility.t: n. 能见度；可见性、曝光度

e.en: Heavy fog reduced {visibility} on the highway.
e.zh: 浓雾降低了高速公路上的能见度。

e.en: Social media gives small brands more {visibility}.
e.zh: 社交媒体让小品牌获得了更多的曝光度。

e.en: The error message is barely {visible} on dark mode.
e.zh: 在深色模式下,错误提示几乎看不清。

e.en: Stars become {visible} once the sun fully sets.
e.zh: 太阳完全落下后,星星就出现了。

e.en: She was {visibly} upset after reading the email.
e.zh: 她读完那封邮件后明显很难过。

e.en: The patient was {visibly} relieved by the good news.
e.zh: 听到好消息,病人明显松了一口气。

e.en: A {Visigoth} army sacked Rome in 410 AD.
e.zh: 公元410年,一支西哥特军队洗劫了罗马。

e.en: The museum exhibits ancient {Visigoth} jewelry and weapons.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古代西哥特人的珠宝和武器。

e.en: The CEO shared her {vision} for the company's future.
e.zh: 首席执行官分享了她对公司未来的愿景。

e.en: Her {vision} got blurry after staring at the screen.
e.zh: 她盯着屏幕久了,视力变得模糊。

visionary.t:
adj. 有远见的
n. 梦想家

e.en: Steve Jobs is remembered as a {visionary} leader.
e.zh: 乔布斯被人们铭记为一位有远见的领袖。

e.en: The architect proposed a {visionary} design for the city.
e.zh: 这位建筑师为这座城市提出了一个富有远见的设计。

e.en: He had wild {visions} of becoming a famous chef.
e.zh: 他怀着成为名厨的种种狂想。

e.en: The prophet claimed to receive {visions} from God.
e.zh: 那位先知声称从上帝那里得到了启示。

visit.t:
v. 访问、拜访
n. 访问

e.en: We plan to {visit} Kyoto during the cherry blossoms.
e.zh: 我们打算在樱花季去京都游玩。

e.en: Please {visit} our website for more information.
e.zh: 请访问我们的网站了解更多信息。

e.en: Most rooms in the castle are {visitable} year-round.
e.zh: 城堡里大部分房间全年都对外开放参观。

e.en: The historic site is easily {visitable} by train.
e.zh: 这处历史景点坐火车就能方便地参观。

e.en: The court granted him weekly {visitation} with his children.
e.zh: 法庭批准他每周可以探视孩子。

e.en: Friends gathered for the {visitation} before the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼前,亲友们聚在一起为逝者守灵。

visited.t:
v. 访问（过去式）
adj. 已访问的

e.en: I {visited} my grandmother last weekend.
e.zh: 我上周末去看望了我外婆。

e.en: This is one of the most {visited} parks in town.
e.zh: 这是城里游客最多的公园之一。

e.en: My cousins are {visiting} from Canada this summer.
e.zh: 我的表亲们今年夏天从加拿大来玩。

e.en: She is a {visiting} professor at our university.
e.zh: 她是我们大学的一位访问教授。

e.en: Each {visitor} must sign in at the front desk.
e.zh: 每位访客都必须在前台登记。

e.en: The website tracks how long each {visitor} stays.
e.zh: 网站会追踪每位访客停留的时间。

e.en: The museum welcomes thousands of {visitors} every weekend.
e.zh: 这家博物馆每个周末都迎来成千上万的游客。

e.en: Our app reached one million unique {visitors} last month.
e.zh: 我们的应用上个月达到了一百万独立访客。

vainest.t: a. 无价值的, 徒然的, 空虚的, 自负的, 愚蠢的

versified.t: vi. 作诗\nvt. 用诗表达

vertebrae.t: n. 脊椎, 椎骨\n[医] 椎骨, 脊髓

vertices.t: n. 顶点, 最高点, 头顶, 天顶\n[计] 顶点

vestrymen.t: n. 教区代表, 教区委员

vetted.t: n. 兽医\nvi. 当兽医\nvt. 诊断, 检审

vexes.t: vt. 使烦恼, 使苦恼\nvi. 烦恼

vied.t: vi. 争, 竞争, 争胜\nvt. 提出...来竞争, 以...作较量

vies.t: vi. 争, 竞争, 争胜\nvt. 提出...来竞争, 以...作较量

vilest.t: a. 恶劣的, 肮脏的, 低廉的, 卑鄙的\n[法] 极坏的, 恶劣的, 卑鄙的

vivified.t: vt. 给与生气, 使生动, 使活跃

e.en: The frame uses a {V-beam} to support the load.
e.zh: 这个框架使用一根 V 形梁来承重。

e.en: The lab aligned the {V-beam} before the test.
e.zh: 实验室在测试前校准了 V 形光束。

e.en: Place the round bar in the {V-block} before drilling.
e.zh: 钻孔前，把圆杆放进 V 形块里。

e.en: A machinist used a {V-block} to hold the shaft steady.
e.zh: 机修工用 V 形块固定住那根轴。

e.en: The carpenter made a clean {V-cut} in the board.
e.zh: 木匠在木板上切出一个干净的 V 形口。

e.en: Her dress had a deep {V-cut} neckline.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙有很深的 V 形领口。

e.en: Veterans gathered downtown on {V-Day}.
e.zh: 退伍军人在胜利日聚集到市中心。

e.en: The shop sold roses for {V-Day}.
e.zh: 这家店为情人节出售玫瑰。

e.en: The engine uses a {V-drive} to transfer power.
e.zh: 这台发动机使用 V 带传动装置来传递动力。

e.en: A worn {V-drive} can make the machine vibrate.
e.zh: 磨损的 V 带传动装置会让机器振动。

e.en: Soldiers sent {V-mail} to save cargo space.
e.zh: 士兵寄送胜利邮以节省货运空间。

e.en: Her grandfather kept a faded {V-mail} from 1944.
e.zh: 她祖父保存着一封 1944 年已经褪色的胜利邮。

e.en: The foundry adopted the {V-process} for smoother castings.
e.zh: 铸造厂采用 V 工艺来生产更光滑的铸件。

e.en: Engineers compared sand casting with the {V-process}.
e.zh: 工程师比较了砂型铸造和 V 工艺。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {v-ring} seal.
e.zh: 修理工更换了磨损的V形密封圈。

e.en: A {v-ring} keeps dust away from the bearing.
